quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money.  Ursala owes me $2500.  You must have spent it.  I hope you go make some to cover her bill, since she trusted you with that money.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Sandra's Jam!  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see.  With what she owed...  All right.  Here's a little something for all that work you did for me.  Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Cinnamon gives milk to thirsty players.
quest_list.success_message: You enjoyed a glass of milk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. Enjoy the milk.

quest_list.notes: Cinnamon asks you to take a letter to Cupcake
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave you the letter.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to take a letter to Cupcake. Cinnamon gave you the Letter for Cupcake.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for stopping by Cupcake's house with my letter.

quest_list.notes: Cinnamon gives milk for Cookie
quest_list.success_message: Cinnamon gave you four glasses of Milk to deliver to Cookie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! Be careful you don't spill it.

quest_list.notes: Deliver Letter to Cupcake
quest_list.title: Cinnamon's Letter
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cinnamon's Letter!  You earned $500, a Cake and 25 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks! I can hardly wait to read it.
quest_list.author: Pam

quest_list.notes: Give Krista 10 Dandelions
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have 10. Remember I only take bundles of 10.
quest_list.success_message: You were given $100 for 10 Dandelions.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you! Do you have anything else for me?

quest_list.notes: Give Krista 10 Branches
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have 10 branches. Remember, I only take them in bundles of 10.
quest_list.success_message: You have been given $100 for 10 Strong Skinny Branches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks! I really need these for my baskets.

quest_list.notes: Agree to deliver baskets to Tulippe.
quest_list.success_message: You have been given a Bundle of Baskets and $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are a lifesaver! Take this bundle to Tulippe. Here is $1000 to cover your boat fares.

quest_list.notes: Give bundle of baskets to Tulippe
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I was hoping you were bringing me something from Krista.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Tulippe the baskets. You were given the payment to return to Krista.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am so glad you brought these. As you can see, I need baskets for all my flowers. Here is the payment for Krista.

quest_list.notes: Give Tulippe's money to Krista
quest_list.title: Krista's Baskets
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money. Her bill was for $750. Did you go shopping on your way back?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Krista's Baskets!  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks so much for taking care of that for me. Now I can just keep working on more baskets.
quest_list.author: Pam

quest_list.notes: Agree to get medicine for Lief
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Thanks anyway, I am sure I will be able to get there soon.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to pick up Lief's medicine at the Tropicton General Store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be great, thanks. Just tell him to put it on my tab.

quest_list.notes: Agree to pick up oats from Oliver for Temperance
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Stop back here when you get them.  I think 5 should do it.
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked to pick up 5 Bags of Oats.  You were given $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Stop back here when you get them.  Here's money for the bags of oats.  Oh, I think 5 should do it.

quest_list.notes: Get bags of oats from Oliver
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have $900.  Come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You were given 5 Bags of Oats for $900.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, here you are.

quest_list.notes: Agree to take bags of oats to Trina and get sent to Mare Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, wait.  I thought you got the bags of oats from Oliver?  Better go get some.  If you fed them to your horse you'll just have to buy some yourself.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF* You are on Mare Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you are.  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Give bags of oats to Trina
quest_list.title: Temperance's Sister
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the bags of oats?  Hmmm...  I guess you'll have to go back to the mainland.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Temperance's Sister Quest!  You earned $5000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks!  I've been needing these.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Temperence sends you to Mare Isle
quest_list.success_message: *POOF* You are now on Mare Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure.  There you are.

quest_list.notes: Pick up medicine for Lief
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Bottle of Medicine to take back to Lief.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yep, I sure do. Here it is.  Hope he feels better soon.

quest_list.notes: Dig to get to the nearby island
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, a tunnel large enough for you to walk through opens in front of you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are on Palm Isle.

quest_list.notes: Dig to go back to Mare Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, a tunnel large enough for you to walk through opens in front of you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are on Mare Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give Lief his medicine
quest_list.title: Lief's Allergy Medicine Delivery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, that wasn't what I needed.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Lief's Allergy Medicine Delivery! You earned $2500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is exactly what I needed.  Thanks again.  Here's a little something for your trouble.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Dig up a treasure on Palm Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: After digging for a bit, you hit something hard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found 8 Gold Ore and 1 Diamond!

quest_list.notes: Nomasonto gives you tea
quest_list.success_message: You drank a hot cup of Jasmine Tea.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Enjoy.

quest_list.notes: Agree to deliver Stable for Parry
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Were you able to find my long lost love and deliver the stable?
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Parry's long lost love. You were given a Miniature Stable and $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for helping me get the stable to my long lost love.

quest_list.notes: Deliver Holly's Letter to Parry
quest_list.title: Parry's Long Lost Love
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Were you not able to find Holly?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Quest for Parry's Long Lost Love!  You earned $2500 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks so much for bringing me the letter from Holly. (Wanders away with the letter in his hand.)
quest_list.author: Pam

quest_list.notes: Deliver Stable to Holly
quest_list.success_message: You have delivered the Miniature Stable for Parry.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much. This is just what I needed. To know it came from Parry makes it so very, very special.

quest_list.notes: Holly asks you to deliver a letter to Parry
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I gave you the letter. Did you deliver it?
quest_list.success_message: You have been given a letter to deliver to Parry and $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I so appreciate you delivering the letter for me.

quest_list.notes: Kilye gives you the Embroidered Saddle Pad
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to deliver a saddle pad to Goodwin for Kilye.  You were given an Embroidered Saddle Pad and $750.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  And here is something for your boat fare.

quest_list.notes: Goodwin gets the saddle pad
quest_list.title: Kilye's Embroidered Saddle Pad
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't lose it, did you?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Kilye's Embroidered Saddle Pad!  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, thank you!  I've been waiting to see this!  I heard she did very good custom work.  Thank you for bringing it here.  Please accept this for your effort.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: get a bridle from Kilye
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked by Kilye to take a bridle to Ward Anvil.  You were given a Turkmen Silver Bridle and $1500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I knew I could count on you!  Here, take this and some money for travel and expenses.

quest_list.notes: Give the bridle to Kilye to alter
quest_list.success_message: You gave the bridle back to Kilye so that she could resize it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She chuckles.) Oh, those Tekes and their fine muzzles. Hmm... I'll need to move some of these silver pieces. Could you come back in a while so I can work on this?

quest_list.notes: Get resized bridle from Kilye
quest_list.success_message: Kilye gives you the resized bridle, and $1500 for traveling expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here it is!  Now it should fit perfectly!  Please bring it back to Ward for me, with my complements.  Here are travelling expenses and... the bridle.

quest_list.notes: Ward takes the unaltered bridle...
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What?  Don't you have it?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ward Anvil the Turkmen Silver Bridle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh! Well. Let me see that. (He takes the bridle and examines it with a craftsman's critical eye.) Fine work. Let me check it on my ol' mare Kyra. Wait here a sec.

quest_list.notes: Ward gets his finished bridle
quest_list.title: Kilye's Teke Bridle
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Kilye's Teke Bridle.  You earned $3000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Kilye's already been paid, but here's something for you.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Ward gives you the bridle with marks where it needs to be altered.
quest_list.success_message: Ward gives you the Turkmen bridle and $1500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fine.  Here's the bridle, and travel expenses.  Keep what's left over.  Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Action for Holly to go to chatpoint
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much!

quest_list.notes: Set future chatpoint for Kilye
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  I'm glad he's happy with it.  Thanks for all your help!

quest_list.notes: Agree to get 15 ebony logs for xamba
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked to find 15 Logs of Ebony Wood for Xamba.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  Wonderful!  Be back soon!  Must finish this soon!

quest_list.notes: Give 15 logs of Ebony Wood to xamba
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have 15?  Go!  Faster!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba 15 Logs of Ebony Wood.  You were given $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect!  Wonderful!  Now, to the instrument making I go.

quest_list.notes: Dolly sends you to the pottery
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get some hand-made mugs from Genevieve and bring them back to Dolly.  You were given $1000 to pay for them.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, do you?  You are a gem!  Here, let me give you some money for travel, and I'll send a message ahead so Genevieve will know what I need.  Thank you -so- much!

quest_list.notes: Dolly gets her new mugs.
quest_list.title: Dolly's Handmade Mugs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the mugs yet?  Be sure to get them from Genevieve.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dolly's Handmade Mugs!  You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Dolly pulls out one of the mugs and carefully unwraps it, and holds it up, turning it in her hands.) Oh! Oh, thank you so much, these are just, just perfect! Wonderful! You're a gem! Here, please take this with my gratitude and complements.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Genevieve gives you mugs for Dolly.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but it appears you don't have that much, sad to say.
quest_list.success_message: Genevieve gave you a package containing six hand-thrown mugs for Dolly.  You were given six Handmade Mugs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are, all safely wrapped.  Now please, ride your smoothest horse!  I don't want these being jostled, even though I wrapped them well!

quest_list.notes: Minnie asks for walnuts and acorns.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Would you like a loaf of nut bread?  Give me ten walnuts and ten acorns, and I'll make you one straight away, then you can sell it to Pablo!
quest_list.success_message: Minnie Biscuits will make you her famous Nut Bread if you bring her 10 Acorns and 10 Walnuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Would you like a loaf of nut bread?  Give me ten walnuts and ten acorns, and I'll make you one straight away, then you can sell it to Pablo!

quest_list.notes: Give Minnie 10 acorns and 10 Walnuts so she can make Bricks... uh, Bread.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, sorry, love, you don't have as many as I need here.  Come back again when you've got the lot.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a loaf of Minnie's Nut Bread.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, love.  A nice fresh loaf of nut bread.  Careful now, it's hot.

quest_list.notes: Give Pablo Walnut-Acorn Bread Bricks
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But you have no nut bread!  What do you think you're doing, telling me you have nut bread when you have none?!
quest_list.success_message: Pablo paid you $500 for a loaf of Minnie's Nut Bread.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah!  Beautiful!

quest_list.notes: Agree to bring oboe to Anika
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Xamba's oboe to Anika.  You were given a Handmade Oboe and $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect!  There.  All done.  All completed.  Here.  Take this to Anika in Crystalton.  She still needs to pay me, so bring that back.  Thank you.  Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Give oboe to Anika
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had the oboe for me.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Anika the Handmade Oboe.  You were given $11,000 for Xamba.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  I've been wondering when he was going to get this delivered.  Oh, it's beautiful.  Here's the money to pay for his bill.  Be sure to bring this back to him.  I don't want him to think I don't pay.

quest_list.notes: Give Xamba the money for Anika's bill
quest_list.title: Xamba's Wooden Instrument
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have $10,000.  You spent her money?  Awful, awful.  Don't come back until you can pay her bill.  Go go.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Xamba's Wooden Instrument.  You earned $3000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ten thousand dollars.  Wonderful!  Perfect.  Thanks!  Here's a bit of a reward.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Caelin Bets you $1000 that you can't answer her questions
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have the $1000 for this challenge.  Come back when you do, please!
quest_list.success_message: You have given Caelin $1000 to take her challenge.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  Okay, are you ready for my questions?

quest_list.notes: Caelin Congratulates you for winning her challenge
quest_list.title: Caelin's Horse Breed Challenge
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this! (bug)
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Caelin's Horse Breed Challenge! You earned $10,000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow!  You got all 10 of my questions right!  You are smart!  Here, take this $10,000 reward.
quest_list.author: Miranda/Rosela

quest_list.notes: The King of Hotzeplotz, Part 1: go search for metals.
quest_list.success_message: Grey Slate wants you to bring him 10 Gold Ores and 20 Silver Ores.  You were given $100.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay.  Now, the first things I need are 10 pieces of gold ore and 20 pieces of silver ore. Here's a little something towards boat fare.

quest_list.notes: Give Grey Slate his ores, sends you for 5 diamonds and 24 small gems.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aw, come on!  I thought I could rely on you!  You don't have what you said you'd get!
quest_list.success_message: You gave 10 gold ores and 20 silver ores to Grey Slate.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent, thank you!  These blended together make Electrum.  King Phil wants his crown to be Electrum.  Now, I need 5 diamonds and 24 small gems.

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate sends you for gems.
quest_list.success_message: Grey Slate wants 5 Diamonds and 24 Small Gems.  You were given $150.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And remember!  Not a word to anybody!  And don't go buying diamonds, it looks suspicious!

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate sends you for peacock feathers.  He doesn't argue taste with King Phil.
quest_list.success_message: Grey Slate asked you to find 10 peacock feathers, and gave you some money for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There we go.  Now.  I need 10 peacock feathers.  He says he wants flaps, because his ears get cold!

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate takes feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aw, really!  Ten peacock feathers!  Is that hard?  No, of course not!  Come on, give it a try!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Grey Slate 10 Peacock Feathers, and he gave you $500 toward new shoes for your horse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks.  This is just what I need.

quest_list.notes: King Phil's Scepter sends you to Hotzeplotz!
quest_list.success_message: You have been transported to Phil the First's Island Kingdom of Hotzeplotz in the Unknown Isles!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Following Grey Slate's instructions, you wave King Phil's scepter... and suddenly, here you are!

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate's Penultimate Request
quest_list.success_message: Grey Slate wants you to bring him a piece of Royal Blue Cloth.  You were given $100.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: One last thing I need.  A piece of royal blue cloth.  Got it from a lady, Kilye, in Tropicton last time I needed it.

quest_list.notes: King Phil gets his crown!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What's this?  Where are my crown and scepter?!  To Prison Isle I should send you!
quest_list.success_message: King Phil I of Hotzeplotz gives you a Thick, Sealed Envelope.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  I will take both the crown and the scepter now.  Here is Sir Slate's payment.

quest_list.notes: King Phil sends you back to Sir Slate
quest_list.success_message: **POOF!**  You find yourself back in Grey Slate's rock shop.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Goodbye to you!  Tell my brother I like his work!

quest_list.notes: King Phil's Payment.
quest_list.title: Grey Slate's Gaudy Crown
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't my rotten brother Phil pay you?!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Grey Slate's Gaudy Crown!  You've earned $50,000 and 350 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Finally! What have you got? (You hand over the envelope, and Grey Slate eagerly tears it open.) What did I tell you! I knew he'd come through! Look at all this! Here you go! $50,000 for you, and $50,000 for me! Yeah!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Kilye gives instructions for making a blue cloth
quest_list.success_message: Kilye has asked you to get a Piece of Cloth and 15 Blueberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: In order to make this, I will need a piece of cloth and 15 blueberries.  You must also pay me $200 for my work.

quest_list.notes: Kilye makes you a royal blue cloth.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you don't have what I need.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a piece of richly dyed, Royal Blue Cloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  Thank you for your business.  Please come see me again.

quest_list.notes: Give Grey Slate his blue cloth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aww, come on!  Didn't you get that cloth from Kilye, like I asked ya?  Hurry up, already!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Grey Slate the Royal Blue Cloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooo!  Beee-yoo-tiful!  Just what I need.  I'll just set it into place like this, aaaannnnnnd.... voila!

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate Gets His Gems
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hey, what's this?  You were supposed to get me 5 diamonds and 24 small gems!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Grey Slate 5 Diamonds and 24 Small Gems, and were asked to go get 10 Peacock Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are nice!  You picked good ones, you did!    Now for the peacock feathers.  I need ten.  Says his ears get cold, so I need to make little muffs out of them.

quest_list.notes: Barnacle Ben gives dirty jolly rogers to be fixed and cleaned.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a pile of dirty, torn and extremely smelly jolly rogers to be washed and mended.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Grabs torn and dirty jolly rogers.) Here ye be, matey. Arrr, go and get these cleaned and repaired. Someone said thar was a place that did that--try on Turtle Isle. I be scraping barnacles now.

quest_list.notes: give Barnacle Ben back the jolly rogers
quest_list.title: Barnacle Ben's Home Improvement
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arrr, those aren't what me needs - better take them back t' be redone.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Barnacle Ben's Home Improvement. You earned a Diamond, a Topaz Necklace and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arrr, thanks so much - now me can work on the rest o' this place. Gar.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: gives Eliza dirty jolly rogers in exchange for washed ones
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have anything that needs cleaning right now.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a pile of washed and cleaned jolly rogers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Not a problem at all to get these cleaned up. Here you go, dear.

quest_list.notes: Accept the Quest 8 Wonders of the Horse Isles
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to search for the sketches of the 8 wonders of the Horse Isles. You have been given $5000 to cover your expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Clue 1: Mammal-shaped island. Parts numbered as 3. Two are same in shape and size. In the center of town, a botanical specimen associated with sadness grows. Find a clue as to who holds the sketch of this most magnificent species.

quest_list.notes: give cleaned jolly rogers to Barb Sower to mend
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Maybe you had better take those back to Eliza for more cleaning.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Pile of Repaired and Cleaned Jolly Rogers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, sure I can. Just a moment. (You read a magazine while waiting.) Here you go - all ready to be taken back to Barnacle Ben.

quest_list.notes: King Phil's Ferrets Steal Your (His) Treasure!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What are you, some kind of joker?!  Where's my money?  You thief!  I expect that paid back to me at once!
quest_list.success_message: King Phil takes back his necklace and cash, and sends you to *Prison Isle!*
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Trying to steal my treasure and my money from my own island!  Leave my land at once!  Never darken my shores again!

quest_list.notes: King Phil's Ferrets Substitute the real necklace with paste!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well.  We'll see about that.
quest_list.success_message: You feel a slight jostling behind you... but there is nothing there.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well.  If you say so, then...

quest_list.notes: The Treasure of Hotzeplotz
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing in your haste to get to King Phil.  Maybe later, when you have more time...
quest_list.success_message: You found a small box with a magnificent Pearl Necklace of perfectly matching pearls and $5,000 inside!

quest_list.notes: sell hay and coconuts to Donna Alligheri
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, sorry, there isn't enough.  And remember, I need you to bring both the hay and the coconuts!  Twenty-five of each!
quest_list.success_message: You sold 25 Coconuts and 25 Hay Bales for $3,750.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much!  This is wonderful!  Please bring more!  Honestly, these ponies eat more than horses, I think!

quest_list.notes: King Phil Makes You A Knight, Already!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hey!  Who are you trying to kid?!  That's not my necklace!  Get outta' here!
quest_list.success_message: Congratulations, Sir Whatsyaname, Knight of Hotzeplotz!  Grey Slate can send you back here whenever you wish.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A-ha!  I knew it when I saw you!  You, gentle Errant, are a person of Honesty, and Integrity!  And because you have passed my test, you may keep the treasure!  And furthermore, I dub you Sir... Whatsyaname... Knight of the Realm of Hotzeplotz!

quest_list.notes: starting Barnacle Ben's Decorating Quest
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to go to Art Isle for Barnacle Ben and check for art to buy. You were given $1500 for boat fare.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, that seems reasonable - har you go.

quest_list.notes: Buying art from Pablo for Barnacle Ben
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I need.  Perhaps you should go and find them.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Several Pieces of Art in exchange for 2 Rubies and a Pearl.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. Tell Barnacle Ben thanks for the purchase.

quest_list.notes: King Phil's Scepter sends you to Hotzeplotz! (regular return)
quest_list.success_message: You have been transported to Phil the First's Island Kingdom of Hotzeplotz in the Unknown Isles!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You grab the end of the scepter, and suddenly feel as if you are being swept off your feet, into a fog...

quest_list.notes: Deliver art to Barncacle Ben from Pable on Art Isle
quest_list.title: Barnacle Ben's Decorating Quest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ahoy, you don't have anythin' me can decorate with - perhaps you should go and find somethin'.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, those look perfect - thanks so much for goin' t' get them.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Agrees to do Barnacle Ben's Decorating Quest - no travel money
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go to Art Isle to find Barnacle Ben something to decorate his home with.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, great. Better get goin', then.

quest_list.notes: Find Wonder Number One
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Congratulations! You found the First Wonder of the Horse Isles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You will find the sketch with Tucker here on Hare Island.

quest_list.notes: Tucker gives you the Sketch for Wonder #1
quest_list.success_message: You were given a sketch and your next clue for Wonder #2.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The climate changes constantly here and is reflected in a plethora of shades. A number of globular patterns make up the location. Although the majority of this species flourishes here, one has lived its life fully and now withers away. Find the withering

quest_list.notes: Find Wonder #2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Searching for details, you find a clue! Posy holds the sketch for which you search.

quest_list.notes: Donna Hayes asks you to get supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It really takes a load off my mind knowing that I've got a new supplier!  And please remember--I need both the hay and the coconuts delivered together, because my helpers don't like to set up the hay-lifters too many times.  Come back soon!
quest_list.success_message: Donna Hayes has asked you to bring 25 Bales of Hay and 25 Coconuts for her ponies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It really takes a load off my mind knowing that I've got a new supplier!  And please remember--I need both the hay and the coconuts delivered together, because my helpers don't like to set up the hay-lifters too many times.  Come back soon!

quest_list.notes: Give the Star of Solomon to Opal.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Waaaaaaaiiit just a minute--you said you had it!  Now go get it, right this minute!
quest_list.success_message: You give the Star of Solomon to Opal.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's it!  You got it!  Oh, I cannot thank you enough!

quest_list.notes: King Phil sends you back to Sir Slate (Normal Return)
quest_list.success_message: **POOF!**  You find yourself back in Grey Slate's rock shop.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Goodbye!

quest_list.notes: Kilye makes you a royal blue cloth. (already completed her quests)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you don't have what I need.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a piece of richly dyed, Royal Blue Cloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  Thank you for your business.  Please come see me again.

quest_list.notes: King Phil sends trespassers to prison
quest_list.success_message: **POOF**  You find yourself suddenly on Prison Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Off to prison with you!

quest_list.notes: Old Horse Rejects your offer of a treat.
quest_list.success_message: Your offer of a treat has been refused.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The old horse shakes its head, and goes back to nibbling grass, utterly ignoring you.

quest_list.notes: OId Ellie accepts your offer of a carrot.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (The old horse shakes her head, and after searching your pockets, will have nothing further to do with you.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave Old Ellie a Carrot.  You were given a Wishing Coin!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Old Ellie accepts your treat, and, munching happily, paws the ground. When you look down, you notice a Wishing Coin.)

quest_list.notes: Old Dude accepts your offer of an apple.

quest_list.notes: Haven Isle Shipwreck?  A Possibility!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search carefully, but all you see are seabirds and a frighteningly high sea.
quest_list.success_message: What is this? Looking carefully, you can see several curved wooden planks, and... an old life preserver!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Was there a shipwreck here? With this sea and these rocks, there certainly could have been! Better go tell Ruthie!

quest_list.notes: Haven Isle--Find the Planks.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You found some sturdy Wooden Planks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Using your shovel as a lever, you manage to free some long, oaken planks from the rocks.  These would be great for fencing!

quest_list.notes: Haven Isle--Find Bucket and Rope
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found a wooden pail and a coil of rope.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Using your rake to help you reach into a crevasse, you manage to snag a sturdy wooden bucket, inside of which is a long coil of rope.

quest_list.notes: Haven Isle--Find Chest of Doubloons
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You found a box of golden doubloons.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Digging around, you come across a small box--inside of which are 42 golden doubloons!

quest_list.notes: Give Ruthie the planks
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had wooden planks?
quest_list.success_message: You gave the wooden planks to Ruthie, and she gave you $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  These will be good for the shed I'm having built.

quest_list.notes: Give Ruthie the bucket and rope
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had a bucket and some rope?
quest_list.success_message: You gave the bucket and rope to Ruthie, and she gave you $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  You can never have too many buckets in a stable, and rope is always useful!

quest_list.notes: Give Ruthie the doubloons
quest_list.title: Ruthie's Doubloons
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had doubloons.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ruthie's Doubloons!  You earned $4000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Doubloons?  Real doubloons?!  Wonderful!  These belong in a museum!  I spent almost everything I had on buying this place, and selling these will get me money to run it.  Please take these as a small reward for your work.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Ruthie gives you apples and daisies.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oops.  Sorry, thought I had some.
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie gives you an apple and a bunch of daisies for her horses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay.  First, there's Dude.  Dude is big and brown with a star and snip on his face.  He likes apples.  Kate is dun and has a star but no snip, and she likes daisies.  Here, let me give them to you.

quest_list.notes: Ruthie gives you carrots and wildflowers.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oops.  Sorry, thought I had some.
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie gives you a carrot and a bunch of wildflowers for her horses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ellie is a chestnut, very red, with a big blaze and three white stockings.  She likes carrots best.  And Decaf is a big, chocolate boy, steady as a rock with a big blaze and a mark like a shamrock.  He likes wildflowers.  Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Ruthie tells you to go look for usable stuff
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't you find anything?  Please look again!
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie instructs you to go search for salvage.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, absolutely, please do!  And... I know it sounds crass to say this, but if you find anything in the wreckage that could be used on the farm, even ropes or planks of wood, please bring that, too!

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Halien's mancala board
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked to find Halian's mancala board.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  I lost it near an ancient stone statue northwest of here.  Maybe you will see something I didn't.

quest_list.notes: By Boat To Half Haven
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, you've not got enough money to make that crossing worthwhile.
quest_list.success_message: Seamus Schooner agrees to take you to the island of Half Haven.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right.  Get ye on board, and let's be going before the seas get any worse.

quest_list.notes: Ruthie asks you to take treats to her horses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Take them some treats to start.  Now, they all like different things, and don't offer them what they don't like--they're very old and kind of crotchety.

quest_list.notes: Ruthie asks for Lucky Hay
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie will buy Lucky Hay from you for $1250 per bale.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, and before you go, one last thing.  If you ever find yourself in possession of any Lucky Hay you'd like to sell, I'd love to buy it from you.

quest_list.notes: Ruthie buys Lucky Horse Hay
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, dear; it seems you haven't got any more.  Well, next time you drop by.
quest_list.success_message: You sold Ruthie a bale of Lucky Horse Hay for $1250.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  My old friends thrive on this!  Thank you so much.

quest_list.notes: Ruthie's Horses Are All Good.
quest_list.title: Ruthie's Retirees
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ruthie's Retirees.  You earned $1000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I was sure they would be.  But it's very reassuring to have someone go over there and check.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Offered to pick up carrots for the Easter Bunny.
quest_list.success_message: The Easter Bunny asked you to get her 7 Carrots.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Marvelous! Barefoot is always better anyway. (Wink.) Just grab 7 carrots and I should be good for another week.

quest_list.notes: Gave carrots to Easter Bunny.
quest_list.title: Supplies for the Easter Bunny
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have enough. Try the carrot garden up in town.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Supplies for the Easter Bunny! You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fantabulicious! I really appreciate your help. Take this with my gratitude.
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Find Halian's broken mancala board
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking away the grass, you see something man-made hiding in the weeds.  You pick it up and notice it's broken.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Broken Mancala Board.

quest_list.notes: Tell Halian about the broken Mancala board
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you found that board?  Better go start searching.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Broken Mancala Board to Halian.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, no!  That is just dreadful.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Halian's Mancala board fixed
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring the Broken Mancala Board to Xamba to be fixed.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect!  Xamba is located on the farthest west isle that is connected to the main Jungle Isle by two isthmuses and another that connects to a smaller chunk of land.  I'm sure you will find him without a problem.

quest_list.notes: Offer to have baby crib made for Magnolia
quest_list.success_message: Magnolia asked you to see Rebecca about getting a crib made. You were given $4000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much! Here's a little money to help with whatever Rebecca might need.

quest_list.notes: Give Xamba the broken board.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said you had the board.  Go get it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba the Broken Mancala Board and have been asked to gather 5 logs of Ebony Wood.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmm...  Not an instrument, but yes, I have made this.  Fix it?  Oh, sorry, beyond repair.  However!  I will make a new one.  Yes, yes.  That will do perfectly.  You must get me 5 logs of ebony wood.

quest_list.notes: Give finished crib to Magnolia
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see it. Are you sure you got it from Rebecca?
quest_list.success_message: You have given the finished crib to Magnolia. You have earned $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Look at all the little engraved flowers! This is perfect; Rebecca has really outdone herself! Please take this as a small reward.

quest_list.notes: Give Xamba 5 ebony logs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not enough.  Nope nope.  Five.  I need five ebony wood logs.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba 5 logs of Ebony Wood.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, yes, perfect.  This will do.  I get to work now.  Oh.  Work costs $1000.  Have that upon return.

quest_list.notes: Xamba gives you finished mancala board
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not enough money?  I need $1000.  Come back when you have enough.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Mancala Board for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Beautiful work if I do say so.  Yes, beautiful.

quest_list.notes: Give completed mancala board to Halian
quest_list.title: Halian's Mancala Board
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had the finished mancala board?  You had better go see Xamba.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Halian's Mancala Board!  You earned $9000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, wow!  He did a marvelous job!  Thank you very much.  Here's a little something to hopefully cover Xamba's bill as well as your time.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Rebecca asks you to get 15 logs and 5 branches for a crib.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great. Remember to check forests further away if you can't find any around here.

quest_list.notes: Give Rebecca 15 logs and 5 branches for baby crib
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have all the pieces there. I need 15 logs and 5 strong, skinny branches.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rebecca 15 Logs and 5 Strong, Skinny Branches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! I'll get to work right away. The flower engravings she wants are going to take a while, so come back later. I'll also need $3000 in payment.

quest_list.notes: Rebecca gives you a finished crib for $3000
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oops, looks like you don't have enough. You'd better go and earn some more.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Baby Crib for $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is the crib. I hope Magnolia and her baby enjoy it.

quest_list.notes: Posy gives you the sketch
quest_list.success_message: You were given the 2nd sketch and the clue to Wonder #3!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Blustery weather is prominent here. Despite the bitter temperatures, this wonder flows freely. It provides a necessary element to weary, dehydrated travelers. Retrieving this clue will require you be both cunning and patient.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much! Here's a little more traveling money.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this blanket is beautiful! It's all just perfect. Thank you for going to so much trouble to help us out! Please take this as a token of my appreciation.

quest_list.notes: Opal tells you she'll set the broken case in the sun for you to examine.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why ever would you want to do that?  Well, sure you can, if you want to.  Let me put it outside in the sunlight, and you can examine it out there where you can see better.

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Broken Display Case
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You have discovered a clue!  Better make a note of it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looking carefully at the forced lock, you see that it was pried open with a screwdriver or knife with a ding or notch in its edge.

quest_list.notes: Alati asks you to have three porcelain rings made.
quest_list.success_message: Alati asked you to visit Genevieve for three porcelain rings. You were given $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She lives on Art Isle. Here's a bit of money for traveling. Just tell Genevieve the rings need to be about the size of an apple.

quest_list.notes: Give three porcelain rings to Alati
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have them. You need to go talk to Genevieve on Art Isle.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Three Porcelain Rings to Alati.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Those will do just fine. Now give me some time to put this all together, and we'll see if it works!

quest_list.notes: Alati gives you a reward for helping him out.
quest_list.title: Alati's Invention
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Alati's Invention!  You earned $10,000, 25 Gold Ore and 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, I want you to have these. Please take them with my gratitude. You've given me confidence in myself again! And now, I must get my quicksand shoes to work properly!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Rocco begins work on Alati's stones.
quest_list.success_message: You have placed Alati's order for the stones.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fine, then. I should have all the supplies I need, why don't you take a walk and come back in a little while, and I'll have them done.

quest_list.notes: Rocco gives you the stones to take to Alati
quest_list.success_message: You have received Two Round Stones for Alati's invention.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here they are. Get those back to him quickly, now.

quest_list.notes: Genevieve tells you to talk to Kiah to find clay
quest_list.success_message: Genevieve asks you to find 6 lumps of Red Jamuti Clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Go and speak to Kiah of Rainy Meadows. She is kindred spirits with the jungle. She's always able to tell me where to find clay. Bring me back 6 lumps of the red jamuti clay, and I'll make the rings.

quest_list.notes: You give Genevieve clay for Alati's rings
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have enough. Go back to Kiah in Rainy Meadows and ask her where to find more. I need 6 pieces all together.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Genevieve 6 lumps of Red Jamuti Clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see it... Yes, this is the stuff! Really good quality, too. Good job! All right, give me some time to make these. I'll also require $3000 in payment.

quest_list.notes: Genevieve gives you three porcelain rings for Alati's invention.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have enough. You had better go and earn some more.
quest_list.success_message: You were given three Porcelain Rings for $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you. Here are the rings for Alati. Please thank him for his business for me!

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Small, Dark Man
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, dear, I hope she's still there.
quest_list.success_message: Opal Sandstone gives you another clue, and sends you to find the great Ms. Mabel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, right around that time, there was a strange man in town.  Small, dark man with a high, womanish voice.  Wore a horrid old brown jacket.  Came by 'ere trying to sell me a donkey.  Big glasses, beard.  Never saw him again.

quest_list.notes: Miss Mabel Examines The First Clue
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Do you mean to tell me you have lost this clue?  Please go and find it at once.  I cannot overemphasize its importance.
quest_list.success_message: You show the piece of torn cloth to Ms. Mabel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is what was left behind on the window, you say? (She turns over the cloth and examines it very carefully, then hands it back to you.) No, I don’t think this is a jacket. This is a twill; saddlepad material.

quest_list.notes: The Treasure of the Solomons, Uncovered! (tracking only)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: The treasure!  The treasure of the Solomon Family!  Buried these long centuries!  Thar it be!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The treasure!  The treasure of the Solomon Family!  Buried these long centuries!  Thar it be!

quest_list.notes: Opal Gives You The Torn Piece of Cloth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I believe I already gave you the cloth.
quest_list.success_message: Opal gives you a small piece of torn, greenish cloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I did indeed. I looked everywhere; on the case, on the floor, and on the window they broke in through. All I ever found was this. (Opal shows you a small, torn piece of heavy green cloth.) Stuck on the broken window it was, must 'ave tore off.

quest_list.notes: Miss Mabel Examines The First Clue
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Do you mean to tell me you have lost this clue?  Please go and find it at once.  I cannot overemphasize its importance.
quest_list.success_message: You give the piece of torn cloth to Miss Mabel to examine.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is what was left behind on the window? (She turns over the cloth and examines it very carefully). No, I don’t think this is a jacket. This is more like a canvas or twill; the kind of cloth used to make saddle pads, or sailcloth, I should th

quest_list.notes: Give Mrs Claus Dasher and Dancer's Harnesses
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You already gave me those.  Did you have the others, still?
quest_list.success_message: You give Mrs. Claus the first two reindeer harnesses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these will look lovely on Dasher and Dancer. Now for Prancer's and Vixen's harnesses?

quest_list.notes: Miss Mabel Sends You Out For More Clues.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, dear...
quest_list.success_message: Ms. Mabel sends you out looking for more clues!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Interviewing witnesses will be a very satisfactory beginning.  Now.  It's been my experience that in a case like this, six additional clues are needed.  Do come back and tell me what you learn, won't you?

quest_list.notes: Rocco's gives design plans for new sign
quest_list.success_message: You were given a set of design plans for Rocco's new sign to take to Smiddy Jones. You were given $1000 for travel costs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Thanks so much for helping me out.

quest_list.notes: Give Rocco's design plans to Smiddy Jones
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have any plans - perhaps you better go and see Rocco again.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the copy of Rocco's design plans to Smiddy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Working on something new, is he? Well, let's see what it is.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get items Smiddy Jones needs to work on Rocco's sign.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Smiddy Jones get 50 Agates and 50 Pieces of Iron Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sounds like the makin' of a plan. Once ya got the items, just bring 'em on back so I can get started.

quest_list.notes: Give Smiddy Jones the agate and ore for Rocco's sign
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the items yet. Better get movin' on it while the sun is still up.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Smiddy Jones 50 Agates and 50 Pieces of Iron Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great.  Now I can get to work on this, but I need one more thing.

quest_list.notes: Complete Water Math for Clara
quest_list.title: Clara's Water Problem
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this for Clara.
quest_list.success_message: Aha!  That's it!  Thank you so much!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You Completed Clara's Water Problem!  You earned $5000 and 25 quest points.

quest_list.notes: take Rocco's sign plans to Xamba at Smiddy's request.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I reckon I will find someone else, then.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to take the design plans to Xamba for Smiddy Jones.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay.  See ya back when Xamba is done with the frame and post.  Oh, and remember, he lives on the very western part of Jungle Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give wood frame and post to Smiddy Jones and get completed sign
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I think he forgot to to give them to you. Reckon you better head on over to Xamba's and pick them up.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a new Wood and Metal Rock Store Sign to take back to Rocco Shale on Rock Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great. Now I will just put them all together and voila! Here is Rocco's new sign.

quest_list.notes: Agree to find ebony wood for Xamba
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No plans?  I can't work without plans.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 10 logs of Ebony Wood for Xamba.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good. Great. You bring back to me the wood.

quest_list.notes: Get completed wood frame and post from Xamba
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That is not what was asked for. No, it was not. You go. You try again.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a completed Ebony Wood Frame and Post to take back to Smiddy Jones.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great.  Perfect.  Some hard work.  Aha!  A beautiful frame and post.  Here!  Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Give Rocco Shale back his completed new rock shop sign.
quest_list.title: Rocco Shale's New Rock Shop Sign
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see that you have it.  Perhaps you better head back and see if you left it there.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Rocco Shale's New Rock Shop Sign.  You earned 2 Diamonds, $3000 and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is perfect. Thanks for all your help.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Help Livia do the frog puzzle
quest_list.title: Livia's Frogs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this puzzle.
quest_list.success_message: That's it!  Great!  Thanks!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You Completed Livia's Frogs.  You earned $5000 and 25 quest points.

quest_list.notes: Help Integra change the guards
quest_list.title: Integra's Puzzle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this puzzle.
quest_list.success_message: That's it!  Great!  Thanks!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You Completed Integra's Puzzle.  You earned $5000 and 25 quest points.

quest_list.notes: Caren Hart sends you to Nizhoni and Sakyo's.
quest_list.success_message: You are transported to Spirit Horse Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Nizhoni sends you to find Sahkyo
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Good boy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Nizhoni gestures toward the door, and you get up and go outside to look for Sahkyo.)

quest_list.notes: Track Humpty Dumpty
Nizhoni sends you in search of calumet material.
quest_list.success_message: Nizhoni sends you back to Dr. Hart's office.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Walk the paths until you find what you need. When you have found what you must, return to me.

quest_list.notes: Help Integra arrange the stars
quest_list.title: Materia's Stars
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this puzzle.
quest_list.success_message: That's it!  Great!  Thanks!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You Completed Materia's Stars.  You earned $5000 and 25 quest points.

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Jacket Pockets
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Please, I'm very busy right now, I have to get back to work.
quest_list.success_message: You have the Clue of the Jacket Pockets!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I remember it because of the enormous amount of old papers this lady took out of her old pockets, and put into her new ones!  Maps, charts, old scribbled notes, everything very old.  Nothing new.

quest_list.notes: The Clue Of The Dogs In The Night-Time.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh. Well, sorry, that's all I know.
quest_list.success_message: You have the Clue of the Dogs in the Night-Time!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, but this was before the theft, you see. Not afterwards, no.

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Odd Shoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But we already went over this, surely.
quest_list.success_message: You have the Clue of the Oddly-Made Horseshoes!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It's hard to say, really.  Mule-shaped feet, but... nothing like our farrier makes.  I told him about them; he might remember better, if you think they're important.

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Odd Shoes, Part II
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I've told you all I'm gonna.  Now leave me be.
quest_list.success_message: You have the Clue of the Uneven Wear!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: They were narrow.  Mule-shoe, like.  But smaller'n a mule foot, normally.  And crudely made.  I don't do shoddy work like that.  Nor does any farrier I know.

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Silver Blaze
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't we already have this conversation?
quest_list.success_message: You have the Clue of the Silver Blaze!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes!  I mean, there wasn't a lot of light, there was a half moon only.  But this was such a loud appy!  Looked like it had a white lace blanket and a silver blaze!

quest_list.notes: Santa asks you to get string of flashing christmas lights made for Mrs. Claus
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go ask Aura Hayward to make a string of flashing Christmas lights for Santa Claus.  You were given $2000 to pay for it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ho, ho, ho - You're gonna make the nice list this year. Thank you for getting this for me. I just know Mrs. Claus is going to love it. Don't forget you will need 15 rubies and 15 emeralds to have it made.

quest_list.notes: Ask Aura Hayward to make Mrs. Claus a string of flashing lights.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I need to make this.  Once you have everything, please come back and I will get right to work.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a String of Christmas Lights to take back to Santa Claus.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, perfect. Why don't you rest your horses while I get to work on this? (Aura hurries into the workroom and starts working. You and your horses rest awhile.) Here you go. I hope Mrs. Claus loves it.

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Blue-Green Dye
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Nope, can't remember.
quest_list.success_message: You have the Clue of the Blue-Green Dye!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes.  I recognize the twill.  I made some very fine ships' blankets from this, some years ago.

quest_list.notes: Discussed: The dogs in the night-time.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't like to repeat myself.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh... yes.  Yes, that is certainly a possibility.  If a thief had some kind of a pet whom he knew would cause a disturbance...  well, then...

quest_list.notes: Take string of flashing lights back to Santa
quest_list.title: Santa's Anniversary Gift
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have left it in Wington. Could you please hurry back and get it?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Santa's Anniversary Quest! You earned $5000 and 75 quest points. Your horse was given a Horse Candy!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks so much! I just know the Missus will love this. Here's something for you and a little something for your horse.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Mingled Sands
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, wait... I just remembered something I have to do right now.  Talk to you soon!
quest_list.success_message: You've obtained the Clue of the Mingled Sands!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: His shoes had just been pulled.  And judging by where the nails were, the shoes were never meant to fit this zebra.  And when I cleaned out his frog and all that, I found sand--but, all different types of sand--and some ice!

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Jacket is discussed (tracking only).
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: We've already gone over this, haven't we?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: We have already noted that the one person identified as a possible suspect was dressed very noticeably.  People might be on the lookout for the old jacket.

quest_list.notes: Anani tells you a sheep swam to an island north-ish from hers.
quest_list.success_message: Anani informs you one of the Golden Sheep may be on an island near hers.

quest_list.notes: Discussed: The Oddly Shaped Shoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Please, let's not go over this again.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes.  That certainly indicates an inexperienced, or possibly simply inept, smithy.  I know of no such person on these islands.

quest_list.notes: Discussed: The Uneven Wear
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: This is all, you know, getting rather tiresome for me.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Because whoever shoed the horse subsequently--that is, assuming anyone did--would certainly have noticed the signs of damage when they trimmed the feet.

quest_list.notes: Discussed: The Mingled Sands
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Could you please come back another time?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Exactly!  Art Isle!  One gallop cross-country on Art Isle would lead you through coarse, brown beach sand, snow and ice, and fine, golden desert sand within a very short time.

quest_list.notes: Discussed: The Silver Blaze.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: My dear, we've gone over this.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She saw a moving animal in the dark. She may have believed she saw an Appaloosa because they are so much more common on these isles than Zebras, and we do have some very loud Patterned Leopards here.

quest_list.notes: Discussed: The Blue-Green Dye
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I may be entirely wrong here.  I need some time to think.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Unless it was used as a saddlepad afterward, or sewn into one, or...

quest_list.notes: Follow up the last clue.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And the fact that there was still ice, or just water, to be found shows that the trip from Art Isle was made in haste.

quest_list.notes: Candide hands out fruit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, it appears I have no more fruit to hand out.
quest_list.success_message: Candide gave you 3 Apples and 3 Oranges.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I hope you enjoy these!

quest_list.notes: Candide asks you to find his Golden Sheep.
quest_list.success_message: Candide has asked you to find his Golden Sheep. You were given $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have no idea what this means to me! Here, please take a little money for traveling. I imagine it will be quite difficult to find them all.

quest_list.notes: Rafiki hints that Galvin knows where a sheep is
quest_list.success_message: Rafiki hints that Galvin may know where a sheep is.

quest_list.notes: Galvin sends you to Deidra to make a peacock feather necklace for Nina.
quest_list.success_message: Galvin asked you to get a peacock feather necklace made from Deidra. You were given $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Here's a bit of money for travel expenses.

quest_list.notes: Galvin tells you one of the golden sheep is with Nina.
quest_list.success_message: Galvin informs you that one Golden Sheep is with Nina on Tail Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: In that case, I'll send a note on ahead to Nina explaining everything. Remember to come back, now!

quest_list.notes: You find a clue to a golden sheep on the road.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closely, you see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see some hoofprints on the road! Looks like whoever made them turned north, toward the beach.

quest_list.notes: Nina suggest searching the road outside for clues to the missing sheep.
quest_list.success_message: Nina suggested searching the road outside for clues.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, but the front door was open. You might look on the road outside for clues.

quest_list.notes: Ms Mabel Sends You In Search Of The Perp!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, dear.  Sorry, I seemed to have lost my train of thought.
quest_list.success_message: Ms. Mabel sends you off in search of further evidence!  Good luck!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I really think that's what you should do at this point.  And if I were you, I would go straight to the inn.  Always an excellent source of gossip. Good-bye, and good luck to you.

quest_list.notes: The Clue of the Crumpled Map
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No.  That's my souvenir of a very odd night.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's what I thought at first.  But look closely.

quest_list.notes: You find Nephele, the golden sheep, the first time.
quest_list.success_message: Nephele will not follow you home. Better return to Candide and let him know.

quest_list.notes: Candide asks you to make apple treats for his sheep.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Unfortunately, I don't. You might need to travel to Carrotton to make enough for all four sheep.
quest_list.success_message: Candide tells you to make 4 Apple Treats. You were given 12 Apples to get you started.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, unfortunately I'm all out. You'll have to travel to Carrotton to make more. I can give you all the apples I have left to help, but you may need to collect more. You better make four treats to have one ready for all four sheep.

quest_list.notes: Give apple treat to sheep Nephele
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (The sheep can't find anything in your hand. You must not have an apple treat with you.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave an Apple Treat to Nephele! It looks like she will follow you now.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The sheep happily snatches the treat and takes a step toward you.)

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Mrs Claus with anniversary gift
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Mrs. Claus get an anniversary gift for Santa - 8 reindeer harnesses. You have been given $1,000 for travel money.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much, dear. I just know Santa will love it.  Do tell Kilye I said hello, won't you?

quest_list.notes: Talk to Kilye to find out what she needs to make harnesses
quest_list.success_message: You were told by Kilye to go see Barb Sower in Shellton to have the harnesses made.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Mrs. Claus wants to have 8 reindeer harnesses made for Santa? That's sweet.  I can certainly dye them for you, but your best bet to get them made would be from Barb Sower in Shellton.  Once you have them all, just bring them back to me.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Barb Sower about making reindeer harnesses.
quest_list.success_message: You were told that Barb Sower will need 40 Pieces of Cotton and 40 Cattails to make the harnesses. You have agreed to come back when you get them.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Eight reindeer harnesses? Sure, I can do that. It's going to be a little bit difficult, though. I will need 5 cotton pieces and 5 cattails for each harness. I will need all 40 cotton pieces and 40 cattails at the same time. Can you do that?

quest_list.notes: Bring items back to Barb Sower for the reindeer harnesses
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You aren't quite there, yet. Remember, I need 40 each of cotton and cattails.
quest_list.success_message: You were given 8 Plain Reindeer Harnesses to take back to Kilye to be dyed.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's exactly what I need. Just have a seat while I get these made up. (Barb goes in the back room and you hear very busy sounds while you browse her shop.) Here you go - 8 reindeer harnesses. Be sure to take them back to Kilye.

quest_list.notes: Tell Kilye you have the plain reindeer harnesses
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the harnesses yet. Remember to go and see Barb Sower in Shellton to get them made.
quest_list.success_message: You were told by Kilye to bring back 10 Venetian Plant Food and one Reindeer Harness to make the first one.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now we can get started.  Let's make the first one for Dasher. I think he would look great in a bright, bold red harness. I will need 10 venetian food plants and a harness to make Dasher's. Just come back when you have them and I will get started.

quest_list.notes: Get red reindeer harness made
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't quite have what I need. Come back when you have the 10 pieces of venetian food and a plain harness.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the items for the red harness to Kylie. She told you she would need 10 Dandelions for the next one.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! I will get started on these if you will go and get what I need for Dancer's harness. Hmmm, with his coloring, I think a yellow harness would be best. I will need 10 dandelions and a plain harness to get started.

quest_list.notes: Get yellow harness made & pick up red harness.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have all 10 yet - better keep looking. Dandelions are best found in grassy places, if that helps.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Dasher's Red Harness and gave Kilye the Dandelions for Dancer's Harness. She also told you she needed 10 Blackberries for Prancer's Harness.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay.  Here is Dasher's harness. I will get started on Dancer's now if you want to go and get what I need for Prancer's harness. I was thinking purple for him, so I will need 10 blackberries and the harness.

quest_list.notes: Get purple harness made & pick up yellow harness
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have quite 10 blackberries yet. Perhaps you should keep looking for some.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kilye the 10 Blackberries to start Prancer's Harness and picked up Dancer's Yellow Harness. You were told to bring 10 Blueberries back so that Kilye can dye Vixen's harness next.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, here's Dancer's yellow harness. I will get started on Prancer's purple one now.  I am going to do Vixen's next and hers will be a beautiful blue.  I will need 10 blueberries and a harness for hers.

quest_list.notes: Get blue harness made and pick up purple harness
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 10 blueberries. Perhaps you ate a couple? You will need to get a few more.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Prancer's Purple Harness and gave Kilye the Blueberries for Vixen's Harness. Kilye has asked you to bring back 10 4 Leaf Clovers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is Prancer's purple harness.  I will get started on Vixen's now and you can get the items I will need for Comet's harness.  A shimmering green would look best on him, so how about bringing me back 10 4 leaf clovers?

quest_list.notes: Get green harness made and pick up blue harness
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have 10 4 leaf clovers yet. Why don't you go and look for some more and then come back?
quest_list.success_message: You picked up Vixen's Blue Harness and gave Kilye 10 4 Leaf Clovers to start on Comet's.  She asked you to pick up 10 Pieces Iron Ore for the dye for Cupid's Harness.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect.  Here is Vixen's blue harness. I will get started on Comet's green harness and I will do Cupid's harness when you come back.  Black would work best for Cupid, so I'll need 10 iron ore.  I know it's a little weird, but it actually works quite well

quest_list.notes: Get black harness made and pick up green harness
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I needed 10 pieces of iron ore to be able to dye this the right color. I need a few more, if you could go and get them, please?
quest_list.success_message: You have picked up Comet's Green Harness and given Kilye the 10 Pieces of Iron Ore. Kilye has asked you to bring back 10 Bunches of Daisies for Donner's Harness.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is Comet's green harness. I will get started on Cupid's black harness now.  I will make Donner's next, so I will need 10 daisies for a shimmering white harness.

quest_list.notes: get white harness made and pick up black harness.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I need yet. I need 10 bunches of daisies. Please come back with them quickly.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Cupid's Black Harness! You gave Kilye 10 Bunches of Daisies for Donner's Harness and Kilye asked you to bring back 10 Walnuts for the dye needed for Blitzen's Harness.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Whew! We're almost done!  Here is Cupid's black harness and I will start Donner's white one now.  Please bring me back 10 Walnuts for the last one.  It will be for Blitzen.

quest_list.notes: Pick up both the white and brown harnesses.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have all the walnuts I need - better go and search the isle some more. Remember, I need 10 of them.
quest_list.success_message: You were given the last two harnesses- Donner's White Harness and Blitzen's Brown Harness. You now have to return them to Mrs. Claus on Christmas Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have everything I need. If you will just wait here I will finish up this last one... (Kylie goes back into her workroom and returns about an hour later.) Here is Donner's white harness and Blitzen's brown harness.

quest_list.notes: Remy gives you bagels and knishes for King Phil
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have enough money. Better go and earn some more.
quest_list.success_message: You have received 6 bagels and knishes for $600.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are. Another happy customer served!

quest_list.notes: Give Mrs Claus Prancer's and Vixen's Harnesses
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You already gave me those.  Did you have the others, still?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mrs. Claus the harnesses for Prancer and Vixen.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Kilye is just such an artist.  These will be perfect for Prancer and Vixen.  And now for Comet's and Cupid's harnesses?

quest_list.notes: Give Mrs Claus Comet and Cupid's Harnesses
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You already gave me those.  Did you have the others with you, still?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mrs. Claus the harnesses for Comet and Cupid.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What lovely colors.  I just knew Kilye would know the perfect shades. She is definitely on the nice list this year!  And now for the last two - Donner's and Blitzen's harnesses.

quest_list.notes: Give Mrs Claus Donner and Blitzen's harnesses
quest_list.title: Mrs. Claus' Anniversary Gift
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't have the harnesses?  You better go back and talk to Kilye.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mrs. Claus' Anniversary Gift Quest.  You earned $13,000 and 250 quest points! Your horse was given 2 Hearty Treats!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are just wonderful. I just can't wait to surprise Santa on our anniversary.  Here is a thank you for you and your horse.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: You find Athamos, the golden sheep, the first time.
quest_list.success_message: Athamos will not follow you home. Better return to Candide and let him know.

quest_list.notes: Give apple treat to sheep Athamos.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (The sheep can't find anything in your hand. You must not have an apple treat with you.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave an apple treat to Athamos! It looks like he will follow you now.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The sheep happily snatches the treat and takes a step toward you.)

quest_list.notes: Sara Sends You To The Solomon Island
quest_list.success_message: Sara sends you to Solomon Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, if that's what pleases you.  Here, go, go!

quest_list.notes: Give Eddie another strawberry in exchange for information about the sheep.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: This isn't a strawberry! Come back when you can give me one.
quest_list.success_message: Crazy Eddie informs you he sent a sheep to King Phil I on Hotzeplotz Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: YAY!! A strawberry! Thank you, thank you! Okay, I did find a Golden Sheep, and like all my treasures, I sent it to King Phil I on Hotzeplotz Isle in tribute to his greatness!

quest_list.notes: You take the Star of Solomon from Flo.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What... wait?  Where'd it go?  Ye cheatin' scoundrel!
quest_list.success_message: You have recovered the Star of Solomon Sapphire!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right.  Now take the stone, take it, arr.  Now... back ye go, you and that horse o' yours!  Back to Wington!

quest_list.notes: You take the Beryl from Flo.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I changed me mind.
quest_list.success_message: Flo gives Barry Solomon's Beryl, and sends you back to Wington.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There.  I suppose this be more than equal to the value of the Star.  Away w'ye now!  An' good riddance!

quest_list.notes: King Phil sends you to get him some lunch.
quest_list.success_message: King Phil has charged you to bring him bagels and knishes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good. Here is what I want. You will travel to the distant Art Isle, and visit the innkeeper Remy Belleeful and bring me back an order of his best bagels and knishes!

quest_list.notes: End of Quest: Opal Sandstone's Stolen Sapphire: Ms. Mabel Investigates
quest_list.title: Opal Sandstone's Sapphire: Ms Mabel Investigates
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Opal Sandstone's Stolen Sapphire!  You earned $10,000 and 300 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for all your work on my behalf.  I hope this covers your expenses and time--and a nice treat for that good horse of yours!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Give Diamonds and Sapphires to Opal
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What's this?  You didn't bring me anything at all?! Get out of here!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Opal Barry Solomon's Beryl.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, I guess this will do. (Opal shrugs.) I suppose pirates can be quite tiring. Here you go, dear, I hope this covers your expenses. Goodbye now.

quest_list.notes: A gift from Ms. Mabel
quest_list.success_message: Ms. Mabel gives you a Ruby, and a nice, hot cup of Tea.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, congratulations are in order!  I'd say you've performed admirably.  Please take this as a parting gift from me.  And now I'll be off to do my shopping.

quest_list.notes: King Phil points you in the direction of a golden sheep.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You will find the sheep mooning about near the palm tree at the very northern tip of this island. Good luck to you, Sir!

quest_list.notes: Give King Phil his bagels and knishes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not the stuff! Do you take me for a fool? Come back when you have the real deal.
quest_list.success_message: You give King Phil 6 Bagels and Knishes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Splendid! You may take the sheep with you now, assuming you can get it to follow you. (<i>King Phil mutters to himself somthing about stubborn sheep not wanting to move.<i>)

quest_list.notes: Flo and the Denuement (for tracking only.)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Very good thinking, that is.  I be impressed.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good thinking, that is.  I be impressed.

quest_list.notes: You find Phrixia, the golden sheep, the first time.
quest_list.success_message: Phrixia will not follow you home. Better return to Candide and let him know.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The sheep happily snatches the treat and takes a step toward you.)

quest_list.notes: Demetrius sends you to Crescent Isle.
quest_list.success_message: You have been transported to Crescent Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please feel free to relate to my delightful sister the deepest of brotherly affections from my humble self!

quest_list.notes: Luna informs you a sheep is on her island.
quest_list.success_message: Luna tells you a sheep has been wandering her beach.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, I have far more important things to do than to look after a sheep. I imagine it's still out there somewhere, wandering the beach.

quest_list.notes: You find Helle, the golden sheep, the first time.
