quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The sheep happily snatches the treat and takes a step toward you.)

quest_list.notes: Return Nephele to Candide
quest_list.success_message: You have reunited Nephele with Candide!

quest_list.notes: You return Athamos to Candide
quest_list.success_message: You have reunited Athamos with Candide!

quest_list.notes: You return Phrixia to Candide
quest_list.success_message: You have reunited Phrixia with Candide!

quest_list.notes: You return Helle to Candide
quest_list.success_message: You have reunited Helle with Candide!

quest_list.notes: Give first sheep to Candide
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Marvelous! Let's see which one it is...

quest_list.notes: Give second sheep to Candide
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Another sheep found! Let's see which one it is...

quest_list.notes: Deidre asks you to get 15 peacock feathers.
quest_list.success_message: Deidra asked you to get 15 Peacock Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Just let me know when you've found enough.

quest_list.notes: You give a third sheep to Candide
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yet another returned to the fold! Let's see which one it is...

quest_list.notes: Give final sheep to Candide
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: The final sheep has returned! Let's see which one it is...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The final sheep has returned! Let's see which one it is...

quest_list.notes: Candide gives you a reward.
quest_list.title: Candide's Golden Sheep
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't found all of the sheep yet?  Best to go back out and search some more.
quest_list.success_message: You completed Candide's Golden Sheep! You earned $40,000 and 400 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: How can I ever thank you enough? You have returned my precious herd to me, my priceless gift from the one place that treated me kindly... until now. Please, accept this small token of my appreciation. And please promise to come back and visit us often!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Liam the Farrier Tells You Your Minute Is Up (tracking only)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There, that's your minute.  I got work to do.

quest_list.notes: Deidra gives you a feather necklace in exchange for 15 peacock feathers.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Nope, I don't see 15 there. Come back when you have enough.
quest_list.success_message: Deidra gave you a Peacock Feather Necklace for 15 Peacock Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Just give me a few minutes here... and a tweak here... and I tie this part off here... and... voila! It's finished. Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Deidra gives you a feather necklace in exchange for 15 peacock feathers.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Just give me a few minutes here... and a tweak here... and I tie this part off here... and... voila! It's finished. Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Galvin asks you to deliver the necklace to Nina.
quest_list.success_message: Galvin asked you to deliver the necklace to Nina on Tail Isle. You earned $2000.

quest_list.notes: You give the feather necklace to Nina
quest_list.title: Galvin's Birthday Present
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, I don't see anything.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Galvin's Birthday Present! You earned 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow, thank you! I will wear this with pride! I will send a note to my brother to thank him. I appreciate you going to all this trouble!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Accepts Your Offer Of Help
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, well, fine.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Sumiko get her Riding for the Handicapped program set up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Sumiko drops heavily into a chair.) Well, the first thing I need are buckets and feed tubs. Can you go to the various other barns and see if they have any old tubs or buckets they don't need?

quest_list.notes: Sumiko asks for 4 buckets and 4 feed tubs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, forget it, then.
quest_list.success_message: Sumiko asks you to get her four used buckets and four used feed tubs from other barns.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have a stable for four horses, so I need four buckets and four tubs.  Here's some money in case they want to sell them cheap.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Buckets: Aura Hayward gives you a 3 buckets.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Those rotten dogs, they've chewed up all my old buckets again! Sorry about that.
quest_list.success_message: Aura Hayward gave you 3 Stall Buckets.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  They're not much to look at, but these three buckets still hold water and the clips are new.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Buckets: Harry Holterz sells you a bucket and a tub.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have $200 on you?  Not like it's a lot.
quest_list.success_message: Harry Holterz sold you two feed tubs for $100 each.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here y'are.

quest_list.notes: Kiah asks you to bring her valerian root.
quest_list.success_message: Kiah has asked you to bring her Valerian Roots.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Buckets: Staebulman gives you a bucket and a tub.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry.  Can't find them.  Maybe the owner finally came for them.
quest_list.success_message: Dwight Staebulman gave you a stall bucket and a feed tub.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  Please give Sumiko my compliments.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Buckets: Donna Hayes sells you a feed tub.
quest_list.success_message: Donna Hayes sells you a new feed tub for $150.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  I hope she likes it.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Gets Her Buckets and Tubs
quest_list.title: Sumiko's Buckets
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh--oh, I'm so sorry, I need four of each, yes.  But... could you please bring them when you've got four of each?  I'm so disorganized just now...
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Sumiko's Buckets.  You earned a Dinosaur Bone and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much, these are all perfect!  And a new one!  Well done!  Here's something for your trouble, and keep the change from what I gave you before.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Find a valerian plant.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You see a small green plant with fragrant pink flowers. This must be the plant Kiah was talking about! It looks like either a shovel or a rake will get you the roots.

quest_list.notes: Dig up the valerian plant.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig up a Valerian Plant!

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Saddles: Tessa sells you an old saddle for cheap.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, come on!  Once this saddle is cleaned up, it'll be worth a lot more than $100!
quest_list.success_message: You buy a used saddle from Tessa for $100.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I hope this helps her.  Here you are.

quest_list.notes: Use the rake to get valerian roots.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over,  but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully rake away some dirt and snip off a few of the roots of the plant, leaving the rest of it alone.

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah the valerian plant
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That is not the right thing. Go back and try again. It grows near the edge of the jungle by some rocks, just south of here.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Kiah the Valerian Plant.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Kiah's eyes narrow dangerously.) What did you do? Ra'stha su ka'sthana nii! Look at this wastefulness! You dug up the entire plant and now no more valerian will grow in that spot. Na'shu! Get out!

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah valerian roots
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That is not the right thing. Come back when you have found the right thing. It grows on the edge of the jungle near some rocks south of here.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Kiah the Valerian Roots.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ahh, this is perfect, Namaste! Well done. Yes, it seems you may yet be truly worthy. I will set you a more difficult task. If you complete it successfully, then we shall see.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko asks for Halters with Leads, and used saddles.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What was I talking about again?
quest_list.success_message: Sumiko asks you to get her four halters with leads and four used saddles.  She gave you $1000 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I need halters with leads, and used saddles, preferably child-sized; four of each.  Here's money for expenses.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Saddles: Belinda sells you a child's saddle.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, really. $200 is not that much, surely you travel with more than that.  I can't sell this saddle for less.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a used Child's Saddle for $200.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Saddles: Bridgett gives your 4 halters with leads.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, no, a tree fell in the woods again...
quest_list.success_message: Bridgett gave you four new Halters with Leads for Sumiko.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There.  Four brand-new halters with nice cotton leads, in four sizes.  Please give them to Sumiko with my compliments.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Saddles: Goodwin gives you two Aussie saddles.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: If auld acquainance be forget, and never brought to miiiiiiiiiiind...
quest_list.success_message: Goodwin Ryder gives you two small Aussie saddles for Sumiko.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aw, she don't owe me anything.  Happy to help.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Saddles: End of Saddle Part.
quest_list.title: Sumiko's Saddles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, dear... Can you please hold on to them until you've got everything?  I need to make room.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Sumiko's Saddles.  You earned a Dinosaur Bone and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are wonderful!  And some of these are new!  I'll have to send everyone a note!  Thank you so much!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Kiah sends you after neem bark.
quest_list.success_message: Kiah has asked you to gather bark from a neem tree.

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah large neem bark.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I see nothing here. You must find the tree behind the temple on the smallest isle west of here.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kiah the neem bark.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is perfect! (Kiah looks truly pleased.) This will be a tremendous help. Thank you very much, namaste.

quest_list.notes: Kiah sends you after a jungle treasure.
quest_list.success_message: Kiah has asked you to retrieve a jungle treasure.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That is part of your lo'kusha. Find the elf, find the object.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Mounting Station: Instructions to player
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need you to go buy me Belinda Buckett's mounting block.
quest_list.success_message: Sumiko gave you $5000 to buy a mounting block from Talia Timbers in Earton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's $5000.  The thing isn't worth even that much, but... see what kind of a deal you can get.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Mounting Block: Buy for $10,000
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aw, who do you think you're dealing with?!  You don't have $10,000 on you!
quest_list.success_message: You arranged for Talia to deliver a mounting block to Sumiko for $10,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: $10,000, thank you.  Deliver this myself.  Go tell her it's coming.  Pleasure dealing with you.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Mounting Block: Buy for $5,000
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Cheapskate!  Who are you kidding?!  You don't even have the money she said she gave you!
quest_list.success_message: Talia has agreed to deliver the Mounting Block to Sumiko for $5,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Five thousand.  I'll deliver it tomorrow.  Go tell her.  Deal?  Deal!

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Mounting Block: Buy for $2,500
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't got the money!  Who do you think you're kidding? Get out of here!
quest_list.success_message: You arranged for Talia to deliver a mounting block to Sumiko for $2,500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're a tough cookie, you are. $2,500 and that's with delivery!

quest_list.notes: Buy the mount from Talia
Give Nicolette a paint base (tracking only, actions 1342 and 1323 chain to this.)
Nizhoni checks to see that you've brought her all the right materials.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Nizhoni looks at the materials you've brought her. ) I will work on the calumets. In the meantime, take the small pieces to the beadmaker. She will know what to do.

quest_list.notes: Sumiko Mounting Block: End
quest_list.title: Sumiko's Custom Mounting Block

quest_list.success_message: You Completed Sumiko's Custom Mounting Block!  She gave you a Red Pine Cone for your efforts.  You earned 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, thank you so much for all your work on behalf of the Appleton Riding for the Handicapped Center!  Please accept this small reward, I hope you will find it useful.

quest_list.notes: Pig III Asks you to tell his brothers that he can't warn them about BB Wolf anymore.
quest_list.success_message: The Third Little Pig sends you off to warn his brothers of his inability to warn his brothers...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is no time for airy persiflage!  There is danger!  They must be told!

quest_list.notes: Pig II is Warned.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh my goodness...
quest_list.success_message: You've warned The Second Little Pig that Wilson can't warn him about the wolf.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wilson is gone?!  Oh my goodness... I guess I'll just have to stay indoors, then.

quest_list.notes: Pig I is Warned
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Fine!
quest_list.success_message: Well, you tried to warn the First Little Pig...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, Wilson is missing, eh? Well, you can just go back to B.B. Wolf and tell him this little piggy isn't so dumb! (Slam... or rather, shplat! goes the door.)

quest_list.notes: You warn Pig III that you warned Pigs II and I about not getting any warnings. [End of Part 1.]
quest_list.title: Pig Warning!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't warn both of them!  I can tell by the look on your face!  I don't want to lose a brother!  Go warn the other brother!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Three Little Pigs, Part Warn... (ahem) Part One.  You earned $1000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, you're a marvel!  Thank you!  Now we'll all be perfectly safe!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah the stone.

quest_list.success_message: You hand Kiah the stone-like object.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Kiah's eyes grow wide with sudden astonishment.) Ma'lo'hana shii'ni! Do you know what this is?

quest_list.notes: Tracker to verify that Gidget gave you the stone or rock.
Give Kiah the nut.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I see nothing. You must return to the elf and get the treasure from her.
quest_list.success_message: You give Kiah the Small Jungle Nut.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Maa'hala. You have done well! Inside this nut is a seed for a kusha tree. They are dwindling in the jungle, so every seed is precious. Well, Namaste, you have done well. You will be welcome here again.

quest_list.notes: Get first small neem bark.
quest_list.success_message: Fending off small claws and small teeth, you hurridly scrape a bit of bark from the neem tree before being forced to retreat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The squirrel takes offense to you pushing her aside, and immediately begins attacking you.)

quest_list.notes: Give Epona $1,000 to participate in her quiz.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it doesn't look like you have enough money right now.  Try coming back later.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Epona $1,000 to take her quiz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, are you ready for the first question?

quest_list.notes: Pecos Bill instructs you to get him ten Sparkling Feathers.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: *Danger, Danger Will Robinson!*
quest_list.success_message: Pecos Bill would like you to find him 10 Sparkling Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Got me an idea!  Bring me ten o' them sparkly feathers.  I know just how to attach 'em.  Widow-Maker'll love it!

quest_list.notes: Pecos Bill gives you a rope to catch Widow-Maker with.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, dag-nabbit, ten feathers!  Won't catch Widow-Maker's attention no-how with just these!
quest_list.success_message: Pecos Bill lends you a Gussied-Up Lariat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, these will do just fine!  I'll stick one here... and a few here... There!  That'll get Widow-Maker's attention all right!

quest_list.notes: Get first small neem bark.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The squirrel takes offense to you pushing her aside, and immediately begins attacking you.)

quest_list.notes: Kiah sends you after more neem bark.
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked to gather more neem bark.

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah a small neem bark.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I see nothing there. You must go back and get the bark. Seach at the tree behind the temple on the smallest isle west of here.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kiah the Small Neem Bark.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You call this neem bark? (Kiah shakes her head in disgust.) There's barely enough here to fill my tiniest nush'kua! Go back and get more.

quest_list.notes: Get second small neem bark
quest_list.success_message: Doing your best to avoid the furry beast attacking you, you manage to scrape more bark from the neem tree.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The squirrel takes you up on your offer, and jumps into the fray with much enthusiasm.)

quest_list.notes: Give Kiah more small neem bark.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have any. You must re-visit the tree!
quest_list.success_message: You give Kiah the small neem bark.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Kiah narrows her eyes.) It will be enough when I say it's enough, no'hani? However, this bit and the other together should do. Now, go and tend to those scratches. I surely hope you did not harm a creature of the Jungle!

quest_list.notes: Nilla sends you after 10 walnuts.
quest_list.success_message: The squirrel asks you for 10 Walnuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The little squirrel sits back and appears to be anticipating your return.)

quest_list.notes: Give Nilla 10 walnuts, get a diamond and the neem bark.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (The squirrel does a quick count and looks at you with disappointment. She thrusts out both hands again so you can count all 10 of her fingers.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave the squirrel 10 Walnuts and received a Diamond!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The squirrel does a little happy dance as she takes her treasure. She holds up a paw and scurries under the tree only to reappear a moment later with a shiny object in her hands. She hands you the object with obvious gratitude.)

quest_list.notes: Get the large neem bark.
quest_list.success_message: Sliding past the happy squirrel, you are able to carefully peel a large piece of bark from the neem tree. You got the Neem Bark!

quest_list.notes: Done visiting Nilla the Squirrel. Tracking only.
Return Widow-Maker to Pecos Bill
quest_list.title: Pecos Bill's Lost Horse
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hey!  Where's m' lasso?!  Go find it!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Pecos Bill's Lost Horse!  You earned $4000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, by golly, you do!  Thanks, and much obliged to you, pardner!  Here's a little bit of a reward for you!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Capture Widow-Maker
quest_list.success_message: You have captured Widow-Maker!  He will now follow you back to Pecos Bill, and probably never realize it!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Carefully, very carefully, waiting until Widow-Maker's full attention is on the feathers, you fling the lasso over Widow-Maker's head.)

quest_list.notes: Ready to go after Kiah's third item. Tracker only.

quest_list.notes: Reunite Will and Rose
quest_list.title: The Sailor's Lost Love
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Sailor's Lost Love Quest! You earned $3000, a Ruby, an Amethyst, and 100 quest points.
quest_list.author: Arica

quest_list.notes: Aladdin asks for a Blue Morpho.
quest_list.success_message: Prince Aladdin asks you to find him a wild Blue Morpho butterfly in return for delaying Red Riding Hood at his castle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have heard that in the Isle of Flowers there can be found, wild, Blue Morpho butterflies!  Find me a wild one, and I shall do this... onerous favor for you.

quest_list.notes: Give Aladdin a Blue Morpho
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You have no such thing!  How dare you deceive a Prince of the East!  Begone!
quest_list.success_message: Prince Aladdin takes the butterfly, and gives you a sapphire and his thanks.  He will detain Red Riding Hood for a while.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah!  More beautiful than sapphires!  For this I shall detain her for... a while.  A short while.  Here, take this sapphire, which pales in comparison to the beauty of this beast!

quest_list.notes: Unicorn Uniter will do a favor for his favorite Pie maker.
quest_list.success_message: The Unicorn Uniter will help delay Red Riding Hood!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd rather not.  But I owe Grandmother a favor for all those delicious pies she sends.  I'll let her granddaughter pet the unicorns for... a little while.

quest_list.notes: Get Sticks and Hay for Pigs
quest_list.success_message: The Third Little Pig wants 20 Strong, Skinny Branches and 10 Hay Bales so his brothers will move out.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  Think of all the people you'll be helping!  Now, 20 branches and 10 hay bales, mind.  Thank you ever so much.

quest_list.notes: Stick the Pig, Hay the Pig, Get Cooperation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Twenty!  Can't you count?  This isn't enough!  I'm not putting up with that child for anything less than twenty!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Third Little Pig 20 Strong, Skinny Branches and 10 Hay Bales, and he promised to detain Red Riding Hood for 30 minutes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do splendidly.  I will detain the child for exactly 30 minutes.

quest_list.notes: Nicolette Gives You A List
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette gives you a list of things you will need to get in order to make pigments, and requests that you find some paint base.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, let me write this down.... Take this.  This is a list of what I need; 10 each copper and iron ores and chrome and tin oxides.

quest_list.notes: Temperton sells you oxides.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, come back when you can pay for the goods!
quest_list.success_message: Arthur Temperton sold you 1/2 kilo of Tin and Chrome Oxides for $100 each.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The SnO is the tin, and the Cr2O3 is the chrome, just so you know.

quest_list.notes: Agrees to get things for Peter the pumpkin eater.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 15 Pinches of Pixie Dust and 15 Moonbeams for Peter.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks.  That would be helpful.  I need 15 pinches of pixie dust and 15 moonbeams.  Something about making it sparkle, or some such thing.

quest_list.notes: Give Peter the pumpkin eater items.
quest_list.title: Peter the Pumpkin Eater's Glittery Decor
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, I really do need 15 of each. She is pretty sure of what she wants.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Peter's Quest! You earned $2500 and 25 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Thanks again. She's gotta move in now!
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Robin sends you to Marisole with the harp.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are on Paradise Isle.  You were given a Singing Harp.

quest_list.notes: Robin jumps you to Paradise Isle
quest_list.success_message: You have been jumped to Paradise Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give Robin the Thank You note and complete the quest.
quest_list.title: Robin's Secret Crush
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Robin's Secret Crush! You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much! (Robin holds the note up to his nose to smell the scented stationery.) I'm going to go read this now, but please take this small reward and my many thanks for your help!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Give Marisole the harp and get her thank you note.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Marisole the Singing Harp and received her Thank You Note.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, isn't it lovely? It really is beautiful! How thoughtful of him! Please, just give me a moment to write a quick thank you note... there! Please take this back to him for me.

quest_list.notes: Vern sells you four cans of white paint.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Actually, I already gave you the paint.  I hope you don't need more, because I don't have any more.
quest_list.success_message: Vern gives you four Cans of White Paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Four cans of fresh, white paint.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the Oxides
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, you don't have what you said you had.  Please see if you can find it.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette takes the Tin and Chrome Oxides from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  This is very good--enough chrome oxide and more than enough tin!  And now the ores, please?

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the Ores
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 10 of each, remember.  Check the list.
quest_list.success_message: You give Nicolette 10 chunks of Iron Ore and 10 chunks of Copper Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, these are excellent.  I have all I need to make the colors now.  Oh, why don't you give me that list, too?  I'll toss it in the bin for you.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette her list (to clear it from your inventory)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: How did you manage to lose... oh, well, never mind.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette agrees to get busy on the pigments.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks!  I'll get on this right away.  It will take a day or so, so why don't you go do something else in the meantime?

quest_list.notes: Nicolette sends you for skim milk for a paint base.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette needs 5 liters of milk for a paint base.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, there's a general store right down the street.  When you come back tomorrow, bring me five liters from there.

quest_list.notes: Tony sells you some goat's milk.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aw, come on, it's not like it's expensive!
quest_list.success_message: Tony Grocer sells you five liters of skimmed Goat's Milk for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, here you go.  Don't spill it, and hurry, you don't want it to freeze.

quest_list.notes: Nicolette Sells You Four Cans Of Paint
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, either you already picked up the paint already, or you can't afford it.
quest_list.success_message: Nicolette sells you four cans of handmade paint for $4000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, then!  Red, Yellow, Green and Blue!  I hope these will do.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the White Paint
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had four cans of white paint!  Please get some more now.
quest_list.success_message: You give Nicolette four Cans of White Paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect.  This will do very nicely.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the Goat's Milk
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't you buy the goat's milk?  Please get it now.
quest_list.success_message: You give Nicolette the 5-liter bucket of Goat's Milk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is excellent.  Smells funny, though...

quest_list.notes: Dewey gives you fishing lures and sends you to Loch Isle
quest_list.success_message: You were given a box of Fishing Lures and sent to Loch Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give 10 worms to Davy
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I don't see 10 there. Come on back when you have 10 worms.
quest_list.success_message: You were given $500 for 10 Earthworms.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Dewey sends you to Loch Isle
quest_list.success_message: You were sent to Loch Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure! Say 'hi' to ol' Sam for me!

quest_list.notes: Give lures to Davy.
quest_list.title: Dewey's Lures
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dewey's Lures! You earned $2000 and 25 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, great! I've been waiting for these. Fishing is my grandfather's true passion. He's always happy when we go fishing together. Here, please take this as a token of my thanks!
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Lucie sends you to Grant Funds.
quest_list.success_message: Lucie suggests you ask Grant Funds in Wington about old band instruments.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: But you know who to try? Grant Funds, in Wington now, I believe.  He was our band instructor and he might just still have some of those old school instruments!

quest_list.notes: Grant Funds sells you a very expensive French Horn.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have the funds.  And I'm afraid I cannot make you a loan at this time.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a new French Horn from Grant Funds for $5,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Done.  Let me get it from my office......................... Here you are, a nearly new French horn.  Treat it with respect and it will reward the player for many years to come.

quest_list.notes: Grant Funds sells you a really cheap French horn.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have the funds.  And I'm afraid I cannot make you a loan at this time.
quest_list.success_message: You buy a very beat up, quite badly abused French Horn from Grant Funds for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: One moment, let me get it from my office..................................... Here it is.  The poor dear has seen many, many semesters come and go, but she is still quite serviceable.

quest_list.notes: You Have Acquired a French Horn.
quest_list.success_message: You have acquired a French Horn.

quest_list.notes: Wolf tells you he was invited to the party (tracking only)
Harry Holterz sells you costumes.
quest_list.success_message: You bought two old costumes from Harry Holterz for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. One dress and one captain's outfit. Good luck with Pirates.

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary Checks To See If You Have Everything She Asked For (tracking)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Avast, ye, WHO DO Y' THINK YE BE FOOLIN' WITH?!  Y'ain't got all what I asked for!  Now shove off afore I hang ye from the yard arm and get me my stuff like ye said ye was going to!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, well, this all seems to be in order.  Now... let me take a closer look here...

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary takes the grungy old French Horn.
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary accepts the Used French Horn.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This has seen better days, I reckon... (Mary picks up the old horn, raises it to her lips, and blows with all the power she possesses. From out of the bell comes a loud BLEAT!) Arr, but it do sound good! Thank ye!

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary takes the new French Horn.
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary accepts the French Horn.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, now this be a fine instrument! (Mary picks up the horn, raises it to her lips, and blows with all the power she possesses. From out of the bell comes a loud BLEAT!) Arr an' it do sound good! Thank ye!

quest_list.notes: Mary Is Less Than Enthused with the dress.
quest_list.success_message: You give Silver Mary the Costume Dress.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye call this a hoop dress?  I asked ye fer a hoop dress!  Ah, well, at leas' it'll fit.  An' now, MY uniform.

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary takes the Captain's Costume
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary takes the Captain's Outfit from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Avast now, ye lubber, what ha' we here?  This be a captain's uniform!

quest_list.notes: Mary Takes The Paint.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arr, ye got no paint!  What be wrong w'ye?  Go get me the paint afore I makes ye walk the plank!
quest_list.success_message: You give Silver Mary 4 cans of paint.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah. Paint. (Silver Mary pries open one of the lids, examines the color... and then sniffs.) This be a funny-smellin' paint to be sure.

quest_list.notes: Vern Has Paint you can buy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Let me think... I have some leftover cans, I think. Hold on a second....
(Vern goes into a back room, and comes out with a few well-splattered cans.)
I have some lime, and navy... and four cans of good white, but that's it.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Rapunzel a hairpiece made.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Rapunzel's hairpiece! You were given $2000 to help with travel and payment costs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much! Here is some money to help with the cost of getting it made and travel. I can't wait to see it - please hurry. I wouldn't want my prince to come without having that to look my best.

quest_list.notes: M. Renard asks that you visit the local cheese emporium (tracking only)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You would do this pour moi, un vieux renard? Merveilleux! You comprehend, an old fox, he does not have the money to pay you. But I can offer you for your services ces raisins magnifiques! They grow nowhere else! Pick as many as you like.
quest_list.success_message: M. Renard, the Fox, asks you to get him some cheese.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You would do this pour moi, un vieux renard? Merveilleux! You comprehend, an old fox, he does not have the money to pay you. But I can offer you for your services ces raisins magnifiques! They grow nowhere else! Pick as many as you like.

quest_list.notes: M. Renard teleports you off his island.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF!*  You are suddenly transported back to Dust Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Et voilà!

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary's Reward
quest_list.title: Silver Mary's Big Production
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Get ye gone afore I sends ye t' Davey Jones!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Silver Mary's Big Production.  You earned two Diamond Necklaces, two Pearl Necklaces and 400 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, these be just lyin' around.  Should be good enough reward for ye.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Fitzgerald sends you to Aesop Island.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You are on Aesop Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, then.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get the copper ore for Inigo to make hair piece
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get 20 pieces of Copper Ore for Inigo Webster.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That sounds fine. Just come back when you have the ore and I will get started.

quest_list.notes: Give copper ore to Inigo for Rapunzel's hairpiece.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have everything I need yet. Make sure and come back with 20 copper ores so I can get started.
quest_list.success_message: You give 20 pieces of Copper Ore to Inigo. He asks you to come back later for the hairpiece.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! I will go ahead and get started. You can come back in a bit and it should be ready.  The price will be $1000.

quest_list.notes: Pick up Rapunzel's hairpiece from Inigo
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have quite enough money. The total cost will be $1000. I will keep it here for you while you go and get the money.
quest_list.success_message: You were given an intricately woven elegant hairpiece for Rapunzel!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yep - here it is! It is cooled down and should be safe for you to carry. Make sure to take it right back to Rapunzel.

quest_list.notes: Tony sends you to Shaylene Shampu for cheeze.
quest_list.success_message: Tony Grocer recommends Shaylene Shampu as a source of cheese.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Shaylene Shampu. She's up in Whiskerton, she's got a grooming salon up there. Ask her. Maybe she knows something.

quest_list.notes: Give Rapunzel her hairpiece.
quest_list.title: Rapunzel's Beautiful Hairpiece
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You might have dropped it along the way. Please go and find it and come back.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Rapunzel's Beautiful Hairpiece! You earned $5000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is so elegant! Thank you so much for getting this for me. Here is something for you since you were so kind.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Shaylene gives you a list of cheese-making ingredients.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave you the list!
quest_list.success_message: Shaylene gives you a List of items she needs to get started as a cheesemaker and $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Okay! Here's a list of what I need: a large, copper pot, some red wax to coat the cheese, cheesecloth, paper cheese wrap and a curd knife.
Here's $3000 to get you started. Take the list, too.

quest_list.notes: Shylene takes back her list if you refuse the quest.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You spent the $3000 already?  Well, by spending the money, you've agreed to get the things, so either bring me the $3000 or shoo.
quest_list.success_message: Shaylene takes back the $3000 and her list and tucks it away in a book.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fine.  Be that way.

quest_list.notes: Winchell Takes You To The Clouds
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: My child, you don't have what I asked for!  I do not perform on command!  Come back when your quests are done AND you have 3 Giant Coconuts!
quest_list.success_message: You are transported to the Cloud Isles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hold on!

quest_list.notes: Winchell sends you to Cloud Isle
quest_list.success_message: Winchell transports you to the Cloud Isles!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Climb aboard!  Let us away to the heights of higher things!

quest_list.notes: Hansel thanks you
quest_list.title: Hansel's Little List
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're missing something, check the list and come back when you've gotten everything.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Hansel's Little List!  You earned $10,000, 10 Silver Linings and 400 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You did a fabulous job for us! Let me have the list back and here, please accept these as a token of our appreciation.
quest_list.author: Bklyn Filly

quest_list.notes: Jayne sends you after his cunning hat.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go find Jayne's cunning hat.

quest_list.notes: Fluffy sends you for carrots.
quest_list.success_message: Fluffy the rabbit has sent you for 3 Carrots.

quest_list.notes: Give Fluffy 3 carrots.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (The rabbit looks dangerously angry again. He points to his picture of three carrots still outlined in the dirt. Obviously you don't have what he wants.)
quest_list.success_message: You were given Jayne's Cunning Hat in exchange for 3 Carrots.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The bunny makes a quick grab for the carrots, and tosses the knit hat at you in exchange before dashing off to his burrow.)

quest_list.notes: Give knit hat to Jayne and complete the quest.
quest_list.title: Jayne's Cunning Hat
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where's my hat?!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Jayne's Cunning Hat! You earned $5000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My hat! My cunning hat! Sorry for getting all bent up before. I been a might jumpy since that lousy day. You've done me a kindness, and I won't soon forget it! Here, it ain't much, but I best be giving you some form of payment.
quest_list.author: Tempest

quest_list.notes: Agree to see if Inigo can build Grey Slate a menorah.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go and ask Inigo Webster on Jungle Isle to make a menorah for Grey Slate to give to King Phil.  You were given $1500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! I really appreciate the help. Tell Inigo I need a menorah that will fit into the throne room.  It needs to be tall and well, heh, kinda gaudy.  Here's a little something to start you off.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get supplies for Inigo to start on the menorah
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get 20 chunks of Iron Ore and 20 chunks of Copper Ore for Inigo to use to build the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, I have all the chemicals I need, but I am out of the metals.  I need 20 iron ore and 20 copper ore and, oh, wait, never mind, I have the steel here, too. Just the iron and copper.

quest_list.notes: Give Inigo the iron and copper for the menorah.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't quite have 20 of each. I need the iron and the copper ores.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Inigo 20 chunks of Iron Ore and 20 chunks of Copper Ore for him to use in making the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are exactly what I need. While I am working on this, can you get what I need for the middle?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get a glass piece for Inigo from Nicolette.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go to Nicolette to ask her to make the middle piece for the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Tell her it can be in any style, but I would like it blue with white animals. Oh, and it should measure, in inches, 12h X 18l X 1w.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get tin oxide for Nicolette to use for Inigo's piece.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to go to Arthur Temperton and buy some Tin Oxide for Nicolette.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am pretty sure Arthur Temperton will have more that you can buy. Just bring it back as quick as you can.

quest_list.notes: Get tin oxide from Arthur Temperton for Nicolette.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I will need 100 dollars for the oxide.
quest_list.success_message: You were given Tin Oxide to take back to Nicolette.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I sure do. Here you go. That will be $100.

quest_list.notes: Give Nicolette the tin oxide
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't Arthur have any oxide? Could you check again?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Nicolette the Tin Oxide.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks so much. This will take a little while, so why don't you wander over to Christmas Isle and say hi to Santa and Mrs. Claus? Oh, and there will be a $500 charge for the piece when you pick it up.

quest_list.notes: Pick up glass scene for the menorah
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough.  I need $500 before I will give you the glass piece.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a glass scene to take back to Inigo for him to use in the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It sure is. Here you go. That will be $500. Tell Inigo I appreciate the opportunity for royalty to see my craftsmanship.

quest_list.notes: Give Inigo the glass piece to be inserted into the menorah.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have it? Did you drop it somewhere along the way? Perhaps you had better go and look for it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Inigo the glass piece to use in the menorah.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is exactly what I was looking for!! This will take just a bit for me to complete, so if you would like to explore some, feel free.

quest_list.notes: Pick up menorah from Inigo
quest_list.success_message: You were given a very heavy, and tall, Metal and Glass Menorah to take back to Grey Slate.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It certainly is. Here you go.  Tell Grey Slate I will send him a bill.  I think King Phil will definitely like this piece.

quest_list.notes: Tell Linnea about Dalton's Reaction
quest_list.success_message: You told Linnea how Dalton liked his rug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's so nice! I never imagined that a simple gift could do that. So, tell me, who did you give the blue-green rug to?

quest_list.notes: Agree to take the menorah to King Phil
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the menorah yet? Or was it left somewhere along the way? Could you get it please and bring it back to me?
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to take the Menorah to King Phil. You were jumped to Hotzeplotz Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks!  Now, just grab ahold of the scepter and off you go.

quest_list.notes: Give King Phil the menorah from Grey Slate
quest_list.title: King Phil's Menorah
quest_list.success_message: You Completed King Phil's Menorah! You were given a Persian Kitten and earned 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now that's a nice piece of hardware! Take this as a token of my appreciation - Please!! (King Phil mutters under his breath -If they would only stop having litters!)
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Get paint base for Nicolette (tracking only, 1335 and 1340 chain to this)
Agree to find wood and leather for Xamba
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to collect 6 logs of Ebony Wood and 6 Leather Strappings for Xamba.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Six pieces.  Yes, six pieces of ebony wood.  Six leather strappings.  That's it.  Yep yep. That will do.

quest_list.notes: Xamba gives you the drum
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not enough.  Only $300 needed.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Drum for $300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Done.  Finished.  Here.

quest_list.notes: Xamba tells you about Lucie B. Euro possibly knowing about french horns (tracking only)
Give Xamba wood and leather for drum
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Six!  Must have six.  Ebony wood and leather strappings.  Off you go.  Go now.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba 6 logs of Ebony Wood and 6 Leather Strappings.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aha!  Perfect.  Yes.  You go.  I work.  Come back later.  With $300.  Yep, yep.  Later.

quest_list.notes: Silver Mary Takes the Drum
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arr, but where be my drum?!  Why ye filthy, lyin' pirate, I'll run you through!  Begone an' get me me drum!
quest_list.success_message: Silver Mary accepts the Drum.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, now this be a nice... if a wee bit exotic... kind of a drum.  T'will do.

quest_list.notes: Give Mary one of the french horns (tracking only)
Cinnamon sells you four liters of cow's milk.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait a minute, you don't have $200!  Can't you get that amount?
quest_list.success_message: Cinnamon sells you four liters of cow's milk for $200.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Find Victor Voice, Harold Nickelendime's Sock Puppet
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you see a bright red thread!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Victor Voice, Harold Nickelendime's Sock Puppet.

quest_list.notes: Agree to bring groups of 25 agates to Bubba Topaz

quest_list.notes: Emma sends out our for seedlings.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Have a peaceful and content day!

quest_list.notes: Barrett jumps player to Puuhonua Isle
quest_list.success_message: You were jumped to Puuhonua Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure I can.  Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Pattini sends you after a winter lotus.
quest_list.success_message: Pattini has asked you to find a Winter Lotus blossom.

quest_list.notes: Sera sends you to christmas elves for help.
Sera tells you where to find the winter lotus.
Dilly Chilly asks you for wood and snowballs.
quest_list.success_message: Dilly Chilly has asked you to bring him 20 Snowballs and 4 Logs.

quest_list.notes: Give Dilly Chilly wood and snowballs and get chilly box.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oops, I don't see enough here. I need at least 20 snowballs and 4 logs.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dilly Chilly 20 Snowballs and 4 Logs and received a Chilly Box.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Just give me a minute here to cut these logs up and put them together like so.... and pack in extra snow in nice and tight there... and voila! One chilly Winter Lotus carrying box! I think this will do perfectly.

quest_list.notes: Find Winter Lotus in snow
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closly, you see a beautiful and delicate white Winter Lotus blossom. What a pretty flower! It looks like if you rake the snow away, you'll be able to pick it at its root.

quest_list.notes: Attempt to pick a Lotus Blossom
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.

quest_list.notes: Give Pattini the Winter Lotus, get reward, and complete her challenge.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I see nothing here. You must bring me a Winter Lotus blossom from the north.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Pattini the Winter Lotus and received a pearl necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well done! You have proven yourself. And for your earlier wisdom, I will gift you this pearl necklace, which is as pale as the Winter Lotus itself. I will send you on to find Katavul, the All-Seeing Eagle. Pass his challenge, and you will find Katukilal.

quest_list.notes: Successfully put Winter Lotus in the Chilly Box
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You pick the flower, but it begins to melt away as soon as it comes into contact with your warm hand. Ruined!
quest_list.success_message: Carefully raking the snow aside, you pick a flower and immediately put it in the chilly box. You take a moment to make sure the flower is okay, but it looks perfectly nestled in its cold carrying case.

quest_list.notes: Got challenge from Pattini (tracking only)
Pattini sends you after a winter lotus (2nd path).
quest_list.success_message: Pattini has asked you to find a Winter Lotus blossom.

quest_list.notes: Finish challenge from Pattini (tracking only)
Give Pattini the Winter Lotus and complete her challenge.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I see nothing here. You must bring me a Winter Lotus blossom from the north.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Pattini the Winter Lotus.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well done! You have proven yourself well. I will send you on to find Katavul, the All-Seeing Eagle. Pass his challenge, and you will then find Katukilal.

quest_list.notes: Give Omand $1,000 to participate in his quiz
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry but you don't seem to have enough money.  Maybe you could come back and try later?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Omand $1,000 to participate in his quiz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Are you ready, then?

quest_list.notes: Workbook Treasure No. 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've Found Horse Isle Workbook Treasure No. 2:  $3,000 and 5 Topazes

quest_list.notes: Workbook Treasure No. 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've Found Horse Isle Workbook Treasure No. 1: $2,000 and 5 Amethysts

quest_list.notes: Workbook Treasure No. 3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have uncovered Workbook Treasure No. 3: $4000 and 5 Silver Ores!

quest_list.notes: Workbook Treasure No. 4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have uncovered Workbook Treasure No. 4: $5,000 and 5 Gold Ores!

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate asks you to get 3 gold ores and a new hammer
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find Grey Slate 3 chunks of Gold Ore and get a Jeweler's Hammer from Liam Flux.  You were given $1,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, well, bring me 3 chunks of gold ore and a new jeweler's hammer from Liam.  See you when you get back.  Oh, and here's some money to pay him and for boat fare and like that.

quest_list.notes: Liam Flux Sells You A Hammer
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't he even give you the money to pay me?
quest_list.success_message: Liam Flux sells you a Jeweler's Hammer for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, jeweler's hammer.

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate Takes 3 Ores And A Hammer.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked for three gold ores and a jeweler's hammer.  Can't you find those?  Go and look, it's not hard.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Grey Slate the ores and hammer.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks.  I've got the mold ready to cast.  The ring will be ready tomorrow.  Come and pick it up then.

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate Gives You Lilianna's Ring
quest_list.success_message: Grey Slate gives you a magnificent diamond ring for Princess Lilianna.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here it is, a ring fit for a fairy-tale wedding.  Don't lose it!

quest_list.notes: Martha agrees to bake a wedding cake for you.
quest_list.success_message: Martha will bake Lilianna's wedding cake for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, you're a dear!  Thank you for understanding.  $1000 for my time and supplies should cover it.

quest_list.notes: Martha sells you an incredible cake.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, I thought we agreed the price was to be $1,000.  You don't seem to have that much on you.
quest_list.success_message: You have bought a Wedding Cake from Martha for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, thank you so much!  I'll have my son put the box on one of your horses and set the cake in it.

quest_list.notes: King Phil says he'll see what he can do.
quest_list.success_message: King Phil will see what he can do about arranging a carriage and four-in-hand.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oy... her wedding... Well, tell her I'll see what I can do.  What more can I say?

quest_list.notes: Kilye will go to Cloud and get Lilianna's measurements.
quest_list.success_message: Kilye agrees to make Lilianna's wedding dress.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, how nice of you to remember.  I'd be happy to do it.  I'll send a message up with Winchell for her lady-in-waiting.  For measurements.  The dress will be ready in a few days.  You can pay me for it on her behalf when it's ready.

quest_list.notes: Jean sells you a bolt of silk fabric
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but it looks like you can't afford this.  Come back when you can.
quest_list.success_message: Jean Stonwasht sold you a Bolt of Silk for $3,000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, one bolt of white silk.  Can't wait to see this dress.

quest_list.notes: Kilye takes the silk from you and begins work on the wedding dress.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have any silk at all!  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kilye the Bolt of Silk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  This is fine.  I've got Lilianna's measurements, so I'll get to work right away.

quest_list.notes: Kilye Will Deliver the Wedding Dress to Lilianna.
quest_list.success_message: Kilye will deliver the wedding dress herself.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great.  Well, see you at the wedding, I presume!

quest_list.notes: Give the Wedding Ring to Dorcas, Lilianna's lady in waiting.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, no!  Have you not gotten it?  Was it lost?  Did someone steal it?!  Please find it at once!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Wedding Ring to Dorcas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, such a lovely job that man does with rings and things.  Very nice.  Her Highness will be pleased.

quest_list.notes: Give the Cake to Dorcas.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, no!  You don't have my lady's wedding cake at all!  Please go fetch it at once.
quest_list.success_message: Dorcas calls the kitchen staff, and they take the Royal Cake off to the Royal Fridge.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  Oh dear!  How on Earth did you... My goodness, that's splendid!  I'll have the kitchen staff fetch it at once!

quest_list.notes: Dorcas Acknowledges that you've spoken to Phil (tracking for replies only).
quest_list.success_message: Dorcas acknowledges that you've spoken to King Phil.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, to be honest, we thought that would really be a bit excessive.  But thanks for trying anyway.

quest_list.notes: Dorcas Acknowledges that you've spoken to Kilye (tracking for replies only).
quest_list.success_message: Dorcas acknowledges that you've spoken to Kilye.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, I've seen the design; it's going to be ever so splendid!

quest_list.notes: You and Dorcas agree that you've done all you can.   (Princess can now be kidnapped.)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, that's not everything yet.  Please go get the rest of the Princess' wedding items seen to, and come back when you have news.
quest_list.success_message: Dorcas takes Lilianna's List and leaves the chamber.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, that's all the preparations underway, then.  Can I have that list back?  She likes to keep anything with her own handwriting on it.  Thanks.  You wait here and I'll go inform Her Highness.

quest_list.notes: You've brought Dorcas all the Things and Promises you can.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I'm afraid you're not done yet.  Please go do what's left, and then come back.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes, that's all of it.  I'll go an inform Her Ladyship at once.  Please wait here.

quest_list.notes: You correctly answer all 10 of Omand's questions.
quest_list.title: Omand's Horse Isle Quiz
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Omand's questions!  You earned $10,000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Congratulations! You have correctly answered all 10 of my questions.  Thank you for helping me pass the time.  I now need to finish packing for my next exploration.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Get sent to isle that has Cheshire's Body if you managed to get off before finding it
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, please do hurry.  It is rather uncomfortable being nothing but a head.

quest_list.notes: The Holiday Horse gives you a gift!
quest_list.success_message: You were given a package from the Holiday Horse.  In it was a Diamond Necklace!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This kind! (She hands you a small package.) Happy Holidays!

quest_list.notes: Dakota asks you to bring her 25 agates
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked to find Dakota 25 Agates.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: How about 25?

quest_list.notes: Agree to talk to Emma for Lelu about chocolate covered grasshoppers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Thank you so much.  Please let me know if she can help.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to talk to Emma about making chocolate covered grasshoppers for Lelu! You were given $500 for traveling expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much.  Please let me know if she can help.  You may need some money for traveling, so please take this.

quest_list.notes: Agree to petition King Phil for the use of Emma's services
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to petition King Phil for the use of Emma's services!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, make sure to come back and let me know if he agrees to let me do it and that way I can tell you what I need you to get.

quest_list.notes: King Phil asks for Struffoli and Milk
quest_list.success_message: You were asked to get King Phil Struffoli and Milk!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I heard there's this lady who has cows and fresh milk.  Why don'tcha see if she can tell ya where to get the struffoli?

quest_list.notes: Cinnamon sells you 2 liters of milk
quest_list.success_message: Cinnamon sold you a Jug of Milk for $100.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! I've put it in a jug for you, but you must get it back to King Phil quickly!

quest_list.notes: You agree to bring Cookie 5 honeycombs
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Cookie 5 Honeycombs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, I'll see you back here when you have them.

quest_list.notes: Give Cookie the 5 honeycomb.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not quite enough. I actually need 5 of them. Come back when you have the rest.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cookie the 5 Honeycombs she needs to make the Struffoli.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is perfect, thanks.  Why don't you come back in just a bit while I make these?

quest_list.notes: Cookie gives you struffoli to take to King Phil.
quest_list.success_message: You were given some Struffoli to take to King Phil.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It sure is.  Here you go. I hope he likes them!

quest_list.notes: Give King Phil the Struffoli and Milk
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That't wasn't what I asked ya for! Maybe you better go and check with that milk girl again!
quest_list.success_message: You brought King Phil the Struffoli and Jug of Milk and were granted permission to use Emma's services. King Phil sent you to see Emma.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well done, Sir Knight! You have my permission to use the services of Emma, Chocolatier Royal!

quest_list.notes: You agree to get Emma the items to make the Chocolate covered grasshoppers
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Emma 25 Small Sugar Chunks and 25 Grasshoppers. You were sent back to King Phil!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure can! Here you go and bring back those items as soon as you can!  Oh!  And I'll need $2500 for the grasshoppers.

quest_list.notes: You give Emma the grasshoppers and sugar chunks
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That isn't quite enough - please go and get the rest and come back when you have 25 of each and the $2500 to pay me.
quest_list.success_message: You were given 25 Chocolate Covered Grasshoppers to take back to Lelu!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect! This is just what I needed. This won't take long, so have a seat or browse through the shop while I finish them. (Emma goes into the back and comes back out a short while later.) Here you are. That will be $2500.

quest_list.notes: Give Lelu 25 Chocolate Covered Grasshoppers
quest_list.title: Lelu's Crunchy Quest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, these aren't quite what I was expecting - perhaps you could check with Emma again?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Lelu's Crunchy Quest! You were given $30,000 and 300 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is exactly what I wanted. Mino will be so thrilled to receive these. Please take this as a thank you for your wonderful deed.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Hans Congratulates you for winning his challenge
quest_list.title: Hans' Second Horse Breed Challenge
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this! (bug)
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Hans' Second Horse Breed Challenge! You earned $10,000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow!  You got all 10 of my questions right!  You are smart!  Here, take this $10,000 reward.
quest_list.author: Miranda/Rosela

quest_list.notes: Minnie asks you to get cardamom from The Spice Shoppe
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Cardamom from The Spice Shoppe. Minnie sent you to Spice Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks again.

quest_list.notes: Rika gives you a bag of cardamom for Minnie
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Bag of Cardamom for Minnie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She will want ground cardamom in a resealable bag, then. Here you go! Tell her I put it on her tab. Oh, and tell her thanks for her business!

quest_list.notes: The Princess Is Back  (Actions 1627 and 1636 chain to this.)
Give Minnie the cardamom
quest_list.title: Minnie's Spice Supply
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Rika must have forgotten to give it to you. Can you check with her again, please?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Minnie's Spice Supply.  You earned $2000, 50 quest points and a loaf of Minnie's Nut Bread.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks again!  Here is a little appreciation and a loaf of my famous nut bread!
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Minnie sends you to Spice Isle
quest_list.success_message: You were sent to Spice Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Rika send you back to Minne's
quest_list.success_message: You were sent back to Minnie's!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure I can! Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Ransom the Princess!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Parrots can count, you know!  Fifty!  And five Diamonds!  Away, before I feed you Lutefisk!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Polly Parrot 50 Pearls and 5 Diamonds.  The princess should be brought home.  Perhaps you should go to Cloud Isle and wait for her.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll let me friend know they're here!  Don't stay around or he won't come!  Now get ye gone, we'll send yer pretty home! Raaaaaaaaaaaaaak!

quest_list.notes: Lilianna's Reward
quest_list.title: The Royal Wedding
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Royal Wedding!  You were given a Pomeranian Dog and earned 350 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Accept this reward from my hands, Errant, and come upon the appointed day to the Royal Wedding you have helped arrange.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Princess Lilianna makes her exit.
quest_list.success_message: With a rustle of fine silks, Princess Lilianna leaves the audience chamber.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Then say nothing.  Just come for the wedding!  Goodbye now!

quest_list.notes: Search For Clues In The Castle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search carefully, but find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Searching the otherwise pristinely clean carpet, you can just make out the outlines of dusty boots with a curiously pointed toe.  Time to check outside!

quest_list.notes: Search Outside the Castle for clues
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Whatever might have been here has long since faded away.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah!  Here in the slowly billowing cloud are the tracks of pointed-toed boots, heading east!

quest_list.notes: Search for Prints around the Tree
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Alas, whatever tracks were here have long since faded away.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The boot tracks stop here--next to many hoofprints, as of a horse impatiently standing.  And on either side of the hoofprints, two deep gouges made by something long and thin!

quest_list.notes: Find a broken feather tip!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Raking carefully amongst the wisps of cloud, you uncover a piece of... the tip of a large feather?  Definitely a clue here!

quest_list.notes: Obtain the Clue of the Red-Stained Feather!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, that?  Don't know.  She had it all over her muzzle, though.  Guess it was from something she was eating when she was... wherever she was.  Rubbed her face on me and got it on this.  Kind of insisted on doing it, too...
quest_list.success_message: You have gotten the Clue of the Red-Stained Feather!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that?  Don't know.  She had it all over her muzzle, though.  Guess it was from something she was eating when she was... wherever she was.  Rubbed her face on me and got it on this.  Kind of insisted on doing it, too...

quest_list.notes: Find the fingerprints, hear the princess!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Behind the scoreboard, you see a small area where some dust has been moved away--fingermarks!

quest_list.notes: The Princess Flees!
quest_list.success_message: You have rescued the princess!  Best to head back to the castle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, no!  I'll call Falcor, he'll come and get me!  Meet me back at the castle!  Hurry!  Be careful!  Go now!

quest_list.notes: Princess Lilianna gives you a perk for being such a brave knight...
quest_list.success_message: Princess Lilianna bestows upon thee a likeness of herself in quartz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: O Knight of the Realm of Hotzeplotz, take firstly this Crystal Statue, wrought in my likeness, that thou mayst remember my gratitude!

quest_list.notes: You Decide To Take Action on this Princess Business (actions 1567 and 1566 chain to this)
Santa gives a snowman for free once.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I have already given you your gift.
quest_list.success_message: Santa has given you a Snowman companion!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  It won't last forever, but it's still helpful!
quest_list.author: Joe

quest_list.notes: Agree to find ingredients for Rose
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to check around and try to find Rose a pound of Nopales and 1/2 cup of Dried Cilantro.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You would do that? Oh, thank you sooo much! I need just a small bunch of nopales - about a pound - and about 1/2 cup of dried cilantro.

quest_list.notes: Buy cilantro from Rika
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you don't have enough money. It will be $50.  Why don't you come back when you have it?
quest_list.success_message: You were given dried Cilantro to take back to Rose.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, here you go.  That will be $50. Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Get nopales from Wynona
quest_list.success_message: You were given a pound of Nopales for Rose.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No charge! Tell her it's a wedding gift - of sorts. I think this will work perfectly for her!

quest_list.notes: Talk to Mrs. Claus
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to talk to Mrs. Claus and find out if she needs any help.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  She should be in the kitchen, if I am correct.

quest_list.notes: Give Rose the ingredients she's missing
quest_list.title: Rose's Missing Ingredients
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, this isn't what I needed. Perhaps you could keep checking?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Rose's Missing Ingredients! You earned a Sapphire Necklace, a Topaz Necklace, and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much! I know it isn't much, but please take these trinkets from Will's sailing days.
quest_list.author: Jule

quest_list.notes: Agree to get ingrediants for Mrs. Claus
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Mrs. Claus ingredients for her soup and received $1,000 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Windy in Crystalton should have the carrots I need, Clementine in Hotton should have the noodles, and Nana in Tropicton has the best celery!  Here's $1,000 to help cover travel costs.

quest_list.notes: Recieve Carrots from Windy.
quest_list.success_message: You received five Carrots from Windy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, goodness, no! I just received a shipment yesterday, so I have plenty to spare. (She rummages around in the back and then comes back out.) Here you go!

quest_list.notes: Recieve noodles from Clementine
quest_list.success_message: You received two Packages of Noodles from Clementine.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! Two packages of noodles.  See you later.

quest_list.notes: Recieve Celery from Nana
quest_list.success_message: You have received Celery from Nana.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  Be sure you get that to her before it spoils.

quest_list.notes: Give ingrediants to Mrs. Claus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it seems that you are missing something.  I need all three ingredients to make the soup.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mrs. Claus 2 Packages of Noodles and some Celery.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these look perfect!  Now for the carrots.  Do you have 5?

quest_list.notes: Give Mrs. Claus the carrots for Santa's soup
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have 5 yet?  Did you eat some on the way?  I really need those 5.  Could you get some more, please?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mrs. Claus 5 Carrots.  She gave you a Bowl of Soup for Santa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you! Now I can start on that soup for Santa. Wait here a moment and I will give you some to take to him. (She goes into the kitchen and a few minutes later brings back some soup.) Just give Santa this, please? Thank you!

quest_list.notes: Give the Soup to Santa
quest_list.title: Soup for Santa
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Soup for Santa!  You earned $5500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  I should be feeling better in no time!
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: One of Pookies Trolls appears.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hey, Troll!  Get over here an' troll!
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
*SNAP!* (For the first time, Princess Pookie actually speaks.) HEY! GUARD!
(Suddenly, from a door to the right, a large troll appears, and stands in front of the pile of shoes, behind which the baby dragon is held.)

quest_list.notes: Pookie sends you off to get a new pair of shoes.
quest_list.success_message: Princess Pookie would like a new pair of shoes in return for the freedom of the baby dragon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The princess' jaw drops as if she can't believe how you just read her mind.) Yeah, like, yeah, really! And *SNAP!* not just plain old shoes. Remember, I'm a princess!

quest_list.notes: Thorn asks for stuff to make Pookie's shoes with.
quest_list.success_message: Thorne needs two Leather Pieces and two Rubies to make shoes for Princess Pookie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Stuff, oh, I always need stuff.  Could you get me two leather pieces and two... uhm... rubies?

quest_list.notes: Thorne begins work on Pookie's Shoes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you haven't got what I need: two leather pieces and two rubies.  Come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Thorne 2 Leather Pieces and 2 Rubies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do, thanks.  Why don't you go wander around the isle for a while, while I work?

quest_list.notes: Thorne Sells You Some Shoes...
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but that's the price.  My work is worth something, you know.

got dragon, u go bibi.
