quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've found a scrap of paper with a clue written on it!

quest_list.notes: Find the Blue Dragon's Treasure!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig carefully, but turn up nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: As you start to dig in this spot, your shovel hits something solid.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have found the Blue Dragon's Treasure Box.  Unfortunately, you can't open it.  Perhaps the Blue Dragon can open it.

quest_list.notes: Give the Blue Dragon his chest and one of the scraps.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I have the chest and first scrap of paper.  I'll need the other scraps, though.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Blue Dragon his Treasure Box, and one of the slips of paper you found.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, that's my chest. I'll take those slips of paper, too. (He takes the first scrap of paper, and, breathing on it, sets it on fire. It soon burns away.)

quest_list.notes: Give the blue dragon paper scraps 2 and 3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What fun.  You did give me those already.  Next, please.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Blue Dragon two more scraps of paper, which he set on fire and blew around the cave.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, give me two more, this is fun.

quest_list.notes: Give the Blue dragon paper scraps 4 and 5, get your reward.
quest_list.title: The Blue Dragon's Treasure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What?  You lost those, too?  Sheesh!  Go find them!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Blue Dragon's Treasure!  You earned 50 Blue Crystal Shards, a Diamond Necklace and 350 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Thank you! And now, your reward!
(The Blue Dragon bites at the lock; the chest opens and 50 blue crystal shards fall out!)
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: You agree to get Carlotta dinner.
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get Carlotta dinner.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I love the idea of ordering dinner! Hurry back soon.

quest_list.notes: Carlotta trades 25 scorpions for a diamond
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough. I said 25 scorpions at a time.
quest_list.success_message: You traded 25 scorpions for a Diamond.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A pleasure doing business with you! Time for a belly fiesta!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about the game buttons on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oops. Better read that question again.
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 2 chunks of Silver Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Terrific! You can't see wild horses with your telescope, either. Here's some silver ore for you. Let's go to the next question.

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about Bird Isle on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Trying to guess your way through it, huh? Try again.
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 2 chunks of Copper Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're right! Here's some copper ore for you. Let's go to the next question.

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about an artist’s pallet on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry! Try again.
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 2 chunks of Copper Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're right! Here's some copper ore for you. Look at the buttons about halfway down your screen for the next question.

quest_list.notes: John O'Lantern sends you off on the first of three deliveries.
quest_list.success_message: You were given 4 Sacks of Roasted Pumpkin Seeds.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Take 2 sacks of the roasted pumpkin seeds to Windy Pick in Crystalton and 2 sacks to Zeke Sacker in Witherton.  They already know what I need in return.

quest_list.notes: Accept the quest for Vixen's Lost Calf
quest_list.success_message: Frilly Lilly has asked you to go find Vixen's lost calf.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, when calves are scared, they huddle up in bushes or under pine trees, very small, and they stay very, very still until their mother finds them.  That's all I know.

quest_list.notes: Zeke Sacker gets his delivery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did you forget my delivery?
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the Sack of Pumpkin Seeds and were given two Bolts of Cotton Cloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Tell Jack thanks for the seeds and give him this cloth.

quest_list.notes: Windy Pick gets her delivery.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Do you want to go back and get my delivery?
quest_list.success_message: You delivered two Sacks of Pumpkin Seeds and were given a Box of Carving Tools.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You can put them over there. (She motions towards the corner.) Here. Bring this back to him.

quest_list.notes: John gets his supplies and sends you out again.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I told to to come back when you made both deliveries.
quest_list.success_message: You gave John O'Lantern the Bolt of Cloth and the Box of Tools and were given 4 Bags of Pumpkin Seeds for planting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for these, now the next deliveries are going to Flo Stemson in Appleton and Rose Thorne in Hotton.

quest_list.notes: Flo gets her delivery.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did you forget my delivery?
quest_list.success_message: You delivered 2 Bags of Pumpkin Seeds and were given 3 Bags of Dried Indigo.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Put them down anywhere.  Oh, and here, bring these back to Jack for me, okay?

quest_list.notes: Rose gets her delivery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don't you think you should go get my seeds?
quest_list.success_message: You delivered 2 Bags of Pumpkin Seeds and were given 2 Bags of Dried Cochineal.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have no idea! (She winks at you.) Put them by the wall, thanks. Oh, and give these to Jack when you get back.

quest_list.notes: Find tracks 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search all over, but find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Searching carefully amid the pile of snow and fallen pine needles, you find a spot where a reindeer calf could have bedded down; but not for long.  Tracks lead away to the south.

quest_list.notes: Find Tracks 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search all over, but find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Using your shovel to pry away a frozen piece of windblown sailcloth, you see reindeer calf tracks running off to the west.

quest_list.notes: Find Tracks 3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search all over, but find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the fallen needles carefully, you see that this animal's bed (whatever animal slept here) was also used by a reindeer calf, but briefly.  Tracks go away to the northwest.

quest_list.notes: Find Vixen's Calf
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search all over, but find nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You see a mound of snow piled against the trees, shivering!  You carefully shovel the snow away.  There you find a tiny reindeer calf, cold and frightened, but glad to see you!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've found Vixen's calf!  Better get her back to Frilly Lilly quick!

quest_list.notes: Return Vixen's Calf
quest_list.title: Vixen's Lost Calf
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, NO!  How could you have lost a calf once you'd found it?!  Oh, no oh no oh NO!  Please go find her!
quest_list.success_message: You've completed Vixen's Lost Calf!  You've earned $5000 and 25 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, she's healthy and safe!  Oh, thank you so, so VERY much!  Please accept this reward!  Oh, Vixen will be thrilled!  I must run off at once and return her calf to her!  Bye!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Jack send you out one mo' time!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I said finish both deliveries before you come back... okay?
quest_list.success_message: You gave John 2 Bags of Ground Cochineal and 3 Bags of Dried Indigo. You were given 2 Sacks of Roasted Seeds and 2 Bags Planting Seeds.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just put them over near my work table. I've got the last part of the deliveries ready for you.  Albert Junker on Hoof Isle gets the roasted seeds and Calla Lilly in Shellton gets the planting seeds.  Got that?

quest_list.notes: You agree to take Roxie's quiz
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry. While that might be a true statement, it isn't the correct answer. Try again!
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to take Roxie's quiz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Terrific! Let's get started. Look at the buttons about halfway down your screen. Click on your MAP button and move your mouse around the islands. When you've gotten the hang of it, come back and we'll start the quiz.

quest_list.notes: You answer a question about Hare Isle on Roxie's quiz.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Try looking at the map again.
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 2 chunks of Copper Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're right! Here's some copper ore for you. Let's go to the next question.

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about the Players button on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Try again. Which one is NOT true?
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 2 chunks of Silver Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's correct. No one can see what you have in your inventory except you. Here's some silver ore for you. Let's go to the next question.

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about chatting rules on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 1 Copper Ore and 1 Gold Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sharing personal information that might allow someone to find you is strictly against the rules. Telling someone which country you live in is considered safe. Here's some copper and gold ore for you. Let's go to the next question.

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about the New Players Guide on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 1 Copper Ore and 1 Gold Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You bet! Here's some copper and gold ore for you. Ready for the next question?

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about Moderators on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 1 Copper Ore and 1 Gold Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're right.  They can't give you money, horses, ranches or make you a moderator. It's best not to even ask for those things. Here's some copper and gold ore for you. Only two more questions to go!

quest_list.notes: You answered a question about quests on Roxie's quiz!
quest_list.success_message: You answered correctly and earned 1 Copper Ore and 1 Gold Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're right.  Here's some copper and gold ore for you. Ready for the last question?

quest_list.notes: You finished Roxie's quiz! [UNTITLED: Roxie's Welcome Isle Quiz]
quest_list.success_message: You completed the quiz. You earned a Seashell Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's right! Acquiring money is easy. Find things and sell them, do quests, play mini-games. Here's a seashell necklace for your hard work.  If you haven't already, you might want to talk to Willy and Ebenezer. Enjoy the game!

quest_list.notes: Albert Junker gets his delivery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don't you think you need to go back and get my seeds?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Albert 2 Sacks of Pumpkin Seeds and were given 2 Boxes of Wax.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You can put them down any place, doesn't matter. Now where did I put Jack's supplies? (Looking around the store scratching his head.) Right, here it is and here you go!

quest_list.notes: Missing Calf Clue No. 0
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looking very carefully, you find what appear to be reindeer calf tracks, heading southwest.

quest_list.notes: Calla Lilly gets her delivery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You really need to go back and get my seeds.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cally Lilly 2 Bags of Pumpkin Seeds and were given 2 Crates of Assorted Flowers and Greens.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You can put the seeds over by the door, thank you.  And here, take these two crates back to Jack for me, okay?

quest_list.notes: Jack gets his supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're supposed to complete both deliveries before you come back here!
quest_list.success_message: You have given John his Wax and Flowers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're doing an unbelievable job for me, too bad you don't live around here.  I'd love to make you a full time employee!

quest_list.notes: Jack rewards you.
quest_list.title: John O'Lantern's Multiple Deliveries
quest_list.success_message: You Completed John O'Lantern's Multiple Deliveries.  You earned a Homemade Jumping Shirt and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's a pity, you would have been a valued addition to my little operation here.  Please accept this shirt, I made it just for you.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Fin tells you where to find Sam McGee
quest_list.success_message: You have been told that you can find Sam McGee on Loch Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, you must be thinking of Sam McGee; he moved to Loch Isle. That is where you will find him.

quest_list.notes: Accept Mino's Quest
quest_list.success_message: You have been asked to pick up flowers from Helena and trellis from Arthur. You were given $3500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm so excited. Lelu is going to love this. Here's some money to pay for your expenses.

quest_list.notes: Get plants Mino ordered
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You can't pay for these now.
quest_list.success_message: Helena has given you a Crate of Hummingbird Plants Mino ordered.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go. Make sure to tell Mino to amend the soil before planting these, and to water well until he sees new growth.

quest_list.notes: Order trellis for Mino
quest_list.success_message: You ordered the trellis from Arthur, and agreed to pay him $1500 and 50 chunks of Iron Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Don't forget, I'll need all the ore and the money when you come to pick up the trellis.

quest_list.notes: Pick-up trellis for Mino
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I need. Don't forget, I need both the 50 chunks of iron ore and the $1500.
quest_list.success_message: You were given the Wrought Iron Trellis from Arthur for $1500 and 50 chunks of Iron Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! I hope this pleases Mino.

quest_list.notes: Pick-up fertilizer for Mino
quest_list.success_message: You are handed three Bags of Manure.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. No charge.  Tell Mino I've got plenty more where that came from if he needs more ever!

quest_list.notes: Give Mino the plants and trellis
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that. I need both the trellis and the plants.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Trellis and Crate of Plants to Mino. You earned $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Splendid! Arthur does such beautiful work. Thank you. And look at these plants! Wonderful, wonderful. And here's a little something for your trouble.

quest_list.notes: Give Mino the fertilizer
quest_list.title: Mino's Anniversary Gift Part 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need the manure, plants and the trellis to get this part of the sanctuary done.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mino's Anniversary Gift Part 1.  You earned $3000 and 100 quests points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is great!  Thank you so much.  Let me know when you have some time.  I would love help with the second part.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Agree to get manure for Mino
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get Mino some manure.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much. I can't set these plants in the ground without it.

quest_list.notes: Accept Mino's Anniversary Gift Part 2
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Mino on the second part of his plan. He gives you a list of the things he needs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fantastic! Thank you so much. This is a worthy cause. I assure you.

quest_list.notes: You get a crate of spoiled fruit.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Crate of Spoiled Fruit. By the smell of it, you'll probably attract every fruit fly within 20 miles!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm sure the surprise will be wonderful!

quest_list.notes: Mino checks the list to see if you've gotten everything.
quest_list.title: Mino's Anniversary Gift Part 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have given me everything on the list yet.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mino's Anniversary Gift Part 2.  You earned $10,000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful! You've gotten everything on the list. I'll take the list, since you won't be needing it anymore. If you have some time, let me know since now all I need is the crowning touch.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: You get a basket of moss and lichen.
quest_list.success_message: You get a basket of moss and lichen.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Twig fondly pats the moss and lichen in the straw basket.) I hope the hummingbirds like it.

quest_list.notes: You get a small handful of downy feathers.
quest_list.success_message: You get a small handful of Downy Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go -- no charge. And have a great day!

quest_list.notes: You get a hank of horsehair
quest_list.success_message: You get a Hank of Horsehair. This should be perfect for Mino.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go. No charge. You can tell Mino I've got plenty more where that came from!

quest_list.notes: You give Mino the crate of spoiled fruit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You give Mino the crate of spoiled fruit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect! And look, there are already flies on the fruit.

quest_list.notes: You give Mino the skein of spider's silk.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You give Mino the skein of spider's silk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is fantastic. I don't know how I would have gotten this far in my plans if it weren't for your help.

quest_list.notes: You give Mino the moss & lichen.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You give Mino the Moss and Lichen.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is just what the hummingbirds need to create their nests. Thank you!

quest_list.notes: You give Mino the bag of downy feathers.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You give Mino the Downy Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful, wonderful! These will make the nests soft and fluffly for the eggs and hatchlings.

quest_list.notes: You give Mino the hank of horse hair.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You give Mino the Hank of Horsehair.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is wonderful! This should be perfect. Just perfect.

quest_list.notes: You agree to get the hummingbirds.
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get the hummingbirds from Suhai. You are given $6000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: As soon as you get them, come back immediately. They will be distressed to be caged. (Mino places his hand gently on your shoulder.) I can't express my appreciation enough. Here's travel money and $6000 to pay for the birds.

quest_list.notes: Get the hummingbirds.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You no have money Mino promised. Come back with $5000.
quest_list.success_message:
**POOF** You find yourself at the edge of the jungle.
You have the hummingbirds and must hurry back to Mino.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She carefully hands you a delicate cage of jewel-colored hummingbirds.) This tribesman take you now. Jungle shortcut, so you travel more swiftly, safely. Take care of birds. You give your word. On your life.

quest_list.notes: Give the hummingbirds to Mino.
quest_list.title: Mino's Anniversary Gift Part 3
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mino's Anniversary Gift Part 3.  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Mino beams with joy as he carefully takes the cage from you.) I am indebted to you. Thank you so much.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Fourfingered Frank asks for your help
quest_list.success_message: You've been asked to find some books for Fourfingered Frank.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: They be a three book set and the title is "The Pirate's Own Book" by a landlubber named Charles Ellms. Ye be on yer own to find them, I've been here so long I don't know where ye should be lookin' to buy them.

quest_list.notes: You Search the rocks and Find the Admiral's sextant
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking carefully around the rocks, you see something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It looks like you found the Admiral's Sextant.

quest_list.notes: Accept quest to find Admiral Leonard's sextant
quest_list.success_message: You agree to help the Admiral find his sextant that he left on some rocks nearby.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be great.  I'd appreciate your help.

quest_list.notes: Mortimer gives you a treasure to bury and tells you where to go.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave it to you!  I don't have another one!  Now get you gone!
quest_list.success_message: Mortimer has given you a treasure chest, which you are to bury for him on the furthest south and east part of the south-east starfish arm.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, here you go.  Here's my treasure chest.  Made it myself.  Won't tell you what's in it.  Just take good care of it, and bury it deepdown, on the furthest tip of the south-east arm.  You'll know when you dig in the right place.

quest_list.notes: Meet Pearl, the geoduck
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig carefully, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You dig carefully, and when you hit something hard, you set the treasure down in the hole.  But there's something else in there.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have uncovered a very large (and fairly ugly!) Geoduck.

quest_list.notes: Pearl won't give the treasure back.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You shout down the hole, but there is no response.
quest_list.success_message: Pearl the Geoduck has disappeared with Mortimer's Treasure.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No! You put it here! MINE! (Pearl burrows back into her hole, well out of reach.)

quest_list.notes: Mortimer gives you a prize.
quest_list.title: Mortimer's Treasure
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mortimer's Treasure Quest.  You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, well.  Oh, well, that's okay, at least the treasure is buried.  Hah!  Yeah, it's buried good now!  Here, have this as a reward for your work!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: You agree to deliver invitations for Elvira's Tea Party
quest_list.success_message: You are given two invitations to deliver -- one for Carlotta and one for Morticia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll be waiting for their responses.

quest_list.notes: You deliver an invitation to Morticia.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered an invitation to Morticia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I wonder what she has planned. I'll be sure to attend -- so I can watch every move she makes!

quest_list.notes: You delivered an invitation to Carlotta
quest_list.success_message: You delivered an invitation to Carlotta.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Tell her I'll be there. Si! With my eyes open and fangs ready! She'd better not try anything sneaky.

quest_list.notes: Elvira gives you the spider's silk for Mino.
quest_list.title: Elvira's Tea Party
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You need to deliver BOTH of the invitations. Come back when you've done that.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Elvira's Tea Party.  You earned a Dinosaur Bone, a Skein of Spider's Silk and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Lovely!  The party will be grand.  Here's the silk.  Don't lose it!  Oh, take this bone for helping me.  It's been lying around here for ages.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: You accept the challenge of getting burley ingredient for Sam Mcgee
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: When you bring them back I can make the burley and then I can catch the barramundi fish. Oh, it will be like the old days.
quest_list.success_message: Sam McGee gives you a Shopping List.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: When you bring them back I can make the burley and then I can catch the barramundi fish. Oh, it will be like the old days.

quest_list.notes: Sam Mcgee accepts 15 little fish from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have 15 little fish.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sam 15 Little Fish.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: We will grind these up to make a base for the burley.

quest_list.notes: Sam Mcgee accepts a bag of flour from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have the flour yet.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sam a Bag of Flour.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for the flour.

quest_list.notes: Sam Mcgee accepts a bottle of tuna oil from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you don't have any tuna oil.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sam a Bottle of Tuna Oil.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Mmm baramundi fish... love this stuff.

quest_list.notes: Sam Mcgee accepts a bag of cat treats from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't seem to have any cat treats.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sam the Bag of Cat Treats.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, and the final secret ingredient...

quest_list.notes: Sam McGee accepts 15 worms from you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you don't have all 15 earthworms.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sam 15 Earthworms.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, and we do need bait for the hooks.

quest_list.notes: Sam McGee checks to be sure you gave him everything and takes list
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have given me everything yet.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sam his Shopping List back.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It looks like we have everything that we need.  I'll make the burley and go catch the fish. Come back later and I will have the barramundi fish for you.

quest_list.notes: Beatrice Bibliophile sends you to Pheobe Wares
quest_list.success_message: Beatrice Bibliophile told you to go talk to Pheobe Wares.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, I don't keep a record of the titles, just the subjects.  I'm afraid you'll have to ask Pheobe what titles she might still have.

quest_list.notes: Michaela McGraw-Hill sends you to Simon Goods
quest_list.success_message: Michaela McGraw-Hill sent you to talk to Simon Goods.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over a ledger book.) I see something by Charles Ellms was sent to Mr. Goods this past shipment, but I can't quite make out the title. You should ask him for more information.

quest_list.notes: Rowena Roget sends you to Trixie Traderton.
quest_list.success_message: Rowena Roget sent you to talk to Trixie Traderton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: "The Pirates Own Book" (going back to the ledger) Ellms...Ellms...ah ha! Here it is, yes those books were in last month's shipment. Go ask Trixie Traderton if she still has them

quest_list.notes: Trixie Traderton sends you to Blythe Booty
quest_list.success_message: Trixie Traderton told you to go see Blythe Booty.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm sure she doesn't sell a lot of books, but she put the word out that she was looking for books about pirates, so I sent them on to her.

quest_list.notes: Blythe Booty offers to sell you information
quest_list.success_message: Blythe Booty told you it will take 5 Emeralds to get your information.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let me see... (First stroking her chin, then twirling her hair.) Oh, I think 5 emeralds should nicely do the trick. Come back with the emeralds, and I'll tell ye what ye want to know.

quest_list.notes: Blythe Booty spills the beans.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye tryin' to welch on our deal?  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Blythe Booty 5 Emeralds.  She sent you to talk to Shimerin Shimm.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye be a swabby of ye word, and now for yer information.  Shimerin Shimm took them books.

quest_list.notes: Shimerin Shimm asks for your help.
quest_list.success_message: Shimerin Shimm handed you the books and a note for Fourfingered Frank.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye matey, it be worth a try.

quest_list.notes: Sam gives you 15 Barramundi Fish
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like I don't have any fish for you.
quest_list.success_message: You were given 15 Barramundi Fish for Louis Penguin.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here they are.  Say hello to Louis Penguin for me, and let him know I can always catch fish for him.

quest_list.notes: Louis rewards you for getting him barramundi fish
quest_list.title: Barramundi Fish for Louis Penguin
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have any barramundi fish.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Barramundi Fish for Louis Penguin.  You earned a Diamond Necklace, 2 Diamonds and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You bewdy mate!! I'm going to really enjoy these. Here is a reward for all your help. (You can tell that he is very much looking forward to eating these barramundi fish.)
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: You accept to help Rusty Cage to get some Cat Treats supplies.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Great. You need to speak to Ginger Craft. She will send you with a package.  For your trouble, I'll let you have yours for free.
quest_list.success_message: You agree to go see Ginger Craft on Hare Isle and get some more cat treat supplies for Rusty Cage.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great. You need to speak to Ginger Craft. She will send you with a package.  For your trouble, I'll let you have yours for free.

quest_list.notes: Ginger Craft gives you a case of cat treats for Rusty Cage
quest_list.success_message: Ginger gives you a Case of Cat Treats for Rusty Cage.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure.  Here you go.  I'll just put it on his account.

quest_list.notes: Rusty Cage takes the case of cat treats and gives you in exchange a bag
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you don't have any cat treats.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Bag of Cat Treats for the Case of Cat Treats.  You were also given $800 for travel expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for your help.  Here is your bag of cat treats and something for your travel.

quest_list.notes: You annoy Stinky Breeches Vincent
quest_list.success_message: **Thunk** Stinky Breeches Vincent just kicked you right out of the lighthouse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I knew it! If ye smells like a landlubber, a landlubber ye be!

quest_list.notes: Cara Cook Sells you a bag of flour.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have enough money right now.  Please come back when you have $50.
quest_list.success_message: Cara sells you a Bag of Flour for $50.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, dear.  That will be $50.

quest_list.notes: Ernie angler Sells you a bottle of tuna oil
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You do not have enough money right now.  Please come back when you have $50.
quest_list.success_message: Ernie sells you a Bottle of Tuna Oil for $50.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Fourfingered Frank gets his books
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aarrgg, ye said ye had me books and something extra... Where are they?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Fourfingered Frank his books and the note.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Reading his note.) Shiver me timbers, I would never have thought that a fine lass like her would fancy an old sea dog like me.

quest_list.notes: Frank asks you to bring a gift to Shimm
quest_list.success_message: Fourfingered Frank has given you a gift and a message for Shimerin Shimm.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yer a right proper mate! Would ye bring this to Miss Shimm (He reaches into a small chest on the table and hands you an exquisite Star Sapphire pendant.) and tell her I'll be comin' to call soon.

quest_list.notes: Shimerin Shimm gets her gift
quest_list.success_message: You gave Shimerin Shimm her gift and she asked you to give Fourfingered Frank her answer. You were given an Amethyst Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Staring at the pendant.) Ooo, ye made this old lass as giddy as a schoolgirl, thank ye! (She gives you a kiss on the cheek and an amethyst necklace.) Please tell Frank it's a date!

quest_list.notes: Fourfingered Frank thanks you, right proper
quest_list.title: Fourfingered Frank's Request
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Fourfingered Frank's Request.  You earned 3 Ruby Necklaces and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here ye be, matey. I haven't thanked ye proper like for all ye done fer me. (He reaches into that chest again and gives you three ruby necklaces.)
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Give Mino the manure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the manure yet.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Mino 3 Bags of Manure.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Three bags! Perfect. I really appreciate you getting it.

quest_list.notes: Admiral Leonard rewards you for finding his sextant.
quest_list.title: Admiral Leonard's Sextant
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have a sextant.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Admiral Leonard's Sextant.  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you very much.  My family and I are indebted to you.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Viola wants help with her recipe
quest_list.success_message: Viola asked you for 50 Thimbleberries and gave you $1000 for travel money.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thimbleberries don't grow around here, it's too cold.  Could you go to the lower islands and bring me back, say, 50 fresh thimbleberries?  That should be enough, and here, take this for your travels.

quest_list.notes: Viola gets her thimbleberries
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, child, but I need all of the thimbleberries.  Come back when you've got all of them.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Viola 50 Thimbleberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, child.  These will do wonderfully well.

quest_list.notes: Viola rewards you
quest_list.title: Viola's Recipe
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Viola's Recipe Quest.  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, thank you, dearie.  I have everything else I need.  You've been such a help to me, here, take this and be sure to come back another time and we can have some thimbleberry jam together!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Just Gus
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Just Gus some Strawberry Pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd be much obliged, matey.

quest_list.notes: You get a strawberry pie.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you don't seem to have what I need.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Strawberry Pie for 25 Strawberries and 7 Small Sugar Chunks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These strawberries are perfect! Here you go, one freshly baked strawberry pie. Enjoy it.

quest_list.notes: You give Just Gus the pie.
quest_list.title: Just Gus Wants Pie
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arggg. Ye don't have no strawberry pie!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Just Gus' Quest. You earned 3 Rubies, 2 Fried Big Fish and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arggg! It be just like me dear old mum's. Here be a bit a glitter and dinner fer yer troubles.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Santa asks you for supplies.
quest_list.success_message: Santa asked you for 25 Logs of wood and 10 Logs of Ebony Wood.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My supply of carving wood is running low. Bring me 25 normal logs and 10 logs of ebony wood, and I'll give you one of my carvings.  Okay?

quest_list.notes: You agree to listen to Just Gus' sad story
quest_list.success_message: You sit down to listen.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be right kindly of ye.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Barrett has the boots
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don't look like ya got enough money. Go on and leave me be!
quest_list.success_message: You were given a new pair of pirate boots that need to be waterproofed.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Karl can help you out with the waterproofing. He lives up in Whiskerton.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: You agree to deliver a letter to Gus.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Letter for Just Gus.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is the best I can do. I hope you understand.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get new boots for Smelly Toes
quest_list.success_message: You agree to find boots for Smelly Toes Monroe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Barrett be makin' pirate boots -- on the side. So don'cha be spreadin' the word.  Lessin' ye be lookin' ta dance at the point of me cutlass!
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: You deliver a letter to Just Gus.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arggg. Ye don't have no letter fer me!
quest_list.success_message: You delivered the Letter to Just Gus.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Just Gus reads the letter.) Arggg! Curses and choppy seas! She be sayin' Michelle ain't gonna be found by the likes of me. Says Willamena might be havin' some suggestions. (He scribbles a few words on the letter.) Could ye take this to her?

quest_list.notes: You agree to deliver a letter to Willamena for Gus
quest_list.success_message: You agree to deliver a letter to Willamena. Just Gus gave you 5 Rubies for your efforts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: If ye could deliver this to Willamena, I'd be much obliged, matey. Ain't got no notion of where she be. I be leavin' that for you to figure out. (He hands you the letter he's written on.) Here's a bit a glitter for all yer troubles.

quest_list.notes: Accept finding Zoe for Cara Cook.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You can't look for Zoe at the moment.
quest_list.success_message: You agree to help Cara find her niece, Zoe.  She thinks she might be around some flowers nearby.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that would be great if ye' could do tha'.  She's very fond of flowers.  You might find 'er 'round some.

quest_list.notes: You accept to speak to Cara on behalf of Zoe
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You can't talk to Cara Cook right now.
quest_list.success_message: You tell Zoe that you're going to talk to Cara Cook on her behalf.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Would you please? I would be happy if you could. I really want to go back.

quest_list.notes: Cara Cook tells you to let Zoe know that eveything will be alright.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You can't go and speak to Zoe at the moment.
quest_list.success_message: You tell Cara that you will go and speak to Zoe and assure her that it's okay for her to come home.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please tell Zoe that I'm not cross and that she can come 'ome.  We will sort out tha' little problem when she gets back.

quest_list.notes: Zoe agrees to go back to her Aunt Cara Cooks House.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Zoe says she can't go back right now.
quest_list.success_message: Zoe feels reassured that her aunt isn't cross with her and agrees to return to the food store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  I feel much better now.  I'll see you when you get back to the store.

quest_list.notes: Cara Cook Rewards you for finding her niece Zoe
quest_list.title: Cara's Lost Niece
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't seem to have found Zoe.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cara's Lost Niece.  You earned $1000, a Gold Chain and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for helping me find Zoe.  I really am grateful.  Please accept these things as a token of my appreciation.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Accept to help Cara cook to get some more truffles
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get Truffles from Fritz on Saddle Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be wonderful.  I get them from Fritz on Saddle Isle.

quest_list.notes: You accept to help Fritz get 6 more truffles for Cara Cook
quest_list.success_message: Fritz lends you his truffle pig, Ruffles, to go and find 6 Truffles in the forest east of here.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No problem, I look forward to seeing you when you get back.  Take care of Ruffles.

quest_list.notes: You rake the first truffle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found your first Truffle.  Only 5 more to go.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Ruffles seems pleased with himself, and scampers off to find another truffle.)

quest_list.notes: You rake the second truffle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found your second Truffle.  Only 4 more to go.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Ruffles seems pretty pleased with himself, and he heads off to look for more.)

quest_list.notes: You rake the third truffle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found your third Truffle.  Only 3 more to go.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (You're starting to think that Ruffles is enjoying this. It's more like a game than work for him.)

quest_list.notes: You rake the fouth truffle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found your fourth Truffle.  Only 2 more to go.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (With another Oink! Ruffles darts off to find another truffle.)

quest_list.notes: You rake the fifth truffle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found your fifth Truffle.  Only 1 more to go.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Ruffles dashes off again to seek out another truffle.)

quest_list.notes: You rake the sixth truffle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found your sixth Truffle.  Time to return to Fritz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (With the last truffle found, Ruffles runs off back in the direction of Fritz's House)

quest_list.notes: Find bonus find when looking for truffles.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You uncovered a Ruby Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (This pig is really excited with this find. You wonder if he would rather be a prospector.)

quest_list.notes: Fritz checks that you have six truffles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have six truffles yet.
quest_list.success_message: You have found six Truffles and you hand back Ruffles to Fritz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, all six, well done. I hope Ruffles was well behaved; he's sure good at his job. (As he puts Ruffles back outside in his yard, you hear a proud owner say 'That'll do pig, that'll do.')

quest_list.notes: Fritz sells you 6 truffles for $3000
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have enough money for that. Please, come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: Fritz sells you six more Truffles for $3000.  You now have 12 Truffles for Cara Cook.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That will be $3000.

quest_list.notes: Cara Cook buys the truffles from you for $12000
quest_list.title: Truffles for Cara Cook
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Truffles for Cara Cook.  You earned $12,000 and 175 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, yes, dearie, at the goin' price that lot is worth $12,000.  'Ere ya go, an' thanks for ye' help.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Test to see if youve done King Phil's Crown quest and Cara's Truffles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not at the moment.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye, I need a delivery done, can ye do it?

quest_list.notes: Accept task of delivering truffles and quail to King Phil.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't seem that you can do a delivery to King Phil at the moment.
quest_list.success_message: You have accepted the task of taking Truffles and Quail to King Phil on Hotzeplotz Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: 'Ere ye go. See ya when ye get back.

quest_list.notes: King Phil accepts the Truffles and Quail from you.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have anything.
quest_list.success_message: King Phil takes the Truffles and Quail from you and bids you farewell with a nod.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ahh! It is what my heart has desired.  Thank you, my royal subject.

quest_list.notes: Cara Cook rewards you for delivering the Truffles and Quail to King Phil
quest_list.title: Truffles and Quail for the King
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have finished the delivery.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Truffles and Quail for the King.  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here ye go, dearie.  Thanks for deliverin' that.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: You give the boots to Smelly Toes
quest_list.title: Smelly Toes' New Boots
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don' cha be pullin' me leg, ye bilge rat! Ye ain't got that!
quest_list.success_message: You completed Smelly Toes' New Boots! You earned an Emerald Necklace, a Pearl Necklace and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Me toes be thankin' ye kindly, matey!  Here be a bit o' treasure fer yer troubles.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Karl waterproofs boots
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the boots, though...
quest_list.success_message: You gave Karl the boots and agreed to give him 12 Ferns.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Karl takes the boots from you and examines them.) I'll coat them with pitch and wrap them in a dozen ferns to seal in the stickiness. Won't win any beauty contests, but that should do the trick. You'll need to replace the ferns from my stock.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Get the finished boots
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the ferns I need.  I need 12.
quest_list.success_message: You were given a new pair of Waterproofed Pirate Boots. Just what Smelly Toes needs!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hope these do the trick. Tell Monroe I said hi.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Smelly Toes
quest_list.success_message: You agree to help Smelly Toes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye'd be courtin' high favor from me, iffn ya kin rid me o' this cursed sea spit in here.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Holli Daysin gives you her poem and asks for your help.
quest_list.success_message: You have been given Holli's Mystery Poem and $2500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I was hoping you'd want to help me.  Here's the poem and some money for your expenses.  Good luck and safe travels!

quest_list.notes: The Easter Bunny asks you to pick up supplies for her.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You need to bring back everything!
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to gather 25 Small Gems and 10 Silver Nuggets for the Easter Bunny.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're a dear.  I'll need 25 small gems and 10 silver nuggets.  I've got enough of everything else, thanks.

quest_list.notes: Easter Bunny gets her supplies and gives you an egg.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It's easier for me if you bring me everything at once.  Come back when you have it all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Easter Bunny her silver and gems and she has given you a beautiful Jeweled Egg.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for these supplies, and here, take this egg...  I think it's one of my best!

quest_list.notes: Track Humpty Dumpty (after tarantula story)
Get directions from Stinky
quest_list.success_message: Stinky hands you a slip of paper with directions on where to search for Stinky's family cookbook.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, take this. It be the directions on where ta find me cookbook.

quest_list.notes: Find cookbook on shoreline
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found Stinky's family cookbook!

quest_list.notes: Return cookbook to Stinky Breeches
quest_list.title: Stinky Breeches' Family Cookbook
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don't be messin' wit' me, ye scallywag! You ain't got me cookbook!
quest_list.success_message: You completed Stinky Breeches' Family Cookbook. You earned a Ruby Necklace, 10 chunks of Gold Ore and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Shiver me timbers! Ye did it. Here be a bit o' glitter fer yer troubles.
quest_list.author: DesertMorn

quest_list.notes: Xiang sends you to talk to the Stonewright.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I get all of my carvings from Lenny.  He lives east of here, past the other side of the Dragon Maze.  Why don't you go see if he can help you?
quest_list.success_message: Xiang has sent you to go see Lenny, the Stonewright.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I get all of my carvings from Lenny.  He lives east of here, past the other side of the Dragon Maze.  Why don't you go see if he can help you?

quest_list.notes: Lenny sends you for supplies.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What?!  I need all of my supplies!
quest_list.success_message: Lenny asked you for 25 pieces of Pumice and 5 chunks of Obsidian.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, let me see (He looks around his shop.) I need 25 pieces of pumice and 5 chunks of obsidian to replace what I'll use on the dragon. Yep, that should be all.

quest_list.notes: Lenny gets his supplies and gives you the carving.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but I need all my supplies.  Come back when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Lenny 5 chunks of Obsidian and 25 pieces of Pumice Stone and he gave you a beautifully carved Obsidian Dragon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful, these will do just fine! Now, (Lenny hands you the carved dragon.) I believe you deserve this. Thanks for your help!

quest_list.notes: Santa gets his logs and gives you a carving.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need all of the wood at once.  Come back when you have it all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Santa all of the logs and Santa gave you a Reindeer Nutcracker.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do nicely, thank you.  Now take Rudolph here back to Holli with my best regards!

quest_list.notes: Saggin' Jowls Willie asks you to fetch supplies.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye be missin' something, come back when ye has everything I asked ye to get.
quest_list.success_message: Saggin' Jowls Willie asked you to get Ink and Tools and a Dinosaur Bone.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I needs ye to go to Art Isle and see Salvador.  I ordered a set of etching tools and more ink from him.  They be paid fer already.  And I needs another dinosaur bone. Bring all of it back to me and the piece be yers.

quest_list.notes: Salvador gives you Saggin' Jowl Willie's tools and ink.
quest_list.success_message: Salvador handed you a box with etching tools and inks for Saggin' Jowls Willie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Tell Willie it's been a pleasure doing business with him, as usual!

quest_list.notes: Saggin' Jowls Willie gets his supplies and gives you the scrimshaw piece
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye completely addled?  I told ye I needed both the tools and the bone.  Come back when ye have both.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Willie his Tools and a Dinosaur Bone and he gave you the Scrimshaw Piece.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yer a right proper mate to fetch these fer me.  Here be the piece I promised ye.  May it bring ye pleasure!

quest_list.notes: You've annoyed Crow's Nest Carrie (tracking)
quest_list.success_message: Yikes! She just kicked your tush right out of there.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Leave me be, ye bilge rat! I'm busy.

quest_list.notes: You've annoyed Crow's Nest Carrie again.
quest_list.success_message: Yikes! Not again! She's kicked your tush right out of there, and onto hard rocks this time!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Stop wasting me time, ye bilge rat!

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Crow's Nest Carrie with crickets. See Kirby in Ashton
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to help Crow's Nest Carrie by talking to bug experts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Iff'n ye do that, I might just be willing to discuss what Cap'n Solomon be wantin'.

quest_list.notes: You get scorpions for Crow's Nest Carrie
quest_list.success_message: Kirby gave you a Bag of Scorpions to help Crow's Nest Carrie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've sealed the bag. I'm sure you wouldn't want them crawling about.

quest_list.notes: tracking ... Crow's Nest Carrie's Lost Foghorn
quest_list.success_message: You should go tell Captain Solomon that Crow's Nest Carrie's foghorn is missing.

quest_list.notes: Find foghorn
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging through the barrels around you, you spot something brass. It's a foghorn! Better get it back to her as soon as you can.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Crow's Nest Carrie's brass foghorn!

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Carrie get her foghorrn back
Sani asks you for supplies.
quest_list.success_message: Sani asked you to get Three Leaf Sumac from Dust Isle and Cornmeal from Hotton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you. I need you to go to Fitzgerald on Dust Isle to pick up Three Leaf Sumac for Yepa's baskets and 2 sacks of cornmeal from the General Store in Hotton. I'll finish this sandpainting and give it to you when you return.

quest_list.notes: Fitzgerald gives you 3 leaf sumac.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave you the Sumac.
quest_list.success_message: Fitzgerald gave you 5 Bundles of Three Leaf Sumac.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I suppose it's because it's too sandy in Santon, while I seem to have the perfect mix of sand, soil and water.  Here you go, tell Sani I'll have more in a couple of months.

quest_list.notes: Ethel gives you Cornmeal  for Sani
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave you Sani's cornmeal.
quest_list.success_message: Ethel Barryjam gave you 2 Sacks of Cornmeal for Sani and Yepa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, give my regards to Sani and Yepa.

quest_list.notes: You deliver the scorpions to Carrie.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye tryin' to annoy me? Ya don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You emptied a bag full of scorpions onto the lighthouse floor.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Ye bilge rat! Look what ya gone an done!
(The floor is crawling with crickets and scorpions now.)

quest_list.notes: Crow's Nest Carrie rewards you
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye tryin' to annoy me? Ya don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: Wow! Crow's Nest Carrie just rewarded you with 25 Pearls! Time to get back to Captain Solomon and let him know the good news.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I be sleepin' like a sailor in Davy Jones' Locker! Here, take this as me thank you!

quest_list.notes: You've agreed to help Carlotta welcome Senor Cangrejo
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to help Carlotta welcome Señor Cangrejo by collecting 18 Scorpions.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Si! One and a half dozen plump scorpions, please. This will be the perfect gift!

quest_list.notes: You carefully release the Pallid bats.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye tryin' to annoy me? Ya don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You released the Bundle of Pallid Bats and they are starting to wake up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Bats? Cute lil' critters. But ye best be checkin' back in a bit ta see if yer idea worked.

quest_list.notes: Sani gets his supplies and gives you the sandpainting
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're missing something.  Please go back and return when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sani the Sumac and the Cornmeal and he gave you a sandpainting of a Sunface.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for everything, here is a sandpainting of the sunface, very significant to my people.  We look forward to your next visit, friend.

quest_list.notes: You give Holli the egg.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you got my egg!  Go get my egg!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holli the Easter Bunny's Faberge style egg.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is the most amazing egg I've ever seen!  I have just the perfect place for this in the cabinet.

quest_list.notes: You give Holli the dragon.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You just said you had a stone the color of night... Go back and get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holli the carved Obsidian Dragon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow... I've never seen such an exquisite carving made from such an unusual stone.  I have the perfect spot in the cabinet for it!

quest_list.notes: You give Holli the nutcracker.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: This isn't from Snow Isle!  Go back and get me something from Snow Isle!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holli Santa's hand carved Reindeer Nutcracker.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Jeepers, this is so neat... and I can't believe it was handmade by the Big Guy himself.  This is going on the top shelf!

quest_list.notes: You give Holli the pirate galleon.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where's my bone, go get my bone!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holli the Pirate Galleon Scrimshaw.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Have you seen the incredible detail on this ship!  I have to find the exact perfect spot in the cabinet to display this.

quest_list.notes: You give Holli the sandpainting
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did you lose the sandpainting?  Go back and get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holli Sani's Sandpainting of the ceremonial Sunface.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is so unique.  I've never seen a pattern like it.  I'll hang it on the wall right next to the cabinet.

quest_list.notes: Holli thanks you for your help.
quest_list.title: Holli Daysin's Poem
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but I need all of the items and my poem back, okay?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Holli Daysin's Poem!  You earned a Parrot, $25,000, and 350 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I knew you could solve this for me.  I told him you'd be the one!  Anyway, he brought this parrot for you for when you finish and here's a little something from me.  Come back and see me again soon!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Holli Daysin mentions how she wants to explore more (tracking only)
Chickletti sells you a Code Book for a dollar.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Eh, what's-a matter?  You no got a dollar?!  What a cheapskate!  Go on, get out of here!
quest_list.success_message: Chickletti sells you a Code Book for $1.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  You look up the code in-a the Code Book.  It's-a tell-a you everything you gotta know!  There you go!

quest_list.notes: Holli checks your quest level
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you need at least 50% of your quests done.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see... Yes, you've been adventurous enough... Want to give it a try?

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Stinky recipe ingredients
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to help Stinky Breeches Vincent get ingredients for his red beans and rice recipe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ye might be a worthy landlubber after all!  Here's a list, though I'll tell ye what I need, too.

quest_list.notes: Get rice and beans
quest_list.success_message: Barrett Braunbag gave you a Sack of Beans and Rice for Stinky.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Tell him 'ello for me.

quest_list.notes: Give Rika scissors and get Spices for Stinky
quest_list.success_message: Rika gave you a bag of Assorted Fresh Spices for the Jewel-Encrusted Scissors.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Rika's face softens as she holds the scissors.) These are beautiful! Perfect for snipping herbs. Tell old Stinky I've forgiven him.

quest_list.notes: Get vegetables
quest_list.success_message: Candide gave you a Bag of Mixed Vegetables for Stinky's recipe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Enjoy them.

quest_list.notes: Give Stinky rice and beans
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye ain't got that!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Stinky the Sack of Beans and Rice. You earned 10 Rubies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These sacks bring back good memories, they do. Here's a bit o' glitter for yer troubles.

quest_list.notes: Give Stinky the spices
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye ain't got that!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Stinky the Assorted Fresh Spices for his recipe and earned 3 Topaz Necklaces.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I best get to choppin' these! Ye done good, matey. Take this bit o' sparkle.

quest_list.notes: Give Stinky vegetables
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye ain't got that!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Stinky the Bag of Mixed Vegetables for his recipe and earned 2 Sapphire Necklaces.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Candide 'as the best vegetables, 'e does! 'Ere be some sparkle fer ye troubles.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get Stinky a cooking pot
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to get a copper-bottomed pot for Stinky.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Make sure it be big enough to cook up enough to fill the bellies of a ship's crew!

quest_list.notes: Stinky gives you a taste of his red beans and rice
quest_list.success_message: Stinky has given you a taste of his red beans and rice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: 'Tis a tasty treat fer a hard-working soul such as yourself!

quest_list.notes: Wu Kung sends you to find his staff
quest_list.success_message: Wu Kung sent you to find his staff.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: They were that meddlesome scientist and his daughter and their insipid plants!  I had to move from tree to tree until those plants got to be too much for me and I left.  But I left my section of the staff up in one of those trees.  Please find it for me.

quest_list.notes: Give Stinky copper-bottomed pot
quest_list.title: Stinky Breeches' Red Beans & Rice
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye don't have that at all! Git outta here, ye bilge rat!
quest_list.success_message: You completed Stinky Breeches' Red Beans & Rice. You earned 4 Diamond Necklaces, 2 Emerald Necklaces and 350 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
By the powers! It looks just like me dear ole mum's! (Stinky wipes a tear from his eye.)
Here be a fair share of glitter for doing such a fine job.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Stinky gives you Reka's bribe
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I gave ye the scissors already.  Give 'er those.
quest_list.success_message: Stinky Breeches gave you a pair of Jewel-Encrusted Scissors.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here be the perfect thing to make that lass smile! Got it on one of me adventures, back in the day.

quest_list.notes: Stinky checks to make sure you've given him all the ingredients
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye jus' yankin' me chain? Ye ain't give me everythin' yet!
quest_list.success_message: You've given Stinky all the ingredients he needs to make his Red Beans and Rice recipe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looks like ye brought me all the ingredients. Only one thing be missing now.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Captain Spaldeen takes the code from you (to get it out of your inventory)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What code?  You haven't got a code.  But next time you get one, take two aspirins and call me in the morning.
quest_list.success_message: Captain Spaldeen takes Chickletti's Code from you, reads it, and puts it in his pocket.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, let me see that... Z V B X R P L ...I had this same code when I had my eyes examined.

quest_list.notes: Stinky gives you a diamond to cover traveling expenses.
quest_list.success_message: You've been given a Diamond to help cover the costs of your travels, and a slip of paper.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This bit o' sparkle should do it, matey. And here be a reminder note so ye don't come back an' bother me! Now be off wit' ye!

quest_list.notes: Mrs. Beesdale sends you off to find Chickletti and Binky
quest_list.success_message: Mrs. Beesdale gave you $1000 to find the Leader of Spreedonia -- or at least someone who knows where he might be.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Then I bid you the best of fortune.  Please take this to help defray your expenses, and report back to me as soon as you have found His Excellency!

quest_list.notes: Koko checks to be sure you in fact do have everything before sending to Patsy.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have everything. Sword blade, sword hilt and shield are what you need. (She spins faster.)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found everything?  Patsy will be happy.  Koko is happy, and you are Koko's new best friend!

quest_list.notes: Jack sends you to find a kitten.
quest_list.success_message: Jack O'Lantern told you to find a kitten and bring it to Hyrokkin on Berg Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hyrokkin, the Sea Hag, lives on Berg Isle.  Find the kitten and bring it to her with my compliments.  She'll reward you well for your efforts, so you don't have to come back to see me, okay?

quest_list.notes: Antonio gives you lemonade
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I am completely out of lemonade.  Sorry.
quest_list.success_message: You drank a tall, cold glass of Lemonade.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: For you, an icy glass of freshly-made lemonade and a few fresh berries on the side. They are full of antioxidants. Good for when you are feeling stressed.

quest_list.notes: ZVBXRPL
quest_list.success_message: Chickletti has given you a Scrap of Paper. (Click ? to read it).
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Evidence, eh?  All-a I find is this piece of paper!  Go ahead!  You read it yourself!  Here-a you go!

quest_list.notes: Nora Nurture sends you for her orders
quest_list.success_message: Nora sent you to Shellton & Wington to pick up her orders.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I placed an order for dog treats with Ollie at Ollie's Pets in Shellton, and bird seed from Kay's shop in Wington.  I need you to pick up both orders, okay?

quest_list.notes: Ollie gives you the Dog treats
quest_list.success_message: Ollie gave you a Sack of Dog Treats.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  I was wondering when Nora would pick this up. Tell her it's been a pleasure, as always!

quest_list.notes: Kay gives you the bird seed.
quest_list.success_message: Kay gave you the Bird Seed for Nora.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  I was afraid that Nora forgot about her order!  Let me know when she needs more, okay?

quest_list.notes: Nora gets her orders and you get the kitten
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but I need both orders.  Come back when you have both, okay?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Nora the Dog Treats and Bird Seed.  You were given a Pure White Kitten.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks ever so much for picking these up for me.  Here's the kitten.  Make sure he goes to a good home now!

quest_list.notes: Hyrokkin gets her new kitten and rewards you.
quest_list.title: John O'Lantern's Friend
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said Jack sent me a gift, go back and get it!  NOW!!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed John O'Lantern's Friend!  You earned 2 Pearl Necklaces and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He's so cute! Thank you. I'll name him Delling. Oh, and here, please take this for your trouble. It's nothing, really, just some things that washed up after the last pirate ship got swamped. (Is that a grin?)
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Agree to get scoops for Ginger
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to speak with Smiddy Jones about new feed scoops for Ginger.  You received $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you very much!  Smiddy is just a boat ride over to Tropicton.  Here's some money for boat fare and money for his supplies.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Augie find shelter in exchange for the pot.
quest_list.success_message: You agree to help find something to shelter Augie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I would really appreciate it.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Get palm fronds for Augie.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found a Handful of Palm Fronds for Augie!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Give palm fronds to Augie.
quest_list.title: Augie Needs Shelter
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have anything for me.
quest_list.success_message: You completed Augie Needs Shelter! You earned $5000, 100 quest points and got a Copper-Bottom Pot that should be perfect for Stinky!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look perfect! Thank you. Here's the pot you wanted. Travel safely.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: A E Y C I K O (Correct Cipher)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You find the letters A E Y C I K O carved into a tree trunk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a mysterious clue!

quest_list.notes: Get to Spaldeen
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Carefully using your shovel to clear away many branches and vines, you find your way into a small jungle clearing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are in a small jungle clearing.

quest_list.notes: A B R C A Q X
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Scratched into a tree here is: A B R C A Q X
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a mysterious clue!

quest_list.notes: Wrong Clue # 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Painted on the leaves of a vine, you see, Z V U K C L L
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a mysterious clue!

quest_list.notes: Wrong Clue No 3

quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a mysterious clue!

quest_list.notes: Wrong Clue No 4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Woven out of vine fibers are the letters, Y U A W S Q K
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a mysterious clue!

quest_list.notes: Wrong Clue No 5
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Scribbled in the bark of a young tree are the letters A W C Y S Q M
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a mysterious clue!

quest_list.notes: Wrong Clue No 6
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Written in fire-flower juice ink on a fallen log is: L S M F T H A
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a mysterious clue!

quest_list.notes: Captain Spaldeen takes the Code Book, too, just so he can irritate you some more.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What code book?  You haven't got any code book.
quest_list.success_message: Captain Spaldeen takes the Code Book.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Code Book.... code book.... Simple Cipher, eh?  I know that one!  "Simple Cipher met a fifer going to the fair."

quest_list.notes: Captain Spaldeen teleports you out of his jungle hideaway
quest_list.success_message: Captain Spaldeen teleports you out of his clearing, then disappears himself, probably to Spreedonia, but who knows...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Go, and may luck be with you!

quest_list.notes: A Reward From Mrs. Beesdale.
quest_list.title: Mrs. Beesdale's Lost Excellency
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mrs. Beesdale's Lost Excellency!  You earned $20,000 and 250 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, how can I thank you!  Please take this, on behalf of all the people of Spreedonia!  (<i>She gives you something, then runs off singing.)
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: You found the staff section!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up in the tree tops and spot something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Wu Kung's Staff Section!

quest_list.notes: You give Wu Kung his section of staff.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Why have you returned empty-handed?  Go back and find my staff!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Wu Kung his section of the staff and he asked you to go to Master Lau next.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, young one.  You have surpassed my expectations!  Now please continue my quest and go to Master Lau and get his section of the staff.  He can be found on a jungle island northeast of here.

quest_list.notes: Accept quest to get oil for Mandy
quest_list.success_message: You agree to get a bottle of Grapeseed Oil from Cara Cook for Mandy.  You were given $800.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you.  I need one bottle of oil.  Here is some money to help you with your travels.

quest_list.notes: Cara Cook gives you  a bottle of grapeseed oil.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave you the grapeseed oil.  Bring it back to Mandy now.
quest_list.success_message: Cara gave you a Bottle of Grapeseed Oil.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oil 'or Mandy?  Aye, I got some a that!  You 'urry back to her now, ya 'ear?

quest_list.notes: Mandy accepts the bottle of oil from you
quest_list.title: Grapeseed Oil for Mandy
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have anything.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Grapeseed Oil for Mandy.  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for your help, now I can cook my chicken tenders. Here is $2000 for you.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Master Lau sends you for his section of the staff.
quest_list.success_message: Master Lau sent you to find his section of the staff.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The only help I'll give you is to tell you it is one of the temples around my lair. It's not in the southern jungles. If you are strong enough, you will find my staff.

quest_list.notes: You find Master Lau's staff.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully dig and hit something!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Master Lau's section of the staff!

quest_list.notes: Master Lau sends you to Master Hoa
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't found my section of the staff! (Roars!) Don't come back without it!
quest_list.success_message: Master Lau sent you to Master Hoa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Most impressive, young one.  Take this section with you and go find Master Hoa, the crane.  When last I heard from him, he was on Bird Isle.

quest_list.notes: Master Hoa sends you for his section of the staff.
quest_list.success_message: Master Hoa sent you to find his section of the staff.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Chill, man... The truth is I, like, spaced out, and I really have no idea where I left it. Other than it's probably up in a willow tree. I like willow trees! Oh, and it's definitely on this island.

quest_list.notes: You found Master Hoa's section.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up in the willow tree and spot something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Master Hoa's section of the staff!

quest_list.notes: Master Hoa sends you to Master Shua.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Bummer, dude, you didn't find my staff.  Come back when you have it!
quest_list.success_message: Master Hoa sent you to find Master Shua.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, wow, like, you found it, dude!  Now take it with you and go find Master Shua and get his section.  His scene is like sand and cactus, but he does like his shade.  Look for him around the pyramids.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Captain Solomon
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to help Captain Solomon. You need to talk to Crow's Nest Carrie as soon as possible!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And iff'n ye be wise, ye be doing it smartly, afore I have a mutiny on me hands.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Captain Solomon by infiltrating the Skulls
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to help Captain Solomon. You need to find out where the foghorn is hidden. You might want to start by asking some of the Skull pirates.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And do it smartly, afore I got a mutiny on me hands.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Captain Jack by getting his crew something to eat.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Captain Jack and his crew some of Stinky's red beans and rice. Better go tell Captain Solomon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: We'll be wantin' some of Stinky's red beans and rice. And do it smartly, afore I got a mutiny on me hands. (Gesh! He sounds just like Captain Solomon!)

quest_list.notes: Agree to bring Stinky's pot back.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to bring Stinky's pot back.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And make sure ye return me pot afore I keelhaul ye!

quest_list.notes: You get the pot of beans
quest_list.success_message: Stinky Breeches Vincent gave you a Pot of Red Beans and Rice. Better get it over to the Skulls before it cools off.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here it is and make sure ye return me pot afore I keelhaul ye!

quest_list.notes: You deliver the pot of beans and rice
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that!
quest_list.success_message: You give the Pot of Red Beans and Rice over.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looks mighty tasty! I thank ye kindly!

quest_list.notes: You get Stinky's pot back
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ye ain't got that! You best be finding me copper pot!
quest_list.success_message: Captain Jack gave you back Stinky's Copper-Bottom Pot. The Skulls failed to clean it, but at least you've got the pot back. Now all you need to do is return the pot to Vincent!!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There ye go, Matey!

quest_list.notes: reuse
Captain Solomon rewards you. {$1500 travel costs}
quest_list.title: Captain Solomon's Quest for Quiet
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Captain Solomon's Quest for Quiet. You earned 5 Diamond Necklaces and 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I be much obliged to ye, matey. Here's a bit a glitter for all yer troubles. Now clear out so's I kin git a bit a shut eye.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: You get the pallid bats to eat the crickets and scorpions
quest_list.success_message: Madame Babushka gave you a Bundle of Pallid Bats wrapped in scarves. Better hurry back to Crow's Nest Carrie's before they get loose and fly away!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Madame Babushka hands you a bundle of bats.) Be careful with them, and hurry. They'll be waking soon and will be ravenous!

quest_list.notes: You release the pallid bats to eat the crickets and scorpions
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You ain't got that!
quest_list.success_message: You've gently unwrapped the scarves and the bats are starting to wake up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Bats? Cute lil' critters. But ye best be checkin' back in a bit ta see if yer idea worked. And by the way, I think I'll be keepin' them purty scarves, thank ye kindly!

quest_list.notes: Crow's Nest Carrie rewards you
Bonus barramundi fish run #1
