quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't appear that you have enough money.
quest_list.success_message: Sam McGee sold you 10 Barramundi Fish to take to Louis Penguin.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  That will be $500.  I'm afraid that is the last of them.  The season is over for barramundi fish.

quest_list.notes: Louis accepts More barramundi fish#1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have any fish.
quest_list.success_message: Louis gave you a Seashell Necklace and took the Barramundi Fish from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You little ripper, thanks for that, mate.  Here is something for the fish.

quest_list.notes: Louis accepts More barramundi fish #2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have any fish.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Bewdy mate, thanks for that.  Here is something for the fish.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Louis accepts More barramundi fish #3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have any fish.
quest_list.success_message: Louis gave you a Dinosaur Bone and took the Barramundi Fish from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Cooee cobber, thanks for that.  Here is something for the fish.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Louis accepts More barramundi fish #4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have any fish.
quest_list.success_message: Louis gave you a Sapphire Necklace and took the Barramundi Fish from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ripper dingo, thanks for that, mate.  Here is something for the fish.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Louis accepts More barramundi fish #5
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have any fish.
quest_list.success_message: Louis gave you an Amethyst Necklace and took the Barramundi Fish from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You little ripper, thanks for that.  Here is something for the fish.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Louis accepts More barramundi fish #6
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have any fish.
quest_list.success_message: Louis gave you a Ruby Necklace and took the Barramundi Fish from you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's awesome, thanks.  Here is something for the fish.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: You accept the quest of getting Turkish Delight for King Phil
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Maybe you can't help me at this time.
quest_list.success_message: You accept the task of getting the King some Turkish Delight.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you. I bid thee farewell until your return.

quest_list.notes: Accept Collecting Items for Patricia Plumb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you can't help me at the moment.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get 25 Rose Hips from Iris Pettel on Bird Isle, and also collect 25 Small Sugar Chunks for Patricia Plum.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for offering to get that for me.  I will see you when you get back, but remember, I need all of the ingredients before we can start.

quest_list.notes: Master Shua challenges you to solve 3 puzzles.
quest_list.success_message: Master Shua has challenged you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I did not sssay they would be easssy puzzlesss, now did I?

quest_list.notes: Master Shua gives you his section of the staff.
quest_list.success_message: Master Shua gave you his section of the staff.  He sends you off to Master Tang next.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have proven yourssself to be worthy, young one.  Here, take my ssssection of the ssstaff.  Now you mussst find Massster Tang.  He ressssides on Flower Isle.  More than that I do not know.  Good sssspeed!

quest_list.notes: You win the Shakespeare quiz.
quest_list.title: Shakespeare with Ethel Barryjam
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Uhm... King Lear and the Three Bears?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Shakespeare with Ethel Barryjam!  You earned $1000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You did it!  Very good!  Excellent!  Here is the $5000 I promised you!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Ethel gives you a piece of cake for answering a question that's... well, a piece of cake.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Tsk....
quest_list.success_message: Ethel Barryjam has given you a piece of cake for answering her question correctly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  Since that question was really a piece of cake, have a piece of cake!

quest_list.notes: Oddly the Mage wants a Hot Cocoa and a Pudding.
quest_list.success_message: Oddly the Mage would like you to get him a Hot Cocoa and a Pudding.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I would like a cup of hot cocoa, and a pudding! (Oddly suddenly gets very misty eyed.) Just like my Nonna used to make me for dessert...

quest_list.notes: Master Tang asks for grasshoppers.
quest_list.success_message: Master Tang asked you for 12 Grasshoppers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It's simple, really.  Bring me one dozen grasshoppers and I'll tell you where to find my section of the staff.

quest_list.notes: Master Tang gets his grasshoppers.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I told you to bring me 12 grasshoppers.  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Master Tang his grasshoppers and he told you where to find his section of the staff.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for this delightful repast!  Now go to the flower patch where that annoying beast Tookers can be found.  Look closely, my section of the staff is by a red rose.

quest_list.notes: You found Master Tang's staff section.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking carefully around the flower, you see something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Master Tang's staff section!  Time to go back to Wu Kung!

quest_list.notes: Wu Kung gets the sections of the staff and rewards you.
quest_list.title: Wu Kung and the Masters
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I am sorry young one, but you do not have all 4 sections.  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Wu Kung and the Masters.  You earned a Diamond Necklace, a Topaz Necklace and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, young one, you have done an exceptional job. (Wu Kung quickly assembles all 5 pieces and begins rapidly spinning the staff.) Yes, yes, exceptional! Please accept this as a token of my humble gratitude.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Wu Kung checks your experience level.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I am truly sorry, young one, but you must complete 25% of your quests before you can assist me again.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, young one, you have been both brave and adventurous.  You are ready to assist me once more.

quest_list.notes: Goldilocks sends you for Venetian Food Flowers
quest_list.success_message: Goldilocks would like you to get 20 Venetian Food and 20 Rubies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ooooooh, you're SO clever! Yes, I want you to go back down to Jungle and get me 20 Venetian Food flowers and 20 rubies. I brought the flower-drying supplies, but... well, the bag with the rubies kind of dropped through the cloud... heh heh...

quest_list.notes: Give Goldilocks the flowers and rubies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, but there aren't ENOUGH!  Don't you know we're on a PRODUCTION SCHEDULE?!  Take 5, everyone!  Hurry up and bring the rest!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Goldilocks 20 Rubies and 20 Venetian Food Flowers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, these are... a little dry, but... yes, they'll do, they'll do, and now I'll put them up on the wall in the most MARVELOUS pattern... OH!

quest_list.notes: Wu Kung sends you to Lung Ch'uan.
quest_list.success_message: Wu Kung gave you the 5 Sectioned Staff and sent you to find Master Lung Ch'uan.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Grand Master Lung Ch'uan is a mighty Red Dragon.  He now resides in the land of the volcanoes.  Please give him this staff as a sign that we, his humble students, have finally taken his lessons to heart.

quest_list.notes: Lung Ch'uan recieves his staff and bestows gifts upon his students
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said Wu Kung gave you my staff, where is it?  Go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Lung Ch'uan his staff and he gave you gifts to give to each of his students.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It pleases me to know that my students have finally learned all of my lessons.  Please give each one of them one of these gifts from me.  You'll find each gift has a name tag on it.

quest_list.notes: Master Tang receives Lung Ch'uan's gift
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have my gift? Go back and get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Master Tang his package from Master Lung Ch'uan.  You were given 5 chunks of Silver Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (You watch as Master Tang unwraps a hand-carved set of nunchakus and begins to use them.) These are exquisite. Thank you for bringing this to me. Here, accept these as a token of my appreciation.

quest_list.notes: Master Shua receives Lung Ch'uan's gift.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did you forget ssssomething?  Go get my package!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Master Shua his package from Master Lung Ch'uan.  You were given a Diamond.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Master Shua opens his package to reveal a Chinese Whip glistening in the sunlight. He begins to practice with it.) Thank you. Thissss issss a marveloussss gift! Pleasssse accept this in gratitude of all that you have done for usss.

quest_list.notes: Master Hoa receives his gift from Lung Ch'uan.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Bummer dude, you need to go back and find my package!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Master Hoa his gift from Master Lung Ch'uan.  You were given 2 Pearls.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Master Hoa opens his package to reveal a Chinese Fighting Fan made of the finest silk and steel.) Far out! This is, like, totally awesome, dude! Here, take this for all your troubles.

quest_list.notes: Master Lau receives his gift from Lung Ch'uan.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Roars.) You don't have my package?!? Go find it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Master Lau his package from Master Lung Ch'uan.  You were given 5 chunks of Gold Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Master Lau opens his package and finds a 3 sectional staff which he immediately begins to twirl.) The balance of this staff is indeed amazing. Here, accept this as a token of my appreciation for all you have done.

quest_list.notes: Wu Kung gets his gift and rewards you.
quest_list.title: Wu Kung and the Grand Master
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Please deliver the packages to all the other masters first.  I will wait.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Wu Kung and the Grand Master.  You earned a Ruby Necklace and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Wu Kung opens his package to reveal a Bo Staff of the finest bamboo. He wastes no time twirling and spinning the staff.) I cannot thank you enough, young one. Please accept this for all of your efforts.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Goldilocks sends you for Red Crystal Shards
quest_list.success_message: Goldilocks would like you to go get her 10 Red Crystal Shards (poor you...)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Can you believe I'd overlook something SO sumptuous! Now, I need (she appears to count on her fingers, but is probably just killing time for dramatic effect.) TEN of those! Yes!

quest_list.notes: Goldilocks sends you for Ebony Wood
quest_list.success_message: Goldilocks would like you to go get her 10 Ebony Logs (are you sure you wanted to do this?)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: An EBONY ARMOIRE! Won't that be just STUNNING! Handy Andy Crane, our carpenter, will build it! Now, you go forth and get me 10 Ebony Logs!

quest_list.notes: Fletcher Feelbedder tells you to talk to Daria (tracking only)
Mathilda Emdee tells you to check the local inns and barns. (tracking only)
Give Goldilocks the crystal shards and ebony wood.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No no no no no, I need ALL the stuff ALL at the same time, no no no no nno no no nooooooo! 10 of each, I mean, 10 of this AND 10 of that, now hurry!!!!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Goldilocks 10 Red Crystal Shards and 10 logs of Ebony Wood.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Lovely, lovely, LOVELY! And now. This place needs DRAMA. Right? Draaaaaaama!. We must reintroduce the truly Grizzly!

quest_list.notes: Goldilocks wants The New Black
quest_list.success_message: Goldilocks would like you to get her some Jet Black Fabric, enough to make a pair of curtains.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, I don't.  And it's going to be really hard to find, because what I need is JET BLACK fabric!  Not brown black, not blue black, not coal black, BLACK.  Jet Black is The New Black.

quest_list.notes: Pookie says Oddly has The New Black
quest_list.success_message: Pookie may have told you that she had some black fabric and she gave it to a Mage named Oddly, who wanders around near Lornbacoll's cave.  But who knows...

quest_list.notes: Start Ethel Barryjam's quiz (tracking only)
Oddly gives you his cloak for a pudding and a hot cocoa.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not what I asked for!  Honestly, what's wrong with you?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Oddly a Pudding and a Hot Cocoa, and in turn he gave you his Jet Black Cloak.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, yes, that is just... yum! Oh, this is nice! Here. Have the cloak. Heaven knows I don't need it, it's much too hot to wear black out here anyway.

quest_list.notes: Give Goldilocks Oddly's Cloak
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I asked you for, honestly, and look, we're on a production schedule here!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Oddly's Cloak to Goldilocks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooooooh! You are the goods, you really, REALLY are! This is ALMOST perrrrrrrfect!

quest_list.notes: Goldilocks sends you for a Silver Lining (this is the last thing, really!)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I asked you for, honestly, and look were on a production schedule here!
quest_list.success_message: Goldilocks sends you for a Silver Lining!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes! Oh, OH, and here come the THREE BEARS, ready to see their new and very chic den! Hurry, hurry HURRY! I need ONE Silver Lining! HURRY!

quest_list.notes: Give Goldilocks the Silver Lining
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't got it!! Honestly!  We have exactly TWO MINUTES of the show left!  HURRY!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Goldilocks a Silver Lining.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: At last! (Goldilocks throws the silver lining to one of her assistants, who rapidly sews it into Oddly's Cloak, now cut in two and used as drapes.) Ready, Bears?

quest_list.notes: Goldilocks Pays You and You Get Away Unscathed.
quest_list.title: Goldilocks' Interior Design
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Goldilocks' Interior Design.  You earned $25,000 and 300 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go... Thank you, I KNOW I really made you work for this, but I hope it's worth it.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Murray's little list
quest_list.success_message: Murray gave you his list and some money for expenses.  You were given $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks.  Here, take the list and here's some traveling money.  Most of the items are either already paid for or going on the isle's tab.  You will have to pay Cedric, though.  I really appreciate your help with this.

quest_list.notes: Amelia gives you the hydrated lime
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had a list from Murray, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Amelia gave you 3 Large Sacks of Hydrated Lime.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The hydrated lime?  It makes the fences look brighter and whiter.  Keeps those ranch owners happy.  Here you go.  Tell Murray it's on his tab.

quest_list.notes: Lars sends you for iron ore.
quest_list.success_message: Lars offered you the nails for free IF you bring him 50 chunks of Iron Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Bring back 50 chunks and I'll have the nails ready.

quest_list.notes: Either give the necklace back, or not, one chance only!  (chained action)
Lars gets the iron ore and gives you the nails.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're a little short on the iron ore, come back when you have all of them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Lars 50 chunks of Iron Ore.  Lars gave you 2 Kegs of Nails.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for the iron ore.  Here you go, just like I promised, 2 kegs of nails with my compliments!

quest_list.notes: Cedric sends you out for logs.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to gather 50 Logs for Cedric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good.  I'll get you Murray's fence rails when you bring the logs.

quest_list.notes: Cedric gets his logs and payment and he gives you a bundle of fence rails.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I sent you out for 50 logs and I expect 50 logs!!  Come back when you have all of them!  Don't forget the $500 also.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cedric 50 Logs and $500.  You were given a Bundle of Fence Rails.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for the logs and the payment.  Here, bring these rails to Murray so he can get started.  Tell him I'll send the rest to him as soon as I have them finished.

quest_list.notes: Simon gives you the buckets and brushes.
quest_list.success_message: Simon gave you 2 Buckets and 4 Large Paint Brushes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sorry, I didn't know you were in such a rush.  Here you go, tell Murray it's on his tab.

quest_list.notes: You buy rock salt from Zeke Sacker.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money, come back with more cash!
quest_list.success_message: You bought 2 Sacks of Rock Salt from Zeke Sacker for $25.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And here's your rock salt. Pleasure doin' business with you.  Give Murray my regards!

quest_list.notes: You give Murray the kegs of nails
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: There's nothing here, come back with the nails!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Murray 2 Kegs of Nails.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, good.  Lars makes the best nails for mending fences.  Thanks.

quest_list.notes: You give Murray the buckets and brushes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You were supposed to get 2 buckets and 4 brushes.  Come back with all of it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Murray the 2 Buckets and the 4 Large Paint Brushes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good.  Simon carries the best brushes around.  Thanks.

quest_list.notes: You give Murray 3 large sacks of Hydrated Lime.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I told you I needed 3 sacks of lime, go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Murray 3 Large Sacks of Hydrated Lime.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Amelia carries the highest grade of lime.  This will be perfect for the fences.  Thank you.

quest_list.notes: You give Murray 2 large sacks of rock salt.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I said 2 sacks of rock salt... Go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Murray 2 Large Sacks of Rock Salt.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks, I'm sure Zeke gave you a good deal on the salt.

quest_list.notes: You give Murray the fence rails.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Cedric said he was sending me some of the fence rails, go get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Murray Cedric's Fence Rails.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmmm... (Murray looks very carefully at one of the fence rails.) I knew Cedric was the right choice. These rails are exactly what I need. Thanks.

quest_list.notes: Murray rewards you.
quest_list.title: Murray's Fences
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't gotten everything yet.  Follow that list and then you'll find everything.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Murray's Fences.  You earned $12,000 and 275 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, I must say you've done a real bang up job helping me!  Thanks a lot and please take this for your troubles.
quest_list.author: BkynFilly

quest_list.notes: Accept task of collecting Flowers from Iris Petal
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you can't help me at the moment.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get Iris 25 Bunches of Wildflowers and 25 Bunches of Daisies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! I'll see you when you get back with those.  Remember, I need 25 of each before I give you the rose hips.

quest_list.notes: Give Wild Flowers and daisies to Iris Pettel and accept rose hips.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like you don't have 25 bunches of wildflowers and daisies.  When you do, I will have the rose hips for you.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Iris Pettel 25 Bunches of Wildflowers and 25 Bunches of Daisies in exchange for 25 Rose Hips.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's great, thank you for the flowers.  Here are the rose hips.

quest_list.notes: Give Rose Hips & Sugar chunks to Patricia Plumb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have 25 sugar chunks and 25 rose hips.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Patricia Plum 25 Rose Hips and 25 Small Sugar Chunks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for that.  Come back later, and I'll have a box of Turkish Delight for you to give to King Phil.

quest_list.notes: Accept Turkish Delight From Patricia Plumb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like I can't give you any Turkish Delight at the moment.
quest_list.success_message: Patricia Plum gave you a box of Turkish Delight for King Phil of Hotzeplotz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, I have.  Here you go.  I have a full box right here.  I'll put the cost of it on his account.

quest_list.notes: King Phil accepts Turkish Delight from you and rewards you
quest_list.title: Turkish Delight for King Phil
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't appear to have anything.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Turkish Delight for King Phil.  You earned a Bunny and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, my royal subject. You again delighted me with your service. Here's a reward.  A genuine bunny companion, for all your efforts.
quest_list.author: LinuxDude

quest_list.notes: Carly Cobbler sends you for her linens.
quest_list.success_message: Carly Cobbler told you to get 25 Moonbeams and 10 Silver Linings and take them to Barb Sower.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see, you'll need to gather up 25 moonbeams and 10 silver linings while you are still up here... Nathaniel!  I'm watching you, buddy!! ...Where was I?  Yes... take them to Barb Sower.  She'll let you know if she needs anything else.

quest_list.notes: You give Barb the Moonbeams & Silver Linings.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, you seem to be missing something. Come back when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: Barb took the Moonbeams and Silver Linings and sent you to gather 50 Pieces of Cotton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The moonbeams give the sheets a gentle glow, so no night lights are needed, and the silver linings ensure a good rest.  By the way, I'll also need 50 pieces of cotton to replenish my stock.  I'll have the sheets ready when you come back!

quest_list.notes: Barb gets her cotton and gives you the linens.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough!  Come back when you have all of the cotton I asked for.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Barb Sower 50 Pieces of Cotton and she gave you Carly's Bed Linens.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And here are Carly's sheets.  Thank you for picking up the cotton.  Tell Carly I'm sending along my best wishes on her new home!

quest_list.notes: You give Carly her linens and she sends you to Floria for pillows.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said Barb gave you the bed linens?  You'd better go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Carly her Bed Linens and she asked you to gather 50 Sparkling Feathers and 50 Feathers and take them to Floria.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are just lovely.  You are such a wonderful person to do this for me!  The next thing on the list are the pillows. Gather 50 sparkling feathers and 50 feathers and bring them to Floria on Flower Isle.  Don't think I didn't see that, Patsy!

quest_list.notes: You give Floria the feathers and she sends you for eider down and cotton damask.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: How about you get the 50 sparkling feathers and 50 feathers first.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Floria all of the feathers and she asked you to go to Rainey for Eider Down and Trixie Traderton for Cotton Damask.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Be a dear and go to Rainey in Soaring Meadows and get me 2 more sacks of Eider Down and stop by Trixie Traderton's in Flipperton for a bolt of Cotton Damask.

quest_list.notes: Agree to go see Yepa for Carly Cobbler
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to see Yepa for Carly's Blankets.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yepa in Santon is weaving the blankets for me, that would be great if you could pick them up. (Spins around.) Georgia, if I told you once, I've told you a thousand times... stop pinching your brother!! (Turns back to you.) Thank you so much.

quest_list.notes: Dig up a carrot
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig up one very large, woody-looking carrot.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You got a carrot!  Maybe you should pay for it.

quest_list.notes: Ricky lets you keep the carrot
quest_list.success_message: You got to keep the old carrot - free!  It was good of you to check with Ricky.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That must have been a leftover from last year's crop.  You can keep it - no charge.

quest_list.notes: Rake up topaz necklace
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You scrape at the soil with your rake, and out comes an old, forgotten, underdeveloped yellow squash... No, wait...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You got a Topaz Necklace!  What a weird thing to find in a garden.

quest_list.notes: You give the necklace back, hope is restored to the universe!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did you bring the necklace in with you?  Did it fall on the floor?   Maybe you dropped it!
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Diamond!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My daughter will be so very happy!  This was so kind of you!  You didn't even have to tell me that you'd found it!  Please take this small token of my thanks.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: You don't give the necklace back, the dark side of the force prevails.
quest_list.success_message: You leave the house feeling disgusted with yourself...  Perhaps thinking of the money you'll make from the sale of the necklace will console you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, okay.  Well, have a nice day.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Liza doesn't need help right now.
quest_list.success_message: Liza doesn't have any work for you.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Not that I can think of.  The whole idea of subsistence is that I shouldn't need help, after all!  Feel free to come back and visit from time to time.

quest_list.notes: Rainey gives you the eider down.
quest_list.success_message: Rainey gave you two sacks of Eider Down.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, here you go.  But please feel free to stop by to visit any time you're near Soaring Meadows.

quest_list.notes: Trixie gives you the Damask
quest_list.success_message: Trixie gave you a Bolt of Cotton Damask.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Tell Floria to give me a little more advanced warning when she needs another bolt... I had the hardest time finding this one in time!

quest_list.notes: Floria gets her materials and gives you the pillows.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked you for eider down and damask! Come back when you've gotten both!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Floria the Eider Down and the Damask and she gave you Carly's Pillows.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, indeedy, here you go!  Take these to Carly and tell her they should guarantee sweet dreams to all her children!  By the way, thanks for the supplies!

quest_list.notes: Carly gets her pillows and sends you out, one mo' time!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said Floria gave you the pillows... Go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Carly Cobbler her Pillows.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooo, these are sooo soft and fluffy!  Floria really outdid herself.  Could I be a nudge and impose on you one last time? I need you to pick up the blankets I ordered.

quest_list.notes: Yepa asks you to pick up craft supplies.
quest_list.success_message: Yepa sent you to Albert on Hoof Isle for Leather Strappings and Rider Isle for 6 Willow Twigs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm running low on my supplies.  I need 6 willow twigs and some leather strappings.  Albert on Hoof Isle has the leather for me and the best willow comes from Rider Isle.  Look closely at the willows.  You'll see twigs loose enough to pull off.

quest_list.notes: Albert Junker gives you leather strappings
quest_list.success_message: Albert Junker gave you a Dozen Leather Strappings for Yepa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, let Yepa know that I sold all of her baskets and I'm looking forward to her next shipment.

quest_list.notes: You found a twig!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look carefully, see a loose twig, and pull.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You got a Willow Twig!

quest_list.notes: You found a twig!

quest_list.notes: You bring Yepa her supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked for 6 willow twigs and the leather strapping. Please come back when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: Yepa gave you Carly's Blankets and 6 Dreamcatchers for Carly's children.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And here are Carly's blankets, and 6 Dreamcatchers to put in her children's bedrooms.

quest_list.notes: Carly gets her blankets and rewards you.
quest_list.title: Carly Cobbler's New Home
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said you had blankets and 6 Dreamcatchers... You're missing something, go back and check!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Carly Cobbler's New Home!  You earned $30,000 and 275 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These blankets are so soft and warm. Yepa is so sweet to send along the Dreamcatchers, too. Now I can finally get all these children to bed and have a little me time. Here, please take this with my thanks.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Captain Spaldeen takes Blinky's note
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Note?  What note?  I don't see any note.
quest_list.success_message: Captain Spaldeen takes Blinky's Note.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, let me see that note.  This might be a map... I've seen better faces on a clock!

quest_list.notes: Blinky gives you a map that looks like a goofy face.
quest_list.success_message: Blinky gave you a Note!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Honk... HONK! (Blinky rifles through the contents of a trench coat pocket and hands you a scrap of paper.)

quest_list.notes: Digging at ABRCAQX sends you back to Tropicton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: This code looks very nice - you dig all over...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: **POOF**  You're back in Tropicton.  That must not have been the right code.

quest_list.notes: Agree to find out about Fennel Seeds for Peru
quest_list.success_message: You volunteer to get the secret of the Fennel Seeds out of Tuque.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Turning back to her cleaning.) Well, if you manage to get a straight answer out of him, it would be a miracle.

quest_list.notes: Get info about fennel from Tuque
quest_list.success_message: You found out where the Fennel Seeds went.  Better go tell Peru!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, well, I don't know anything else about it.  You tell her that.

quest_list.notes: Peru sends you after fennel
quest_list.success_message: Peru asked you to locate her seven Fennel Plants and dig them up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I had seven seeds, so probably seven plants should be around somewhere.  Fennel plants have yellow and white flowers which you should be able to see, even at a distance, but you'll need to dig up the whole plants and bring them to me.

quest_list.notes: Peru rewards you for her fennel
quest_list.title: Peru's Fennel
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Vaguely.) Yes, yes, that's nice dear, but I think there should be more than this...
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Peru's Fennel!  You earned $6000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is wonderful!  It's been so long since we've had fennel for soup!  Please take this reward with my thanks.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Fennel 1 dig location
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig down next to a very weedy-looking plant with white and yellow flowers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have unearthed a large Fennel Plant!

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Gosh, do you think it's okay to dig up Appleton Town Square like this?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have unearthed a large Fennel Plant!

quest_list.notes: Use Tool to find Higgins the first time
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: In a high corner of the cabin, you spot a very small, glowing man.  Is he floating?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have found Higgins.

quest_list.notes: Accept Selena's vague quest
quest_list.success_message: You agree to help Selena.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I sensed that you were ready.   Now, allow me a moment to consult the guides.

quest_list.notes: Dig for your reward!
quest_list.title: Selena's Ethereal Summons
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig around outside the cabin and find a nice reward!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You Completed Selena's Ethereal Summons!  You earned $8000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Selena finishes her reading
quest_list.success_message: Selena suggests listening for a restless spirit near a place of wisdom and learning.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You will be able to hear this poor soul. Listen for its wailing moan. When you hear it, you will know you have found the right spot. Ground yourself and use your senses carefully to find the soul. I have faith that you can do this, dear!

quest_list.notes: Higgins requests Bath Salts and Cider
quest_list.success_message: Higgins asked you to collect Tea Tree Bath Salts and Spiced Apple Cider.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I would be thrilled if you would! A couple of things I'd love... Tea tree scented bath salts, and some spiced apple cider. Those would really make my day!

quest_list.notes: Ted Sells a large package of bath salts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you don't have enough for the bath salts.  I'll be happy to hold them for you, though.
quest_list.success_message: You paid $250 for a large package Tea-Tree-Scented Bath Salts and were asked to fetch them yourself.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, I left my supply of bath salts at the other racetrack, I'm afraid.  Would you mind running up there to fetch them?  You should be able to find them very easily.

quest_list.notes: Find Bath Salts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You easily spot a large supply of bath salts on the Steward's desk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You got a large package of Tea Tree Bath Salts.

quest_list.notes: Abigail gives you apple cider mix
quest_list.success_message: You were given a package of Spiced Apple Cider Mix.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Would that be my old friend Higgins?  Oh, for him, anything!  Please take this package of apple cider mix to him right away, and tell him I hope he feels better soon!

quest_list.notes: Give Higgins his Apple Cider and Bath Salts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: <i><font color='#6699CC'>Thanks for trying, but I don't see what I asked for.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Higgins the large package of Tea Tree Bath Salts and the Spiced Apple Cider Mix.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: <i><font color='#6699CC'>Thanks so very much!  This is exactly what I was hoping for!

quest_list.notes: Selena gives you a crystal statue because you're just too cool
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Crystal Statue!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The restlessness I felt earlier has been abated!  You have done wonderfully well!  Please allow me to give you this humble token of thanks.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Adolphus is here!

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Gustavus is here!

quest_list.success_message: Immediately, upon placing your shovel to the grass in this location, you are transported away.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have escaped from the Unknown Isle.

quest_list.notes: Check for all presents given
quest_list.title: Big Blue's Fishy Friends
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are you sure you gave presents to ALL of my friends?  Please make double sure.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Big Blue's Fishy Friends!  You earned a Sapphire Necklace, a Topaz Necklace and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks a million for helping my friends, kid!  Please take this reward with my sincere thanks!
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: After Quest, Big or Little Blue sends you to one island in exchange for a diamond
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Tsk tsk!  I don't see a diamond!  Are you trying to trick me?  Come back with a diamond, and then we'll talk.
quest_list.success_message: You have paid one Diamond in exchange for passage to an Unknown Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can tell you're determined.  You must have some pressing business on one of those isles.  So which will it be?

quest_list.notes: Big or Little Blue sends you to Gustavus' Unknown Isle (middle)
quest_list.success_message: You were sent to an Unknown Island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Hope you find what you're looking for.

quest_list.notes: Big or Little Blue sends you to Adolphus' Unknown Isle (west)
quest_list.success_message: You were sent to an Unknown Island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Hope you find what you're looking for.

quest_list.notes: Big or Little Blue sends you to Mercurius' Unknown Isle (east)
quest_list.success_message: You were sent to an Unknown Island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Hope you find what you're looking for.

quest_list.notes: Big Blue sends you to the store for produce
quest_list.success_message: You were asked to go get an Ear of Corn, a Pear, and a Bunch of Grapes from Zeke.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: First thing you wanna do is get over to the grocery store, and ask ol' Zeke for some supplies.  He might have these things in stock:  an ear of corn, a pear and a bunch of grapes.  Have Zeke pick out especially nice ones for you.

quest_list.notes: Big Blue sends you out to look for three gems
quest_list.success_message: You were asked to go get a Topaz, an Amethyst and an Emerald.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hahaha!  Hold your horses!  I also want to send a tribute to each of my friends!  Along with the food, I'd also like to give each one of them a gem to match his color.  Could you collect a topaz, an emerald and an amethyst next?

quest_list.notes: Get Corn and Pear from Zeke
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, you don't seem to have $50 for the corn and the pear.
quest_list.success_message: You received an Ear of Corn and a Perfect Pear for $25 each.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here are the corn and the pear.  These are the nicest ones I have.  $50, please.

quest_list.notes: Get Beautiful Grapes from Zeke
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, you don't seem to have $25 for the grapes.
quest_list.success_message: You received some Beautiful Grapes for $25.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here are the grapes.  Hope these will work for ya.

quest_list.notes: Learn the Three Wise Fish names
quest_list.success_message: You learned the names of the Three Wise Fish of the Eastern Seas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The first is Adolphus, the Golden Fish of the Sun.  Gustavus is the Green Fish of Nature.  Mercurius is the Purple Fish of Love.   I'm sure you can figure out which fish gets which gifts.  Which one would you like to visit first?

quest_list.notes: Give Adolphus Corn and Topaz
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hm... Something is missing here!  You should check your pockets for holes!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Adolphus an Ear of Corn and a Topaz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooh, goody goody for me!  I love corn!  And this shining gem will make the best bindi!  Thank you ever so!

quest_list.notes: Give Gustavus Pear and Emerald
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're missing something.  You might want to retrace your steps.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Gustavus a Perfect Pear and an Emerald.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now, that is very special.  I adore Pears, and the Emerald is so beautiful I could stare at it for hours.  I think I'll stick it right here above my beak.  Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Give Mercurius Grapes and Amethyst
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: *Glomp* Attack! *hugs hugs* Are you sure you really brought that stuff for me? 'Cause I don't SEE it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Beautiful Grapes and an Amethyst to Mercurius.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fishy Hugs!  You wonderful, wonderful human!  I adore grapes, and I've never seen such an overwhelmingly beautiful Amethyst!  You must've spent ages choosing the right one!  I'll stick it right here over my heart!

quest_list.notes: Gustavus Sends you back to big or little blue
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You were sent back to the Rider Isle Fish.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure thing!  Here you go.

quest_list.notes: Adolphus sends you sort of the right place
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You were sent away from the Unknown Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm sure I could send you there if I tried hard enough, darling.   Hmm... This is probably about right.

quest_list.notes: Gustavus' new Wise Fish pitch
quest_list.success_message: Gustavus would like you to ask Big Blue to visit him.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: When you see Big Blue again, tell him that we'd love to have him as a new Wise Fish, if he would like the position.  Please ask him to come visit me, so we can discuss it.

quest_list.notes: Big Blue accepts summons from Gustavus
quest_list.success_message: You have delivered Gustavus' message to Big Blue.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow!  I can't believe it!  Me?  ARRIGHT!  I'm heading out now!

quest_list.notes: Call Vesuvius correctly
quest_list.success_message: You have called Vesuvius.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are dumped into the water.  This seems familiar.

quest_list.notes: Use the Escape from Vesuvius' Isle
quest_list.success_message: Immediately, upon placing your shovel to the grass in this location, you are transported away.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have escaped from the Unknown Isle.

quest_list.notes: Little Blue sends you to Vesuvius' Unknown Isle
quest_list.success_message: You were sent to an Unknown Island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Hope you find what you're looking for.

quest_list.notes: Vesuvius sends you back to Little Blue.
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You were sent back to Little Blue.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure thing!  Say 'hi' to Little Blue for me, will ya?

quest_list.notes: Mercurius sends you sort of the right place
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You were sent away from the Unknown Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Send you somewhere?  Sure!  This'll be a riot!

quest_list.notes: Liza Gives money, bucket, asks you to talk to Henry
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Leaky Bucket, $2000 for expenses, and told to see Henry in Appleton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  Hurry back now, and be careful with my bucket!

quest_list.notes: Little Blue puts you back on land
quest_list.success_message: **POOF** Little Blue magically got you back to shore, and you're perfectly dry!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Allez Oup!

quest_list.notes: Dotti says she heard a scary noise.
quest_list.success_message: Dotti tells herself that there's a scary noise in the small forest to the north.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: How can I help this person understand that there's a scary noise in the little forest that's to the north of my own forest?

quest_list.notes: Find the guinea hen
quest_list.success_message: You found the source of the scary noise.  Better go tell Dotti!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Puh-kawk!

quest_list.notes: Guinea asks for 11 acorns
quest_list.success_message: Mama Guinea has asked you for some acorns.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Relieved sigh.) Puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk, puh-kawk!

quest_list.notes: Give Guinea Hen 11 acorns
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Mama Guinea looks disappointed and weary.) Puh-kawk.
quest_list.success_message: You have successfully interpreted Mama Guinea's need, and are rewarded with an Amethyst Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Mmuh-kmmff!! (Mama Guinea excitedly offers up an amethyst necklace in her little claw.)

quest_list.notes: Dotti Rewards you
quest_list.title: Dotti's Scary Noise
quest_list.success_message: You have completed Dotti's Scary Noise!  You have earned $2000, a Balloon Animal, a Gum Drop and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Dotti is so relieved!  Dotti wishes she could ask the helpful person to take these most special posessions as a reward.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Big Troll helps you go see the fish, because you asked nicely.
quest_list.success_message: Big Troll nudged you into the ocean!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Nudge.) Have fun, nice human!

quest_list.notes: Liza gets repaired bucket back -
quest_list.title: Liza's Leaky Bucket
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Liza's Leaky Bucket!  You earned $13,000 and 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It's better than I ever expected!  What a skilled artisan Krista is!  Thank you so very, very much!  Please, take this reward... it's nothing compared to my gratitude.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Henry tells you to not get a modern looking repair
quest_list.success_message: Henry has asked you to find someone who works with wood to fix the bucket.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, go ahead.  Just keep in mind that Liza won't be happy with a modern-looking repair.

quest_list.notes: Krista sends you out for lac
quest_list.success_message: Krista has taken the Leaky Bucket, and asks you to find a few ounces of Lac for her.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Any person who has knowledge about insects could point you toward some lac.  Let me just take the bucket from you before you go, and I'll start preparing it to take a patch.

quest_list.notes: Flicka gives you lac
quest_list.success_message: You are given a few ounces of Lac.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here are a few ounces for you - I'm thrilled you're so interested in bugs!

quest_list.notes: Krista takes Lac
quest_list.success_message: You gave Krista the Lac.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  This will work perfectly.   Let me just take that from you and put it somewhere safe.

quest_list.notes: Krista gives you the marked wood
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Length of Cedar Wood.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is the wood.  Thanks for doing all this!  I'm sure you'll be pleased with the result of the restoration.

quest_list.notes: Cedric takes length of cedar, gives axe
quest_list.success_message: Cedric has given you Ol' Betsy and suggested finding someone with a Whetstone to sharpen her.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You do seem determined.  Go ahead and leave the length of wood here, and take Ol' Betsy with you.  Anyone with a good whetstone could get her sharp enough.

quest_list.notes: Ryland asks for a bucket of water
quest_list.success_message: Ryland has asked you to fetch him a Pail of Water.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, no... Nothing so bizarre!  I just need a bucket of water from the feed store.  Could you run and get me one?

quest_list.notes: Give Ryland Pail of Water
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What?  No water?  Please run over to the feed store and fetch a pail for me... I do need one so I can help you, after all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ryland a Pail of Water.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Ryland grabs the pail and drinks greedily.) Wow, I was sure thirsty! All that talk of water... (Glug, glug, glug.)

quest_list.notes: Ryland gives you sharpened axe
quest_list.success_message: Ryland has finished sharpening Ol' Betsy.  Cedric will be pleased.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: ...Voila!  A beautiful razor-sharp edge!  You do realize that a sharp edge will not last long on an axe, right?

quest_list.notes: Cedric takes ol' Betsy, gives rough hewn cedar plug
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Rough-Hewn Cedar Plug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just a couple of careful splits on this little length of cedar... and there you have it!  A rough-hewn bit of cedar.  I hope that's what you were looking for.

quest_list.notes: Give Cedar Plug to Krista
quest_list.success_message: You gave Krista the Rough-Hewn Cedar Plug.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is a perfect match in every way!  The person you found to cut this must have been an expert!

quest_list.notes: Pester Krista for the Bucket
quest_list.success_message: Krista needs more time.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please give me a little more time.  Another hour ought to do it.

quest_list.notes: Pester Krista for the Bucket 2
quest_list.success_message: Krista needs more time.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please give me a little more time.  Another hour ought to do it.

quest_list.notes: Finally get the bucket
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, the restoration costs $1000.  Please come back when you have it!
quest_list.success_message: You paid $1000 and received Liza's beautiful Primitive Bucket.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I even amazed myself with this repair job.

quest_list.notes: Henry takes pity on you and gives you more travel money
quest_list.success_message: Henry gave you an extra $1000 toward travel fares.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  Of course!  It should have occured to me that you'd have to travel a lot more than Liza had expected.  Please take this, with my apologies!

quest_list.notes: You agree to deliver the first pair of Jade's Gifts.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Birthstone Necklaces to Nadine and Krista.   You were given $500.

quest_list.notes: Yellow Dragon Asks for 7 Ferns - this action fixes the yellow dragon's CP0/CP11 problem
quest_list.success_message: The Yellow Dragon has asked for seven Ferns.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes!  I'd like seven ferns, please.  That should be just enough to plant all the way around my cave.

quest_list.notes: You deliver Jade's gift to Krista.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, where is it, then?  You can't give me a sapphire necklace if you don't have a sapphire necklace!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Krista a Sapphire Necklace from Jade.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is beautiful!  Thank you.  I'll have to run over and see her when I get a chance.  Not now, though.

quest_list.notes: You deliver Jade's gift to Nadine.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hm, my birthstone is emerald.  You don't seem to have an emerald necklace.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Nadine an Emerald Necklace from Jade.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: An emerald necklace!  She is too kind.  Thank you very much for bringing this.

quest_list.notes: Jade gives you money for the second pair of gifts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are you sure you delivered both?  Please double check.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring a Ruby Necklace to Viola and a Diamond Necklace to Ethel.  You were given $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, here's $2000.  This will be wonderful!  Thank you!

quest_list.notes: You deliver Jade's gift to Ethel.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But thou hast no such necklace!  This is a cruel jest!  Begone!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ethel a Diamond Necklace from Jade.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Shakespeare was born in April, you know - or at least he was baptized in April.  No one is exactly sure of his birthdate.  He died in April as well, 52 years later.  Ah, I shall wear this brilliant gem with joy.  Thank you.

quest_list.notes: You deliver Jade's gift to Viola.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: She would have sent a ruby necklace - you don't have one.  Perhaps you meant to visit someone else.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Viola a Ruby Necklace from Jade.  You were given Pie a la Mode.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Jade is such a sweetheart to think of me, let alone remember I was born in July.  Thank you for coming all this way just to deliver a gift from an old friend.  Here, take this with you.

quest_list.notes: You return to Jade at the end of the delivery.
quest_list.title: Jade's Gift
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are you sure you delivered both?  Please double check.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Jade's Gifts!  You earned $10,000, 4 Silver Chains and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: How lovely!  I am so happy you could help me give my friends their gifts.  Please take this with my thanks.
quest_list.author: Bazjack

quest_list.notes: Tracks first pair of deliveries for Jade's Gifts.
Tracks second pair of deliveries for Jade's Gifts.
Give Yellow Dragon 7 Ferns

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, I asked for seven ferns. What you have there isn't even enough to shake a fish at!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Yellow Dragon's Greenery!  You earned 6 Yellow Crystal Shards and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Seven ferns!  I'll plant these right now!  Here - take a few of these things for your trouble.  I have ever so many!

quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've heard tell of a little human plant doctor that lives to the northeast of here.  Surely he would know how to keep these things alive.

Karl tells you to talk to Zeke.

quest_list.success_message: Ferrel asked you to bring him 25 chunks of Iron Ore and 5 Pixie Dusts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, I'm no magician, but I've learned a few little tricks here and there.  I'll need 25 chunks of iron ore, and this is the tricky part, 5 pinches of pixie dust.

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you are adventurous enough to get to The Cloud Isles yet. I know of someone else that might be able to give you some if you are interested in knowing.
quest_list.success_message: Ferrel suggests where you can get the Pixie Dust for him.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You seem to be the adventurous type. You can get the pixie dust up in the Clouds.

quest_list.notes: Mrs. Claus shares her Pixie Dust
quest_list.success_message: Mrs. Claus has given you 5 pinches of Pixie Dust.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, dear, a leprechaun without his magic? I think I can spare a little to help him out. Here you go, my dear.

quest_list.notes: Ferrel gets his supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have everything I asked for!  Come back when you have it all.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good, I see you got everything. Give me some time to work my magic and you can have Fergus' new pot.

quest_list.notes: Ferrel gives you the new pot.
quest_list.success_message: Ferrel Ironman gave you Fergus' New Pot.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I just finished it.  Here you go.  Tell Fergus thanks again, but now we're square!

quest_list.notes: Fergus gets his new pot.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hush now, 'tis a real beauty, it 'tis.

quest_list.notes: Fergus rewards you
quest_list.title: Fergus' New Pot

**POOF**You are in the middle of Earton!

quest_list.notes: Get the quest from the Magenta Dragon
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I didn't really think you were up to it.
quest_list.success_message: The Magenta Dragon has asked you to find the egg from which he hatched and return it to him whole.

quest_list.notes: Find clues outside the Magenta Dragon's cave
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: On the one damp spot on the ground, you find a patch where it looks like something was rolled... and tiny footprints.  One or more small animals was here, scurrying around.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found some tiny paw prints outside the Magenta Dragon's cave.

quest_list.notes: Penfold suggests you make a plaster cast of the tracks you found.
quest_list.success_message: Penfold has suggested that you make a plaster cast of the animal tracks you found outside the Magenta Dragon's cave.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, that could be... almost anything.  Too bad you didn't make a plaster cast of the track.  If I could see it, I could tell you exactly what it was; I'm good at tracks!

quest_list.notes: Get Plaster and Water from Patrick in Ashton.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hah!  You can't afford this?  Who are you kidding?  Come back when you can.
quest_list.success_message: You've bought a sack of Plaster of Paris and some Water from Patrick.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Thanks for your business.

quest_list.notes: Make a plaster cast of the tracks outside the Magenta Dragon's cave.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: The ground here is too hard to dig in--all you manage to do is move ash and pumice into piles.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully use your shovel to mound ash and stones around the paw prints.  Then, after mixing the plaster, you pour it on top of the prints.  After about 20 minutes, you pry up the plaster.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You made a Paw Print Cast.  Bring it back to Penfold so he can identify them!

quest_list.notes: Give the Plaster Paw print Cast to Penfold
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not a plaster cast!  Sheesh!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Plaster Cast to Penfold.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent!  Hmmm... Let me find my paw print guide... Hmmm... Hang on a sec.

quest_list.notes: Uncover Max the Ferret in the Blue Dragon's maze.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Searching around with your rake, you come upon a little den built from sticks, stones and ash.  Inside, you find a chocolate-colored ferret, sleeping curled up in a ball.

quest_list.notes: Hansel's Supply list
quest_list.success_message: Hansel gave you an imposing Supply List for the bakery.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's a list of the supplies that I still need to find suppliers for.  You're a bright young thing.  I'm sure you'll have no problem lining up all my suppliers for me!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gives you the letters of credit
quest_list.success_message: Hansel gave you 12 Letters of Credit for his suppliers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, there's a lot needed to start up a bakery.  By the way, here are 12 letters of credit to give to the suppliers that you find for me.  Make sure that every vendor you find who agrees to be one of my suppliers gets one of these.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #6

quest_list.success_npc_chat: My Himalayan rock salt has arrived!  Thank you!  Here's your payment for the delivery!

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Agree to delivery #7

quest_list.success_npc_chat: That must be the special treats I ordered!  Sometimes you just have to outsource to get what you want.  Thank you!

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, kiddo.  Times are tough, so this is all I can spare, if you don't mind.

quest_list.success_message: You gave Lilac the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $3000!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, Sweetie.  Here's your money for the delivery!

quest_list.success_message: You gave Tucker the package from the Pony Express.  You were given $1500!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh... Well, in that case, thanks.  That must be my new banjo strings.  Here you go, Kid.

quest_list.notes: Pony Express Completed Delivery #12 Priscilla/Crystalton

quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find the Blue Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man for Rodney.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (He thinks for a few moments.) I believe I saw the Blue Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man fly off to the north and it crossed the water to the bigger isle up there.

quest_list.success_message: You gave Rodney the Blue Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh… 5% on the dollar.  I can put in a good word to Al for all your hard work, so maybe more...

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Last Pink Tube Man
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find the Pink Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man for Rodney.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I think you should be able to spot the Pink Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man pretty easy.  Just look up high in the trees in the woods east of here.

quest_list.notes: Clue to find Pink Tube Man
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You spotted the Pink Tube Man high in the trees, but suddenly the wind picked it up and it flew right into the mud hole!

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't ye say ya had something fer me from that Hansel fella?  Go back and git it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Porthole Wilma one of Hansel's Letters of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Avast, ye landlubber, what do ye want me ta do with this? (Staring at the letter of credit.)

quest_list.notes: Porthole Wilma signs her copy and gives you the coconuts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did ye fergit somethin'?
quest_list.success_message: Wilma gave you the Signed Letter of Credit and 5 Large Sacks of Coconuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arrr, I'll make me mark here fer ye and here be yer first 5 sacks of coconuts.  And thank ye fer helpin' a couple of lady buccaneers turn a new leaf.

quest_list.notes: Cannonball Cate gets her letter of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ain't ye supposed ta be givin' me somethin' from me new boss?  Go bring it ta me, now!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cannonball Cate the Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And what am I supposed ta do with this?

quest_list.notes: Cannonball Cate gives you the signed copy and her first delivery
quest_list.success_message: Cate gave you the Signed Letter of Credit and the first 5 Kegs of Molasses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Righty-oh, matey! Here ye be. (She signs the letter.) All legal-like and here be the first 5 kegs of molasses. I can see that this will be the beginnin' of a right profitable arrangement by cracky!

quest_list.notes: Use tool to find Pink Tube Man
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You found the Pink Tube Man in the mud hole!  Well, at least the arms are still flailing.  You should probably get this back to Rodney before all of your horses get covered in mud, too!

quest_list.notes: Give Pink Tube Man to Rodney
quest_list.title: The Search for Rodney's Wacky Tube Men
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the Pink Wacky Waving Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Man yet!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Search for Rodney's Wacky Tube Men!  You earned 2 Diamonds and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No matter!  You have done well finding the Wacky Inflatable Arm Flailing Tube Men and I will let Al Arrington know about your job well done!  Maybe if you come back later, I might have another sales job for you, too!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Rika gets the letter of credit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you were going to give me a letter of credit from Hansel? You'd better go get it!
quest_list.success_message: You have given Rika Hansel's Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Takes the letter from you.) No problem, thanks!

quest_list.notes: Rika gives you the signed copy and the spices.
quest_list.success_message: You were given the Signed Letter of Credit and the first 5 Sacks of Assorted Spices.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's fine, saves me the trouble of shipping them. I've taken the liberty of adding some spices I think he'll need, like nutmeg and clove. Tell him to let me know if there's anything else he needs with the next shipment.

quest_list.notes: Max sends you to Shellton for a hotel pillow.  (tracking)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Just go get me the pillow, will you?
quest_list.success_message: Max the ferret has asked you to get him a hotel pillow with the name of the place on it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm, let me think, let me think... ooo, yes, I once stole a really fine set of rubber erasers from the place in Shellton.  Why don't you try there?

quest_list.notes: Rosemary Sleepytime inscribes a pillow for Max.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I already gave it to you.
quest_list.success_message: Rosemary Sleepytime has given you an inscribed pillow for Max the Ferret.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah.  Here.

quest_list.notes: Trade Max the pillow for his Magenta Egg shard
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But... you don't really have it!  I knew you wouldn't...
quest_list.success_message: Max has given you his Egg Shard in return for the Hotel Pillow he wanted.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, look!  So fluffy!  So warm!  And... and she signed it!  To ME!  Ooooooooo! Thank you thank you thank you.  Here is the egg shard.  Oh, thank you!  She signed it!  Wow!

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all around, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You've found BugBug the Ferret.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Raking carefully, you find an old towel.  Wrapped up in this is an elderly ferret jill.

quest_list.success_message: BugBug will trade you a Claus Peppermint Ball for her piece of eggshell.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please get me a peppermint ball from Mrs. Claus, then I'll give you the eggshell.

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, sorry, dear, but you didn't bring enough of what I need.  Please try to find the rest.

quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Oh, excellent! Just a moment.......................

Here you go. One Peppermint Ball. Just try not to eat it yourself on the way back!

quest_list.notes: (Tracking only) King Phil has taken quest necklace.
Give BugBug a peppermint ball, get Shard No.2.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have what I wanted, sorry.
quest_list.success_message: BugBug the Ferret has given you a Magenta Dragon Egg Shard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my, this is yummy.  Here you go.  Enjoy!  Oh!  And when you get them all, don't forget to get the egg mended.

quest_list.notes: Uncover Eris the Ferret

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Raking carefully, you find an old shoe-box.  Opening the box, out pops a small, chocolate ferret!

quest_list.success_message: Eris says she doesn't have any dragon eggshell shards.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Raking carefully, you find a huge stash of old socks.  Curled up in the middle is a huge, chocolate-silver ferret hob.

Give the first dream box to Jasper.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Dream Mare?  That's why I haven't been getting very much sleep.  I'm not quite sure why she sent you, but please tell her thank you for me.

quest_list.notes: Dan tells you where to go get Raisins to use to lure Eris out of her den. (Tracking)

quest_list.notes: Receive first dream box from Isleen.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Cheater!

quest_list.notes: Agree to get food for Augie's cat.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much. I look forward to feeding the fish to Shadow.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah.  All is well, then.  Accept thee my reward.  And also... take this.  It keeps running in here and being quite a pest!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Agree to find teddy bear for Dominique (goes with 35)
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Tally's Teddy Bear for Dominique.

quest_list.notes: Patrick says nobody's tried to sell him a dragon egg (tracking only, so does get asked twice).
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: A... a what?  A dragon egg, you say?  You've got to be kidding.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A... a what?  A dragon egg, you say?  You've got to be kidding.

quest_list.notes: Manco gets the letter of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aren't you supposed to give me something?  Go get it!
quest_list.success_message: You have given Manco Hansel's Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Takes the letter of credit and stares at it.) What do I do with this?

quest_list.notes: Manco gives you the walnuts
quest_list.success_message: You have been given 5 Sacks of Walnuts and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This will be very good for our village.  Here you go, we are now Hansel's official supplier of walnuts!

quest_list.notes: Cinnamon gets the letter of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aren't you supposed to give me something? Go get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cinnamon Hansel's Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the letter.) This seems in order, now what?

quest_list.notes: Cinnamon gives you the first shipment of milk
quest_list.success_message: You were given the Signed Letter of Credit and the first 5 Cans of Milk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That will do just fine, it gives me some time to negotiate with Winchell over his rates.  Now, don't dawdle, get that milk to Hansel right away.  He doesn't need any sour milk, not from me anyways!

quest_list.notes: Agree to find baby bunnies for Mama Bunny
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Mama Bunny's 8 baby bunnies and return back to the nest.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have 8 babies and I am afraid you startled them off into the grass!  Check around in this area and come back when you find them all!

quest_list.notes: Find baby bunny #1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Leaning over and looking closely, you see a ball of brown fur.  You gently pick it up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Baby Bunny!

quest_list.notes: Give Mama Bunny her babies
quest_list.title: Mama Bunny's Missing Babies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you don't have all 8!  You must keep looking for all of my babies!  Please hurry!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mama Bunny's Missing Babies!  You earned 10 Carrots and 75 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my babies... They're all here!  Thank you!  This is all I can spare to thank you.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Penfold suggests places to look for the ferrets (tracking)
quest_list.success_message: Penfold identifies the paw prints as ferret tracks.

quest_list.notes: Dig up Anika's Lost Hat
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging around the pier, you notice a yellow thread.  Digging further, you uncover a yellow knitted cap.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Yellow Hat!

quest_list.notes: Get the yellow hat quest from Anika
quest_list.success_message: Anika would like you to dig around the bridge ends for her lost yellow woolen hat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It blew off my head while I was crossing the bridge to Snowball Isle.  With any luck, it washed up on the beach somewhere near one of the ends of the bridge.  If you dig or rake around there you may find it.

quest_list.notes: Give Anika the Hat
quest_list.title: Anika's Lost Hat
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not my hat, sorry.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Anika's Lost Hat!  You earned $2000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's it!  Thanks so much!  This was my horse's favorite hat, for... whatever reason!  I think it looked better on me, personally, but hey.  Thanks!  Please take this reward!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Bowen gets the letters of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but aren't you supposed to give me something?  Go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Bowen 2 of Hansel's Letters of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the letters.) These seem to be in order. What's next?

quest_list.notes: Bowen gives you the apples
quest_list.success_message: Bowen gave you the 5 Bushels of Apples and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All righty, here's your copy of the letter and the apples.

quest_list.notes: Bowen gives you the oranges
quest_list.success_message: Bowen gave you the 5 Bushels of Oranges and the other Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Certainly!  Here's your oranges and the copy of the letter, all square.

quest_list.notes: Chaffie gets Hansel's letter of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you were going to give me something. Go get it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Chaffie Hansel's Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Reading the letter.) So all I have to do is sign this and give you a copy?

quest_list.notes: Chaffie gives you the flour shipment
quest_list.success_message: Chaffie gave you the 5 Barrels of Flour and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, then.  I gave you the flours I thought would most be used in a bakery. Hansel can always change the order.  By the way, you don't have to yell.  I'm not deaf, you know!

quest_list.notes: Dr. Fernlove gets the letter of credit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You obviously forgot something... We shall continue our business when you come back with it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dr. Fernlove Hansel's Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All this legal-ese...  What do you want me to do with this?

quest_list.notes: Dr. Fernlove gives you the berries (!)
quest_list.success_message: Dr. Fernlove gave you 5 Crates of the most incredible Assorted Berries you have ever seen and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Here is your copy of the letter of credit and an assortment of my finest berries.

quest_list.notes: Ricky gets the letters of credit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You already gave me the letters.  What next?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ricky Mantequilla 3 of Hansel's Letters of Credit, one for each of his items.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the letters.) These look all right. What do we do next?

quest_list.notes: Ricky gives you the eggs
quest_list.success_message: Ricky gave you 5 Cases of Eggs and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's the first signed letter and the eggs.

quest_list.notes: Ricky gives you the butter
quest_list.success_message: Ricky Mantequilla gave you 20 Pounds of Butter and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Next?  How about the butter and the butter letter?

quest_list.notes: Ricky gives you cream cheese
quest_list.success_message: Ricky Mantequilla gave you 20 Pounds of Cream Cheese and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Finally, here's my brand new cream cheese, and the letter, of course. Hope they like it!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his apples
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need the apples and the signed copy of the letter of credit, come back when you have both.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Bushels of Apples and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These apples are the best I've seen.  They'll be perfect!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his berries.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, this isn't right.  I need the berries and the signed letter of credit.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Crates of Assorted Berries and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These berries are the biggest, most perfect berries I've ever seen.  You've outdone yourself!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his spices.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Have you gone daft? I need both the signed letter and the spices! Now, get going!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Sacks of Assorted Spices and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking through the spices.) That's so intuitive of Rika. I realized I forgot to add these to the list. She's an excellent choice, thanks!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the milk
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Again you forgot that I need both the milk and the signed copy, get going!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Cans of Milk and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't believe you found me a milk vendor so near to me.  Wonderful work!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the butter
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You forgot again?  I need the butter and the signed copy of the letter of credit.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 20 Pounds of Butter and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is a very high quality butter.  Excellent work!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the cream cheese
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Again... I need both the product and the copy!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 20 Pounds of Cream Cheese and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is a very tasty cream cheese.  Good job!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his oranges
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need both the produce and the signed letter of credit, remember?!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Bushels of Oranges and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent oranges.  You chose a fabulous orchard man.

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets his eggs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Okay, let's try this again... I need the product and the signed copy of my letter of credit... Got it?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Cases of Eggs and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Very good.  Can't run a bakery without eggs, you know!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the flour.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need both the product and the signed letter of credit, remember?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel the 5 Barrels of Flour and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm glad that she grinds different types of flour.  I like to experiment until I find just the right combinations.  Again, you've proven to be an excellent choice!

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the coconuts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Please remember, I need both the product and the signed letter of credit!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Large Sacks of Coconuts and the Signed Letter of Credit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My, these are, without a doubt, the best looking coconuts I've seen in a good long time.  Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the walnuts
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Once more... I need the signed copy of the letter of credit AND the product!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel 5 Sacks of Walnuts and the Signed Letter of Credit.
