quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hast thou forgotten what thou were asked for?  Come back when thou hast them all, mortal.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Oberon's Midsummer Celebration.  You earned a Ruby Necklace, an Emerald Necklace and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thou shall be rewarded for all thy hard work on our behalf.  Here, accept these baubles as my gift.  Now thou must leave our gathering, Farewell, mortal, ever shall thee be blessed, now trip away, no more to stay!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Titania sends you away from the Mystic Forest
quest_list.success_message: **POOF** You are now outside the Mystic Forest.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Farewell and goodspeed, mortal! (You hear a chorus of fairies bidding you farewell.)

quest_list.notes: Pyramid Labyrinth Quest #10 Torrid Isle. S of docks.
quest_list.title: Pyramid Treasure #10
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already found the treasure in this pyramid!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Pyramid Treasure Quest #10!  You found $6000, 1 Diamond and earned 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You successfully found the treasure in this pyramid!
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Janice gives ginger ale
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Woaaah, you drank, like, four glasses of ginger ale and now it's all gone, man.
quest_list.success_message: You drank Ginger Ale.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So come on over here!  I made this ginger ale myself, with, like, fresh ginger and, like, imported deep aquifer water, man!

quest_list.notes: You agree to find a spinning wheel for Janice - collect $6k
quest_list.success_message: You were given $6,000, and asked to buy a Spinning Wheel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow, rully?  Fer shur?  I'm sooo, like, stoked, you know?  So here's the $6,000 for you!  Like, the more modern the spinning wheel, the better, man!  My mom likes to be all efficient and stuff.

quest_list.notes: Laurence asks you for help with his turban
quest_list.success_message: Laurence has sent you to the library in Shellton to look up how to make a turban and get some new material for him.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Miss Beatrice in Shellton has always been nice to me.  Ask her.

quest_list.notes: Agree to find items for Anabelle
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Anabelle 10 Feathers and 20 Skinny Branches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hawwk! (She makes a small noise in confirmation.)

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Felicia find her mom
quest_list.success_message: You agree to help Felicia search for her mom.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I don't mind.  She's probably fine, but I haven't seen her in a while.

quest_list.notes: Find Felicia's Mom
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You gently rake through the amazing assortment of junk piled around the hut, and voila, you uncover a large woman snoozing under a pile of papers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Felicia's mom.

quest_list.notes: Felicia rewards you
quest_list.title: Missing Maude
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Missing Maude!  You earned $4000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, what a relief! (Laughs.) That's so like Mom to fall asleep in a pile of stuff. You've taken a load off my mind. Please accept this as a token of thanks!
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Maude emerges from the pile of papers
quest_list.success_message: Maude is finally awake.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, me?  I'm fine.  Happy as a clam.  Thanks for asking!

quest_list.notes: Beatrice Bibliophile helps you with Laurence
quest_list.success_message: Beatrice gave you an Instruction Sheet and a Biography for Laurence.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The paper is step by step instructions on tying a Moroccan Shesh.  That's a kind of desert turban, and the book is another biography of T.E. Lawrence I've been keeping for Laurence.

quest_list.notes: Liza gives you a modern spinning wheel
quest_list.success_message: You were given a Spinning Wheel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, no, dear.  It was given to me, I couldn't sell it to you!  Go ahead - take it.  My treat!  If Chaffie ever asks after it, I'll have a heartwarming story to give her in return.

quest_list.notes: Albert Junker sells you the linen
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It doesn't look like you have enough money right now.  Don't worry, I'll hold onto it for you.
quest_list.success_message: You bought 3 Yards of Linen from Albert for $200.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, then.  I hope this linen works out for you.  Come again!

quest_list.notes: Give Spinning Wheel to Janice
quest_list.title: Maude's Modern Spinning Wheel
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, man, you spent all that money anyway.  I was totally going to ask you to keep it, too.  I can't talk about it right now.  You bummed me out, man.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Maude's Modern Spinning Wheel.  You earned $2000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please keep the $6000!  It's worth it to me!  The family tradition means so much more to us than mere money.  I was going to give you this extra, too, for your trouble.  Thank you so much, fer shur!
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Laurence  gets the book and instructions
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't given me everything you said you would... Go get the rest!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Laurence his book and instructions.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, boy! Leave it to Beatrice to find something special for me.

quest_list.notes: Laurence gets his linen and rewards you
quest_list.title: Laurence's Turban
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where's my linen?  Go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Laurence's Turban.  You earned $5000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This material smells a little like moth balls, but I'm sure it will be fine.  Thank you for your help.  Please accept this small token of my appreciation.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Sandcastle Moat #20 north end Torrid
quest_list.title: Sandcastle Moat #20
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this Sandcastle Moat!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Sandcastle Moat #20! You earned $4000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Congratulations on completing the Sandcastle Moat!

quest_list.notes: Swim to Dust Isle from Torrid Isle
quest_list.success_message: You climb out of the water on the shore of Dust Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (He goes back to tossing nets around as you dive off the end of the dock.)

quest_list.notes: Vivian asks for an inspiring item
quest_list.success_message: Vivian asked you bring back the first item you find in yellow desert sand.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All you have to do is walk around on the yellow desert sand until you find an item.  The first item you find, bring it back to me and perhaps I'll be inspired by it.

quest_list.notes: Chained action for checking an item with Vivian (tracking only)
Show Vivian a little lizard
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: A little lizard, you say?  Oh, dear, I don't see one.  Perhaps he wiggled away.  Bring him back when you find him, though!
quest_list.success_message: You show Vivian a Little Lizard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, he's perfectly marvellous!  Fiery oranges and yellows - almost a sun theme, wouldn't you think?

quest_list.notes: Emmett Perl sends you to Rain Isle the first time
quest_list.success_message: **POOF**  You are now on Rain Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Good luck.  Bring back something for my store should you find anything interesting.

quest_list.notes: Show Vivian a scorpion
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: A scorpion, you say?  Oh, dear, I don't see one.  Perhaps he wiggled away.  Bring him back when you find him, though!
quest_list.success_message: You show Vivian a Scorpion.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, he's perfectly fabulous!  Dark, mysterious and even dangerous - a cave-like theme, wouldn't you think?

quest_list.notes: Show Vivian a diamond
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: A diamond, you say?  Oh, dear, I don't see one.  Bring it back when you find it, though!
quest_list.success_message: You show Vivian a Diamond.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, very lovely indeed!  Bright, clear and sparkly - a sort of ethereal theme is coming to mind.  What do you think?

quest_list.notes: Show Vivian a coconut
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: A coconut?  Oh, dear, I don't see one.  Bring it back when you find it, though!
quest_list.success_message: You show Vivian a Coconut.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I think it's the perfect inspiration!  A tiki theme is abundently clear, don't you think?

quest_list.notes: Vivian rewards you for a job well done
quest_list.title: Vivian's Inspiration
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Vivian's Inspiration.  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, indeed!  I'm very pleased.  You've been a wonderful muse.  Please take this as a reward for your invaluable service.
quest_list.author: Vetiver

quest_list.notes: Give Anabelle the items for her Nest
quest_list.title: Anabelle's Nest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Haaaawwwwakkk!!! (She makes an angry noise and shakes her head.)
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Anabelle's Nest.  You earned a Ruby Necklace and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Haaawwww! Hawwwkk! (The eagle makes little appreciative noises and pushes something shiny over to you.)
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Grasshoppers and Worms for Anabelle
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 10 Grasshoppers and 10 Earthworms for Anabelle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hhawwk! (She nods her head in agreement.)

quest_list.notes: Give Anabelle the Grasshoppers and Earthworms
quest_list.title: Eaglets' Dinner
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Haaaawwwwwwaaakkkk!!! (She makes an angry screeching noise.)
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Eaglets' Dinner.  You earned a Diamond and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hawwk! Hawwwaakk! (She nods her head in thanks and drops something down from her nest for you.)
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Emmett Perl sends you to Rain Isle
quest_list.success_message: **POOF**  You are now on Rain Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go!  Good luck.

quest_list.notes: Leontine sends you to Vine Isle
quest_list.success_message: Leontine has teleported you to Vine Isle... somewhere.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Shoo!

quest_list.notes: Beginning of Leontine's quest.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Look, I'm not going through all this again.  Get lost!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Never you mind.  You're not them.  Now scat!

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Danner get boat supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: The best rope is made with vines found on this 'ere isle.  Go ask one of the local residents for some help findin' some.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Cap'n D fix his boat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, the best rope is made with vines found on this 'ere isle.  Go ask one of the local residents for some help findin' some.

quest_list.notes: Go find some vines
quest_list.success_message: Esther told you to look up in the trees to the west to find vines.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Head to the west of here and look up into the trees. Come back when you have five vines. That should be enough to make a sturdy rope.

quest_list.notes: Vine #1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up into the trees and cut down a long vine.

quest_list.notes: Vine #2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up into the trees and cut down a long vine.

quest_list.notes: Vine #3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up into the trees and cut down a long vine.

quest_list.notes: Vine #4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up into the trees and cut down a long vine.

quest_list.notes: Vine #5
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up into the trees and cut down a long vine.

quest_list.notes: Give vines to Esther
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, dear.  You have to keep looking!  We need five really good vines to make a rope sturdy enough for a boat.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Esther 5 Vines. In return, she gave you 1 Vine Crafted Rope.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  A little twist and some glue...  Perfect!  Give this to your friend and tell him good luck with his repairs!

quest_list.notes: Agree to run errand for Jada
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to run an errand for Jada.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  Please give this peculiar bug to Nedrick.  I found it this morning and I'm sure he would love to have it!

quest_list.notes: Give Nedrick bug
quest_list.title: Jada's Errand
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Jada's Errand.  You earned $500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is a black swallowtail caterpillar!  I cannot believe it!  Here, please take this for your troubles.  Thank you!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Agree to find button for Icy
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Icy find his lost button.  *POOF*  You are now on Icicle Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks!  Make sure you look real close by the rocks for my button.

quest_list.notes: Danner checks for everything
quest_list.title: Cap'n D's Ship Repairs
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Nay, ye are still missing somethin'.  Come back when ye have it all, matey.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cap'n D's Ship Repairs.  You earned $4000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, that is just what I need to get the old girl in top shape.  Thank ye for ye help, matey!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Robinson wants fruit
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to bring Robinson some fresh fruit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You could!?  Would it be too much of an imposition to ask for a dozen oranges and six bananas?

quest_list.notes: Robinson gets his fruit
quest_list.title: Robinson's Fruit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Thanks for what you did get, but could you get all of the fruit I asked for?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Robinson's Fruit.  You earned 4 Seashell Necklaces and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My, these look so wonderful and you got back so quickly... You're not a magician, are you?  Never mind, take these for your troubles, I made them myself.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Cheeky
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Cheeky join the Monkey Thieves Guild.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ooooo oooo eeeeee eeeeep!!

quest_list.notes: Matata okays Cheeky for the guild
quest_list.success_message: Matata agrees to let Cheeky into the Monkey Thieves Guild.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fine.  He can come play with us!  Just tell him to meet us at the pyramid in the middle of Torrid Isle on the first of every month for meetings.

quest_list.notes: Cheeky not a monkey??!!
quest_list.success_message: Cheeky removes his monkey suit...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's right.  You see...  I'm not a monkey at all.

quest_list.notes: Det. Cheekster gives reward.
quest_list.title: More Monkey Business
quest_list.success_message: You Completed More Monkey Business!  You earned $5000, 5 Bananas and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks again for all of your help.  Here's a little something special for your troubles.
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Agree to find wendy for Griffin
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find Wendy for Griffin.  Try looking around for clues.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Her name is Wendy and she has red pigtails.  I'm not sure where she went, but you might find some clues if you look around outside.

quest_list.notes: Find Wendy's footprints leading to Eartip forest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You see footprints walking towards Eartip Forest.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You should go look for Wendy in the forest.

quest_list.notes: Wendy asks for her uncle's ladder.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to bring Wendy her Uncle Griffin's Ladder.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Bring me Uncle's ladder so I can get my kite out of the tree, and then we can talk.

quest_list.notes: Recieve ladder from Griffin for Wendy
quest_list.success_message: You were given Griffin's Ladder!  You should return to Wendy now.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, I see. That shouldn't be a problem. Let me see here. (Griffin goes to a closet and then pulls out his ladder and hands it to you.) This should work! Just please bring her home when you're done.

quest_list.notes: You bring Wendy the ladder and get her kite out of the tree for her.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, you didn't bring me the ladder.  Please go get it.
quest_list.success_message: You brought Wendy her Uncle's Ladder and got her kite out of the tree.  You should take Wendy home now.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's great!  Now I know you're not a stranger and I have my kite back.

quest_list.notes: Wendy gives you back the ladder and you both go back to her Uncle Griffin's
quest_list.success_message: *Poof* You and Wendy traveled back to Griffin's together.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay!  We can go home together.  Oh, and don't forget the ladder.

quest_list.notes: Bring Wendy and the ladder back to griffin.
quest_list.title: Griffin's Niece
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but I think you forgot my ladder.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Griffin's Niece!  You earned $3000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much for helping me.  I'm glad my niece made it back in time for her parents to pick her up.

quest_list.notes: Weekday asks for help
quest_list.success_message: Weekday has asked your help to find them a home.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be perfect!  It doesn't have to be deluxe accommodations, just protection from the elements.  I'm sure you'll do a good job.

quest_list.notes: Agree to get three honeycombs for Integra
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, never mind.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to bring Integra three Honeycombs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes.  Please get me three of them, so I'll have honey for a while.  Honey on toast.  Mmmmm!  Luscious!

quest_list.notes: Clarissa needs bottles.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Uhm... what?
quest_list.success_message: Clarissa would like you to get her 24 bottles and labels.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Can you get me... 24 bottles from somewhere?  And labels for them?

quest_list.notes: Tony Grocer sells you a crate of empty bottles.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the $2000 to pay for these.  Come back again when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a crate of 24 Empty Glass Bottles for $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Twenty-four empty one-liter bottles.  That'll be $2000.  As for the labels...  There's a papermaker on one of the jungle isles, don't remember which, but you could look.

quest_list.notes: Buy 24 gummed labels from Trayja
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you don't have the money.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You bought 24 Gummed Labels for the empty bottles that Clarissa wanted.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  Thanks for your business!

quest_list.notes: Give Clarissa the bottles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the bottles!  What happened?  Please get them for me like you said you would.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Clarissa the Crate of Empty Bottles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you!  These will do fine!

quest_list.notes: Give Clarissa the labels
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the labels!  What happened?  Please get them for me like you said you would.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Clarissa the Gummed Labels.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are just what I need.  I wonder what I'll put on them?

quest_list.notes: Clarissa is fixed up to sell bottled water...
quest_list.title: Clarissa's Mineral Enterprise
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not yet, sorry.  There's still something you need to find.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Clarissa's Mineral Enterprise!  You earned $9,000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, that's everything!  Now maybe I can keep that hot spring in order!  Thanks so much!  Please accept this reward!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Agree to get butterflies to replace the ones Nedrick's dog ate.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, forget it.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to get Nedrick three Hairstreak Butterflies from Art Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd like three Hairstreak Butterflies.  They come from Art Isle, and you find them where it's very rocky, just on the edges of the different environments.

quest_list.notes: Find Butterfly No. 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking carefully among the stones, you find a small butterfly sipping nectar from a tiny flower.  You carefully catch it and put it in a box.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You caught a Hairstreak Butterfly!

quest_list.notes: Find Butterfly No. 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking carefully among the stones, you find a small butterfly sipping nectar from a tiny flower.  You carefully catch it and put it in a box.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You caught a Hairstreak Butterfly!

quest_list.notes: Find Butterfly No. 3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking carefully among the stones, you find a small butterfly sipping nectar from a tiny flower.  You carefully catch it and put it in a box.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You caught a Hairstreak Butterfly!

quest_list.notes: Give Nedrick his butterflies.
quest_list.title: Nedrick's Hairstreaks
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But you don't have all of them.  I need all of them or none.  Please try to find the rest.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Nedrick's Hairstreaks.  You earned $6000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are lovely.  This one looks like one of my old ones.  Well, thank you!  Here's a reward for you, I'm sure you can find a use for it!  Thanks again!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Find Icy's button
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You have found Icy's Magic Button!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: *POOF* You are back on Snow Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give Icy button
quest_list.title: Icy's Lost Button
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Icy's Lost Button.  You earned $1500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There it is!  Thank you so much.  Here's your reward.  Come back and visit me anytime!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Icy Sends you to Icicle
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You have been magically transported to Icicle Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: With a twitch of my nose and... off we go!
quest_list.author: Nuova

quest_list.notes: Icy sends you back to Snow
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You have been magically transported to Snow Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: With a tip of my hat and... off we go!

quest_list.notes: Sandcastle Moat #21 Polar Isle s of Olivia's
quest_list.title: Sandcastle Moat #21
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have already completed this Sandcastle Moat!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Sandcastle Moat #21! You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Congratulations on completing the Sandcastle Moat!

quest_list.notes: Agree to ask Ted his pie order for Olivia.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to ask Ted what his pie order was.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The first order was for Ted in Frigid Meadows.  Could you start with him, please?

quest_list.notes: Find out Ted's pie order for Olivia
quest_list.success_message: You found out Ted ordered a blueberry pie.  You should go tell Olivia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She needs to learn to keep better track of important things.  I ordered a blueberry pie.  Now run along and leave me alone.

quest_list.notes: Tell Olivia Ted's Pie order.
quest_list.success_message: You told Olivia that Ted wanted a blueberry pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  He is a little grumpy, isn't he?  Are you ready to collect the ingredients for it?

quest_list.notes: Gather Blueberries for Olivia.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 15 Blueberries for Olivia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, then.  It looks like I have everything for the pie except the berries.  I will need 15 of those.  Please come back when you have them.

quest_list.notes: Bring Olivia 15 blueberries
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I'm sorry, but it looks like you still don't have quite enough.  Please come back when you have all 15.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Olivia 15 Blueberries for her first pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do quite nicely.  Thank you!  Are you ready for the next task?

quest_list.notes: Take the pie back to ted.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to take Ted his Pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Okay, then.  Now I'll need you to take this pie back to Ted while it's still warm.  In case you forgot, he's in Frigid Meadows.

quest_list.notes: Give Ted the pie from olivia.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Humph! I don't see any pie!  Now get out and leave me alone!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ted his Pie.  You should go talk to Olivia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks.  Now I need to get back to my work, so run along.

quest_list.notes: Return to Olivia for reward.
quest_list.title: Olivia's Pies #1
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olivia's Pies #1.  You earned $2000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much!  That definitely helped me out.  Let me know when you are ready for my next quest.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Michelle tells you that she wants a gift from Just Gus
quest_list.success_message: Michelle told you she expects a gift from Just Gus before she will accept his apology.

quest_list.notes: Agree to find abacus for Alexi
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I can hardly wait to be reunited with my abacus. Please hurry!
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to help Alexi find her lost Abacus.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can hardly wait to be reunited with my abacus. Please hurry!

quest_list.notes: Find Alexi's Abacus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking carefully through the sand, you find an old abacus.  You carefully brush the sand off of it.  Alexi will be excited to see this.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found an Abacus!

quest_list.notes: 3rd pig gives you his pallet of adobe bricks
quest_list.success_message: The Third Little Pig gave you his Adobe Bricks to return to the Postmaster General.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The Postmaster General that runs the Pony Express on the main isle down there. Make sure you get those red bricks that look like the ones on my house. There's nothing worse than mis-matched bricks. Not even a crumbly-looking porch.

quest_list.notes: Give Alexi her Abacus
quest_list.title: Alexi's Missing Abacus
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have my abacus. Please find it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Alexi's Missing Abacus.  You earned $1000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Can it be? It is, indeed! Ah, my little abacus. What a joy. I didn't realize how much I'd missed it. Thank you so much. Here's something to show my deep appreciation.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Gretel gives you a plate of cookies to give to Mother Goose
quest_list.success_message: Gretel gave you a Plate of Cookies for Mother Goose.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are. Thank you so much for doing this for us.

quest_list.notes: Give Mother Goose the plate of cookies
quest_list.title: Cookies from Hansel and Gretel
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you don't have any cookies. You didn't eat them, did you? Go see Hansel and Gretel and see if they have more for you.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Cookies from Hansel and Gretel.  You earned 3 Silver Linings and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, thank you! These look just scrumptious!  Here, take these for your trouble, dear.
quest_list.author: OkamiFreak

quest_list.notes: Leontine sends you for party favors.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, never mind.  You're not them anyway!
quest_list.success_message: Leontine would like you to go to Treeton and get a box of party favors for her.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I need a boatload of party favors!  I like the ones they sell at the general store in Treeton.

quest_list.notes: Sasha Stacker sells you an ancient box of unfashionable party favors.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you haven't got enough money there.  Please come again when you do.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a Box of Party Favors from the Treeton General Store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  I hope whoever's getting them enjoys them.  At least they're finally getting a home!

quest_list.notes: Give Leontine her party favors.
quest_list.title: Leontine's Party Favors
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't got what I sent you for!!  What did you do, have a party by yourself?  For shame!  Where's my stuff?
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Leontine's Party Favors!  You earned a Ruby Necklace and 50 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Leontine quickly opens the ancient box.) Well... these are... are... just like the ones I had for my 5th birthday! Oh, those big black horses are going to be SO surprised!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Agree to talk to Elsa and find out what pie she ordered for Olivia.
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to ask Elsa what her pie order was.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The next order was from Elsa.  She lives in Crystalton.  Could you go talk to her and find out what she wanted, please?

quest_list.notes: Ask Elsa her pie order.
quest_list.success_message: You found out that Elsa ordered an apple pie.  You should go tell Olivia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, Olivia!  I had ordered an apple pie.  They taste rather nice with a good cup of coffee.  Did you want a cup?

quest_list.notes: Tell Olivia, Elsa's order
quest_list.success_message: You told Olivia that Elsa wanted an apple pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: An apple pie?  Yes, that does sound about right.  Are you ready to collect the fruit for it?

quest_list.notes: Gather apples for Olivia
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to find 10 Apples for Olivia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, then!  I'm going to need 10 apples for this.  They're a bit bigger than blueberries, you know.

quest_list.notes: Give olivia the apples
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Actually, I think you may have miscounted.  Please come back when you have all 10 of them.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olivia 10 Apples.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are some nice apples.  Good work!  Are you ready for your next task?

quest_list.notes: Take Elsa her pie from Olivia
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to take Elsa her Pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now that the pie is finished, I need you to take it back to Elsa.  In case you forgot, she lives in Crystalton.

quest_list.notes: Give Elsa her pie
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you must have left the pie at Olivia's.  Please come back when you have it.
quest_list.success_message: You have given Elsa her Pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, wow!  That smells amazing; it should definitely taste so with a good cup of coffee.  Please give Olivia my thanks.

quest_list.notes: Return to Olivia for reward
quest_list.title: Olivia's Pies #2
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olivia's Pies #2. You earned $3500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's wonderful!  Here you are, please take this as a reward.  Are you ready for my last order?
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Agree to ask Valarie her pie order for Olivia
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to ask Valarie what her pie order was.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My next order was from Valarie in Chillton.  You'll need to go ask her what kind of pie she ordered.

quest_list.notes: Ask Valarie her pie order
quest_list.success_message: You found out that Valarie ordered a cherry pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  Well, I suppose it's a good thing she has you helping her, then, huh?  I wanted a cherry pie.  It's my favorite!

quest_list.notes: Tell Olivia Valarie's order.
quest_list.success_message: You told Olivia that Valarie wanted a cherry pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A cherry pie?  Yes, that does sound right.  I remember worrying about the cherries earlier.  All right, well, I have another task for you, if you're ready for it.

quest_list.notes: agree to talk to Ben Burlap for olivia
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to talk to Ben Burlap for Olivia.  She gave you $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Since this is a cherry pie, I'm going to need some cherries.  However, you'll have to go talk to Ben Burlap in Tropicton.  He's the owner of the store and is the only one who has perfect cherries for a pie. I'll give you a little bit of cash for the trip.

quest_list.notes: Receive cherries from Ben Burlap
quest_list.success_message: Ben Burlap gave you a Jar of Cherries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Olivia? Ah, yes, I remember her. I haven't seen her in a while, though. (He grabs a jar of cherries from under the counter.) Here you are. I'll just add those to her tab.

quest_list.notes: Give Able, the pigeon, to Colina in Ashton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ooops, I guess they all flew home on their own.  Sorry about that.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered Able, the Homing Pigeon, to Colina.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you!  Please tell Goodwin that I will be sure to release this pigeon exactly when he told me to.

quest_list.notes: Give Olivia the cherries.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, I'm sorry, you must have left them at the store.  Please go back and get them.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olivia the Jar of Cherries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes!  These should do quite nicely.  If you're ready, I have just one more task for you.

quest_list.notes: Agree to take Valarie her pie
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to take Valarie her Pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You catch on quick, don't you?  Please take this pie to Valarie and then come back and see me.

quest_list.notes: Give Valarie her pic.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Why would you tease me like that?  I don't see any pie.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Valarie her Pie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh!  It smells wonderful!  Please give her my thanks for me.

quest_list.notes: Return to Olivia for reward
quest_list.title: Olivia's Pies #3
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olivia's Pies #3. You earned $5000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you!  That means I'm all caught up.  Since you were such a big help, please take this as a reward.
quest_list.author: CheshireKitty

quest_list.notes: Goodwin gives you four trained homing pigeons to release at various spots for him.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, you know, I'll need you to go to places where only the more adventurous travellers go.  Come back some time when you've got more experience.
quest_list.success_message: Goodwin has given you 4 Homing Pigeons to bring to people on different isles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here are the pigeons.  Able goes to Colina in Ashton, Baker goes to Dolly in Hotton, Charlie goes to Pablo on Art, and Delta goes to Caren Hart in Tropicton!  Here is $4,000 for travel expenses.  Thanks!  Good luck!

quest_list.notes: Give Baker, the pigeon, to Dolly in Hotton.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Uh oh, looks like they got away from you!
quest_list.success_message: You safely delivered Baker, the Homing Pigeon, to Dolly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, how pretty!  Do let Goodwin know that I'll release this bird exactly on time.

quest_list.notes: Give Charlie, the pigeon, to Pablo on Art Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Looks like they've already gone home.  Maybe you'd better check.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Charlie, the Homing Pigeon, to Pablo.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for bringing him.  I'll make him comfortable and release him at the appointed time.

quest_list.notes: Give Delta, the pigeon, to Caren in Tropicton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Got away from you, did it?  Better let Goodwin know.
quest_list.success_message: You brought Delta, the Homing Pigeon, to Caren.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, how pretty!  Thanks for bringing her.  Please let Goodwin know she arrived safely.

quest_list.notes: Pigeons in readiness!
quest_list.title: Goodwin Ryder's Homing Pigeon Experiment
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't do it right.  You still have to deliver pigeons.  Oh, well...
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Goodwin Ryder's Homing Pigeon Experiment!  You earned $7000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  Now the experiment is set up and waiting to go!  I can't thank you enough, but hopefully this small reward will show my appreciation!  Thanks again!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Esther makes a suggestion
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Look on the next island, I think you'll find something there.
quest_list.success_message: Esther suggests you look on the next island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Look on the next island, I think you'll find something there.

quest_list.notes: Emmett makes a suggestion
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Come to think of it, I noticed a really nice uninhabited tree house on this very island.  It's near the southeast tip.  Take a look and see if it will do.
quest_list.success_message: Emmett Perl sends you to the tip of his island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Come to think of it, I noticed a really nice uninhabited tree house on this very island.  It's near the southeast tip.  Take a look and see if it will do.

quest_list.notes: Danner makes a suggestion
quest_list.success_message: Danner has sent you to the next island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, if it be fer a fellow tar, ye might look on the next island southwest of here.

quest_list.notes: Weekday thanks you and sends you to talk to Rob.
quest_list.success_message: Weekday gave you two Pearl Necklaces and told you to go talk to Robinson for the rest of your reward.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That just might work.  Here, take these pearls for helping me.  I'm sure Robinson will reward you after you give him the good news!

quest_list.notes: Robinson thanks you

quest_list.success_message: You Completed Daisy Gerbera's Bright Idea.  You earned $5,000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, yes!  Yes, yes indeed, yes, these will do very nicely.  Here's a bit of a reward for you, now don't spend it on foolish things like flowers from someone else's shop!  Ta-ta!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Agree to bring back items for Princess Pookie.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to return the stolen items to their rightful owners.  Princess Pookie gave you a Knit Hat, a Wacky Tube Man, a Dinosaur Bone, an Easter Egg, a Whip and a Miniature Horse.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here. Here's a knit hat. I was, like, told it was, like, cunning, or something. There's also this crazy, like, tube thing, a nifty whip... *SNAP!* Well, you got eyes. Here. (She tosses the items at you.)

quest_list.notes: Second set of things to bring back for Pookie
Third set of things to bring back for Pookie
Return the Miniature Horse to Holly
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holly the Miniature Horse.  She gave you $2000 as a reward.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, thank you so much!  It looks like it's still in great shape.  This was my favorite, so I'm so glad you were able to return it from wherever it was.  Here.  It's not much, but I do really appreciate it.

quest_list.notes: Give Jayne back his knit hat
quest_list.success_message: You gave Jayne back his Knit Hat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My hat! (He puts it on.) How's it sit? Pretty cunning, don'tchya think?

quest_list.notes: Give Rodney back his wacky tube man
quest_list.success_message: You gave Rodney back his Wacky Tube Man. He gave you $1500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect!  Here.  Take this as a reward.  I do appreciate you returning it.  I don't even want to know who stole it.

quest_list.notes: Give Felton back the dino bone.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Felton the Dinosaur Bone.  He gave you $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Carefully takes the fossil.) Ah! It is! I noticed this had gone missing. Thank you for returning it to me. Here, take this as a little reward.

quest_list.notes: Give Easter Bunny back the Easter Egg
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Easter Bunny back the Easter Egg.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, wonderful.  I did notice one was missing.  Hopefully, in the future, she'll remember to just ask.  Thanks for returning it.

quest_list.notes: Return the Whip to Witherton Jones
quest_list.success_message: You gave Witherton Jones the Whip.  He gave you a Silver Amethyst Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's it!  I was going to be needing that shortly.  Thank you for returning it.  Here, take this necklace I found during my travels.

quest_list.notes: Tell Pookie you returned everything.  Get reward
quest_list.title: Princess Pookie's Stolen Goods
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No you haven't.  You finish first, then maybe I'll give you something for it.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Princess Pookie's Stolen Goods.  You earned a Diamond Necklace, two Ruby Necklaces and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good. Now I won't, like, get in trouble again. (She throws a few things at you.) Here. They don't match anything anyway, but since you're so keen on stuff, you can have 'em. And yeah, these are, like, mine to give you. So there!
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Agree to pick up a dog toy for Mikko
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to pick up a dog toy from Iggy Chewtoy for Mikko.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! Go see Iggy Chewtoy in Earton. Just make sure Barney doesn't see it when you come back. I want to keep it a surprise!

quest_list.notes: Agree to get some orange tree saplings for Charla Mae
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but it seems you're not quite adventurous enough to visit Lava Isle yet. Come back when you have completed 25% of your quests, please.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get some Orange Tree Saplings from a farmer in Molten Meadows.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, would you, please? It would make a splendid project for me. I won't need too many saplings, so whatever the farmer wants to part with is fine with me.

quest_list.notes: Get dog toy from Iggy Chewtoy
quest_list.success_message: Iggy Chewtoy gave you the dog toy Mikko ordered.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure, no problem. Here you go. Is there anything else I can get for you?

quest_list.notes: Give Mikko the dog toy he ordered and get reward
quest_list.title: Barney's Birthday Present
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where is it? I couldn't bear not giving Barney something for his birthday!
quest_list.success_message: You completed Barney's Birthday Present! You earned $4000 and 35 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, you even had it wrapped! (He peeks through the paper covering the toy and grins.) I just know Barney will love it! Thank you so much for picking this up. Here, take this for your trouble.
quest_list.author: OkamiFreak

quest_list.notes: Pay $300 to find 3 orange tree saplings from Bowen's orchard
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you don't have the $300 I need for the saplings. Come back when you have the money.
quest_list.success_message: You paid $300 for Bowen to allow you to dig up 3 Orange Tree Saplings.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you! They'll be near the orange tree, and since there's no grass here, the saplings should be fairly easy to find. Remember, just get three.

quest_list.notes: Dig up 1st orange sapling
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You see a small, green plant that has to be an orange sapling and dig it up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You dug up an Orange Tree Sapling!

quest_list.notes: Dig up 2nd orange sapling
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You see a small, green plant that has to be an orange sapling and dig it up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You dug up an Orange Tree Sapling!

quest_list.notes: Dig up 3rd orange sapling
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You see a small, green plant that has to be an orange sapling and dig it up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You dug up an Orange Tree Sapling!

quest_list.notes: Give Charla Mae the orange saplings
quest_list.title: Saplings for Charla Mae
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have three orange tree saplings. Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You completed Saplings for Charla Mae! You earned $5000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are fantastic! That's not that bad, really, having to pay $300 for three saplings. Here, this should more than make up for the fee.
quest_list.author: OkamiFreak

quest_list.notes: Atreyu asks you to find a vet to help Falcor
quest_list.success_message: Atreyu has asked you to find a vet that can help Falcor.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you. I'm glad you are concerned about his health, too. I know not which vet can help my old friend, so you will have to visit each one until you find one that is able to.

quest_list.notes: Get Falcor's medicine from Caren Hart
quest_list.success_message: Caren Hart gave you the Luckdragon Medicine Falcor needs to get better.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! (She hands you a small box.) Everything Atreyu should need is in there, including my instructions. Tell him to contact me if Falcor isn't improving in a couple days.

quest_list.notes: Dr. Heimlich points you to the Tropicton vet for Falcor's medicine
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I do. Try seeing the vet in Tropicton. She'll probably be able to help, since she's closest to the Cloud Isles and its mythical creatures.
quest_list.success_message: Dr. Heimlich suggested that you speak with the Tropicton vet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I do. Try seeing the vet in Tropicton. She'll probably be able to help, since she's closest to the Cloud Isles and its mythical creatures.

quest_list.notes: Give Atreyu the medicine for Falcor
quest_list.title: The Seemingly Neverending Illness
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have anything I can use to help Falcor get well.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Seemingly Neverending Illness! You earned $8000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (He takes the box and reads the instructions.) Oh, this should work wonders on my old friend! I'll give this to him right away. Thank you ever so much for your kindness!
quest_list.author: OkamiFreak

quest_list.notes: Agree to get more treats for Jaxon Whanacrackur's pet store
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Animal Treats from the local feed store for Jaxon Whanacrackur.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, not really.  If you mention to Luke that it's for me, he'll know what I need.  Thanks a bunch!

quest_list.notes: Luke gives you box of treats for Hotton Pets
quest_list.success_message: Luke Straw gave you a Box of Animal Treats.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sounds good. (He starts to grab some things off the shelf, writes something on a pad, then throws them in a box.) Here you are. This should hold him for a bit. He knows it will just be on his monthly bill.

quest_list.notes: Give Jaxon the box of animal treats.  Complete quest
quest_list.title: Treats for Hotton Pets
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You must have left them somewhere, because you don't have them with you.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Treats for Hotton Pets.  You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that's great!  Thanks so much.  Here, take this.  It isn't much, but it should help some.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Max Attire wants a book on Fruit Bats from the AppleTon Library
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, well, nevermind, then.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Our Friend, the Fruit Bat for Max Attire from the Appleton Library, and he gave you his library card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The Appleton Library. Here's my card.

quest_list.notes: Brock Limestone asks you to get him two meteorites.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ow!  I sat on my keys.
quest_list.success_message: Brock Limestone has asked for a nickel-iron meteorite and a carbonaceous chondrite.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd like a nickel-iron meteorite and a carbonaceous chondrite, if you can find them.

quest_list.notes: Librarian bemoans the fact that libraries are always the last to get new books.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: See that kid over there?  She just slapped me with a fish!
quest_list.success_message: Rowena Roget has told you that, to her knowledge, Flo Stemson has not yet published her book.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The author, Flo Stemson.  I knew she was writing the book, but I hadn't heard she'd finished it, or that it was published yet.  And you know how things are, libraries are always the last people to get new books...

quest_list.notes: Flo Stemson gives you a copy of her newly published book.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's him?  Ugly beast.
quest_list.success_message: Flo Stemson gave you a copy of her Newly Published Book for Max Attire in Treeton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, okay... This isn't really the kind of story one can concoct on the spur of the moment.  Here's a copy of my book for Max, with my compliments.

quest_list.notes: Give Max his book and library card.
quest_list.title: Max Attire's New Book
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're missing something.  It's either my library card, the book I wanted, or your mind.  Go get it, whatever it is.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Max Attire's New Book. You earned $5,000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah! Excellent, excellent! Look at those adorable faces! Who in their right mind wouldn't want a fruit bat!  Thank you so much!  Please accept this small payment.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Nickel-Iron meteorite on Icicle Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You dig very carefully, looking for dark spots in the bright, white snow.  You soon uncover a peach-pit sized nickel-iron meteorite, and take it with you.

quest_list.notes: Dig up the carbonaceous chondrite on Ice Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Lots of people have been prospecting here, and tossing away what they found uninteresting.  Looking amongst this, however, you find just the rock you were looking for!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Carbonaceous Chondrite!

quest_list.notes: Agree to get paint for splattering from Pablo for Basil Snoremore
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I changed my mind. I don't need paint anymore. Sorry.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to pick up some Paint from Pablo for Basil Snoremore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be great. I usually get my paint from Pablo. He lives on Art Isle.

quest_list.notes: Give Snow Isle meteorites to Brock Limestone
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait just a minute here, you were supposed to get me both a chondrite and a nickel-iron meteorite.  You don't have both here.
quest_list.success_message: Brock Limestone has asked you to look on southwest Torrid Isle for a Tektite.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are lovely!  Yes, thank you!  Now, there was a fall of tektites on Torrid Isle just recently.  On the southwest end of the island, where the sand is a bit disturbed.

quest_list.notes: Give Brock his tektite.
quest_list.title: Brock Limestone's Meteorite Hunt
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not a tektite, that's a burnt out piece of coal.  Please keep looking.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Brock Limestone's Meteorite Hunt.  You earned $10,000 and 125 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, this is beautiful!  Good job!  Now my personal collection is complete!  Here's the money I promised you!  Enjoy it!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Dig up the Tektite
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Digging carefully and sifting the sand, you find a teardrop-shaped black tektite!

quest_list.notes: Get paint for Basil
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, seems I don't have any paint left.
quest_list.success_message: Pablo gave you some Splatter Paint for Basil Snoremore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! It's just leftover paint I have sitting around. He seems pretty happy with it.

quest_list.notes: Give Basil his splatter paint
quest_list.title: Basil Snoremore's Ironic Hobby
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: ...You don't have any paint with you. It's kind of hard to splatter paint without the paint, you know.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Basil Snoremore's Ironic Hobby! You earned $3000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, the colors are splendid! They'll look great scattered around the paper together, don't you think? Take this as a token of my gratitude.
quest_list.author: OkamiFreak

quest_list.notes: Laurence sends you out for the camel tack
quest_list.success_message: Laurence sends you to Santon for Camel Tack.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: First, could you pick up his new tack from Santon's Special Gear?  Then, if Chauncey hasn't come back, could you help me look for him?

quest_list.notes: Hessa gives you the new tack
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You left before I could give you the tack.
quest_list.success_message: Hessa gave you Chauncey's Arabian Camel Tack.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, tell Laurence that I threw in the knee covers and a fancy braided headdress.  Looks just like the photo!

quest_list.notes: Laurence gets the tack
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where's the tack, did you lose it in the desert?  Go back and get it from Hessa!
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Arabian Camel Tack to Laurence.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh my, this is absolutely the most beautiful tack I have ever seen!  I'm sure Chauncey will love it...

quest_list.notes: Laurence makes some suggestions
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to look for clues to finding Chauncey.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Chauncey could be anywhere.  He likes the trees around the desert, but not the cactus plants.  He likes the berry patches and the coconut palms along the beach. Last time I saw him he was by the tree behind my hut.  Look there for clues.

quest_list.notes: Chauncey Clue #1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closely you see something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see camel hoof prints by the tree! Looks like they are heading North.

quest_list.notes: Chauncey Clue #2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closely you see something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see camel hoof prints at the edge of the berry patch.  Looks like this time Chauncey headed Northeast.

quest_list.notes: Chauncey Clue #3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closely you see something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see camel hoof prints near the tree.  Looks like Chauncey went East from here.

quest_list.notes: Chauncey Clue #4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closely you see something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see camel hoof prints by the palm tree! Now Chauncey seems to be heading Southwest.

quest_list.notes: Chauncey Clue #5
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking closely you see something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see fresh camel hoof prints by the oasis! Looks like Chauncey is still heading Southwest.

quest_list.notes: Laurence rewards your efforts
quest_list.title: Laurence's Companion
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Laurence's Companion! You earned $5000, a Diamond and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh my, yes, Chauncey looks just like T.E. Lawrence's camel now!  You have done a wonderful job finding him for me. Here, take this as a token of our appreciation.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Chauncey agrees to go home
quest_list.success_message: Chauncey agreed to go back to Laurence's hut.  It sounds like he'll meet you there.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Mmmaaaawwwwwwmm bbraammkk.

quest_list.notes: Olav checks your level
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm afraid you are not experienced enough....you can always come back when you've had more adventures.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All of my vendors are on the main islands, but I don't know where they get their materials.  You should be ready for anything.

quest_list.notes: Olav sends you on your way
quest_list.success_message: Olav gave you his List of Vendors and $5000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I was hoping so!  Here, take this list of my vendors and this for your assorted travel expensese. There's no particular order to this list.

quest_list.notes: Greig gives you the reeds
quest_list.success_message: Greig gave you 10 Bundles of Reeds for Olav.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Right, the reeds, I have them right here.  Let Olav know I can get more whenever he needs them.

quest_list.notes: Cedric sends you for logs
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Cedric 10 Logs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see, 10 logs should do it.  I'll have the shingles finished by the time you return with the logs.

quest_list.notes: Cedric gets his logs, you get your shingles.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I beg your pardon, but I need 10 logs.  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Cedric the 10 Logs and he gave you a Crate of Wooden Shingles for Olav.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Perfect timing, I just finished.  Here are the shingles and thanks for the logs!

quest_list.notes: Genevieve sends you for red clay
quest_list.success_message: Genevieve has asked you to go to Rider Isle for 6 Clumps of  Red Clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh no, I use red clay all the time, I have a delivery due next week, I just need 6 clumps of clay from the forest on Rider Isle to tide me over.  Dig for it around the rocks.

quest_list.notes: You find red clay
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over and turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you notice some clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clump of Red Clay!

quest_list.notes: You find red clay
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over and turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you notice some clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clump of Red Clay!

quest_list.notes: You find red clay
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over and turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you notice some clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clump of Red Clay!

quest_list.notes: You find red clay
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over and turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you notice some clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clump of Red Clay!

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over and turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you notice some clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clump of Red Clay!

quest_list.notes: You find red clay
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over and turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging carefully, you notice some clay.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clump of Red Clay!

quest_list.notes: Genevieve gets her clay, you get Olav's tiles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't bring me enough red clay, come back when you have all 6 lumps.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Genevieve the 6 Clumps of Red Clay and she gave you Olav's Terra Cotta Tiles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do fine, thank you ever so much!  And here are Olav's terra cotta tiles.

quest_list.notes: Murray sends you to Ashton
quest_list.success_message: Murray sent you to Ashton for the Tar Paper.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I get my tar paper from Patrick's Supplies in Ashton.  He always has 20 rolls waiting for my order.  Tell him you want half and to put it on my tab.

quest_list.notes: Patrick gives you the Tar Paper
quest_list.success_message: Patrick gave you 10 Rolls of Tar Paper.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is a little unorthodox, but I suppose it would work. Here are 10 rolls of tar paper and I'll add them to Murray's bill.

quest_list.notes: Olav gets his Reeds
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aren't you forgetting something?  You don't have the reeds, go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olav the 10 Bundles of Reeds from Greig.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, Greig always sends me the finest reeds, they're perfect for the thatched roofs around the islands.

quest_list.notes: Olav gets his Shingles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had the shingles from Cedric...well..what are you waiting for?  Go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olav the Crate of Wooden Shingles from Cedric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Opening the crate.) Wonderful, Cedric always does such fine work! (Holds a shingle up for your inspection.) See? Perfection!

quest_list.notes: Olav gets his Terra Cotta Tiles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Didn't Genevieve give you my roofing tiles?  Go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olav the Crate of Terra Cotta Tiles from Genevieve.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Genevieve, (Looking at one of the tiles.) you are so in tune with the clay....magnificent!

quest_list.notes: Olav gets his Tar Paper
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are you and Murray playing games with me?  Go back and get my Tar Paper!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olav the 10 Rolls of Tar Paper from Ashton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I know that I can always count on Murray to have what I need! (You roll your eyes after hearing that!)

quest_list.notes: Olav gets his list back and rewards you
quest_list.title: Olav's Supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't given me everything that was on my list.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olav's Supplies!  You earned $5000, a Meerkat and 175 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Uff da! You brought back everything on my list and so quickly! Here, take this Meerkat and a little money as a token of my appreciation.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Belinda Buckle wants an amethyst necklace.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Uhm.... I forgot.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to bring Belinda Buckle a Silver Amethyst Necklace.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Laughing heartily.) Ahh, I see you've been around Horse Isle for a while, haven't you? Yeah, I'll pay you handsomely for a silver amethyst necklace.

quest_list.notes: Give Belinda the necklace
quest_list.title: Belinda Buckle's Fashion Accessory
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not what I asked for. (Taps foot in irritation.)
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Belinda Buckle's Fashion Accessory.  You earned $6,000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ooo!  Perfect!  Perfect, perfect, perfect!  Thanks tons!  Here, have a reward!  Thanks again!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Cadence wants a mole trap.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to ask the smith for a mole trap for Cadence.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Head over to the smithy and ask if he's got one.

quest_list.notes: Smith finds the idea of a mole trap oppressive.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What in tarnation....
quest_list.success_message: Liam Flux, the Wington Smith, does not have any mole traps.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, no mole traps.  Don't hold with traps.  Moles and varmints all lived here first, I say.  Tell her I said she don't like the neighborhood she oughta move!

quest_list.notes: Cadence wants you to ask at the food store for a barrel.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Cadence an empty barrel from the food store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I guess that's a thought.  Tell you what, why don't you go over to the food store and ask if they have any empty barrels?  I'll try one if they do.

quest_list.notes: No barrels at the food store.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What?
quest_list.success_message: Cara Cook hasn't any barrels for sale.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a clue in the tree!

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found large hoof prints in the snow, let Kelda know!

quest_list.notes: Kelda sends you to find the creature.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find the creature for Kelda.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, find out what I can do to help it, of course!

quest_list.notes: John O'Lantern gives a pumpkin for free once.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I have already given you your gift.
quest_list.success_message: John O'Lantern gave you a Pumpkin companion!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go!  I think horses like pumpkin, so it may not last long, but it's still helpful!

quest_list.notes: Give seashells to No-Navel Nancy
quest_list.title: No-Navel Nancy's Earrings
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arr, can ye not count?! I said four seashells!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed No-Navel Nancy's Earrings quest! You earned $1500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arrr, me shells! These be grand shells! Thank ye, matey!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: No-Navel Nancy sends you for 4 seashells
quest_list.success_message: No-Navel Nancy asked you to bring her four Seashells.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Needs to make me some earrings, matey! Ain't got no navel for a ring, and mum said no anyhow- arr, not that that matters. (She flushes.) Arr, just four seashells fer me ears, yeah?

quest_list.notes: Dr Starsdottir wants hot chocolate, and lots of it.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, well, if you can't be bothered, then.  Shut the door.
quest_list.success_message: Dr. Stardottir has asked you to get her five Mugs of Hot Cocoa.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, there's something you can do, now I think of it.  It's going to be a long, cold night.  Get me some mugs of hot cocoa.  Five ought to do.

quest_list.notes: Give Dr Starsdottir her hot chocolate.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Five!  I asked for five, can't you count?  Get out of here and get five, and shut the door.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dr. Starsdottir five Mugs of Hot Cocoa, but it's cold cocoa now.  She wants a Log and five Strong, Skinny Branches to heat it up with.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It's cold.  Run out to the forest and get me a log and, say, five skinny branches so I can heat it up again.

quest_list.notes: Give Dr Starsdottir her firewood
quest_list.title: The Touchy Astronomer
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Yup.  You can't count, all right. I need one log and five skinny branches.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Touchy Astronomer.  You earned $7,000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah.  These will do.  Thank you.  Here's your pay.  Now get out of here and shut the door, tightly!  I need to work.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Gytha asked you to ask Esmerelda if Mrow is in her garden.
quest_list.success_message: Gytha has asked you to go next door to Esmerelda and ask if her cat, Mrow, is in the garden.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, and aren't you nice. Matter of fact, Mrow- that's my kitten- has gone off again. Would you go next door to Esmerelda's and ask her if he's been seen around her garden?

quest_list.notes: You are aware of the existence of King Phil. Tracking/timestalkedto var.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Talked to Esmerelda about Mrow.
quest_list.success_message: Esmerelda says that she just shooed Mrow out of her garden, where he was eating her flowers. Again. She says he should be home to Gytha soon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That cat! If it weren't that he's Gytha's... He was eating my tulips. Again. And my roses. I chased him out! I expect he's slinking home to Gytha now.

quest_list.notes: Mrow appears.
quest_list.title: Gytha's Missing Cat
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Gytha's Missing Cat! You earned $1000 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There he is! Who's a good little man gone walkabout again, who's mummy's little boy, yes you are yes you are yes you are... Oh, and thank you for finding him!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Gytha gives you a cup of tea
quest_list.success_message: You drank a mug of Earl Grey Tea.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She passes you a delicate china cup.) Biscuit?

quest_list.notes: Gytha gives you a biscuit
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, my, I must be out.  Sorry about that.
quest_list.success_message: You ate a Biscuit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There now.

quest_list.notes: Sir Az gives you his application and sends you to King Phil to petition his case.
quest_list.success_message: Sir Az has given you his application to take to the King.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
What a kind soul the young wanderer has! My poem I've given you with much pizzazz
To take to the King, and await a response to bring back to me!

quest_list.notes: King Phil sends you back with a reply.
quest_list.success_message: King Phil has entrusted you with a reply. From the sounds of it, it's not one that Sir Az is going to like.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (King Phil reads over the poem that Sir Az bade you deliver, and turns white, then bright red!) Oy gevault! The man's in the wrong profession. It must hurt to be so crazy! Feh! (He scribbles something on a sheet of paper and hands it back.)

quest_list.notes: You delivered King Phil's response.
quest_list.title: Sir Az's Poetry Application
quest_list.success_message: You gave Sir Az the response from King Phil- and against all odds, he actually seemed happy about it! You Completed Sir Az's Poetry Application! You earned $10,000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
(He unfolds the paper eagerly, then reads King Phil's message. His brow furrows. You brace yourself for the thunderstorm... but he smiles!) Oh frabjous day, calloo! Callay! The King himself appreciaaaaa-
-Tes my work!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: You are aware of the existence of Sir Az. Tracking for hinting npcs to stop hinting.
Track Humpty Dumpty (he learns Patience doesn't know him)
Beebonnet Buck sent you off for four bales of straw and ten sticks.
quest_list.success_message: Beebonnet Buck needs four Bales of Straw from Levi Shoogerkube and ten Strong, Skinny Branches to complete his thatching project.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, well, if ye be helpin'... Go get me four bales'a straw from Levi down in Wington. He does wheat straw for thatchin'. An' ten sticks, I need 'em, too.

quest_list.notes: Beebonnet Buck asked you to go find his knitting needles.
quest_list.success_message: Beebonnet Buck has asked you (sort of) to look in the trees up north for a bird who may or may not have stolen his knitting needles.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: They be my knittin' needles, and they be gone! Arrr, that bird! You git out an' look in the trees up north here and you find that bird and make 'im give 'em back!

quest_list.notes: Find birds' nest in giant palm tree, Beebonnet Buck's Missing Needles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around,  but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking far up into the giant palm, you see a small birds' nest filled with cheeping baby birds! They're all looking southeast down the shoreline.

quest_list.notes: Magda tells you where to find the knitting needles.
quest_list.success_message: Magda isn't telling where she hid the knitting needles- but then again, being a bird, she can hardly talk!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Magda makes a harsh, pleased sound in her throat- like bones rattling together.)

quest_list.notes: Find knitting needles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Peering closely into the bones, you see a pair of long, thin, green, shiny objects. Not wanting to touch the bones, you wrap your hand in a cloth to pull them out.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Beebonnet Buck's knitting needles!

quest_list.notes: Return knitting needles.
quest_list.title: Beebonnet Buck's Lost Needles
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Beebonnet Buck's Lost Needles! You earned 2 Ruby Necklaces and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arr, it be a cloth, you be foolin'! What, inside? (He unwraps the cloth as you explain where you found the needles.) Eh, don't worry, those bones be plaster casts, they be for decoration. Arrr... That bird! Here, take these afore she steals 'em.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Levi Sugarcube sells you 4 bales of straw.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Uh, you don't have the right amount of money here. It's $100 per bale, so it will be $400 total. Come on back when you've got it.
quest_list.success_message: You bought four Bales of Straw for $400 for Beebonnet Buck's roof!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! Four bales of straw.

quest_list.notes: You delivered the thatching materials.
quest_list.title: Beebonnet Buck's Roof Repair
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arr, ye ain't listenin'! I need ten strong branches for my thatchin'! Bring 'em back!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Beebonnet Buck's Roof Repair! You earned 3 Emerald Necklaces and 75 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Tongue poking out of the side of his mouth, he counts the bales of straw and sticks.) Arrr, perfect! I can fix me roof like lightnin' with these. Here, take these necklaces; Magda tried to steal 'em, but I beat her off.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Gillian tells you to go find Rivvie the dog.
quest_list.success_message: Gillian has asked you to find her dog Rivvie and retrieve the missing first-aid kit.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be helpful, thanks. Check the shoreline south of here- she's always running around between the palm trees.

quest_list.notes: Rivvie has buried the first aid kit by a really big stick.
quest_list.success_message: Rivvie has buried the first aid kit near a stick of some sort.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking extremely proud of herself, Rivvie holds up the stick in her mouth and gestures down the shoreline.)

quest_list.notes: Dig up the first aid kit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging in between the large pieces of driftwood on the beach, you uncover a red cloth pouch with a recognizable white cross.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This must be the first aid kit Gillian is missing!

quest_list.notes: Gave the first aid kit back to Gillian
quest_list.title: Gillian's Lost First Aid Kit
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Gillian's Lost First Aid Kit! You earned $3,000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, you found it! Great! Thanks so much!

quest_list.success_message: You Completed Kelda's Visitor quest.  You earned a Penguin and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My this is an unusual picture of a moose, I hope he let's me know next time he stops by.  Oh and here, please accept this little guy as a token of my appreciation.

quest_list.notes: Enzo gets his photo
quest_list.title: Enzo's Surprise
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Liar, liar, pants on fire!  You said you had a present for me!  Where's my present?  Go get my present!!!!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Enzo's Surprise.  You earned 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (You give Enzo the photo and watch his eyes open wide in astonishment.) Wow! You really met Chiropticon! And he signed it too! Wait 'til I show Gina, I told her he was real! Thanks a bunch!!!

quest_list.success_message: You told Ruthie that you would go check on Old John.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be very kind. John is a big, dark bay gelding with a Roman nose- and not a white marking on him. He's starting to roan out a bit around the eyes in his old age, though. Will you please let me know how he seems?
