Ruthie sends you out for 5 apples and to go to Ollie Scooper for a toy for John
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie asked you to bring back five Apples and a Big Rubber Ball from Ollie Scooper.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, the poor, big man. Kate, the lead mare, is very protective and probably won't let the others talk to him. Well, maybe we can help John get situated. Please go to Ollie Scooper and bring back a big rubber ball. Oh, and five apples.

quest_list.notes: You brought Ruthie the apples.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (She peers at you very closely.) I don't see any apples here. My horses don't eat invisible apples, although I'm sure Kate would try! Please come back when you have five apples.
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie asked you to give each of the horses an Apple in order of herd dominance.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are the biggest apples I've ever seen! Please take one to all of the horses. And listen, don't start herd drama. Go in order of herd dominance. Kate first, all right? Then Dude, then Decaf, then Ellie. John last, all right?

quest_list.notes: Ollie will sell you a red rubber ball.
quest_list.success_message: Ollie Scooper will sell you a Big Rubber Ball for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, sure. I've got some in the back. I have some customers with big dogs who like to play with big rubber balls. I make 'em tough so they can't pop 'em when they bite down. They cost $500.

quest_list.notes: You gave Old John the Red Rubber Ball.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (He snorts and shakes his head.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Red Rubber Ball to Old John.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Old John stares at you for a moment, then lowers his head to nose at the ball. Suddenly he swings his nose back and butts the ball straight at you!)

quest_list.notes: You bought a red rubber ball.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, I'd be happy to sell it to you, but it costs $500. You don't have enough here.
quest_list.success_message: You bought an enormous Red Rubber Ball from Ollie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! One red rubber ball. You sure you can carry this thing? Haha, only kidding, you'll be fine.

quest_list.notes: Jack O' tells you he needs help.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, as it happens, so I do... I've had so many pumpkins this year and so many orders that I haven't had time to deliver them all. Could you do that for me?

quest_list.notes: Lilibeth sends you out
quest_list.success_message: Lilbeth gave you a Crate of  Wreaths for Betsy Burlap and a Crate of Flower Arrangements for Iris Pettel, as well as $2500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, I believe in barter. Betsy gets the wreaths and she'll give you my ribbons. Iris gets the flower arrangements and will give you my floral tape and wire.  And here's some traveling money.

quest_list.notes: You gave Old Kate an apple.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (She snorts, shaking her head. You must not have an apple for her.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave an Apple to Old Kate.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Kate noses at the apple, her nostrils flared as though in distaste- but she eats it anyway, taking dainty, mincing bites.)

quest_list.notes: You gave Old Dude an apple.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (He snorts, shaking his head. You must not have an apple for him.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave Old Dude an Apple.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Without prelude, Dude gobbles up the apple whole!)

quest_list.notes: You gave Old Decaf an apple.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (He snorts, shaking his head. You must not have an apple for him.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave an Apple to Old Decaf.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (The gelding looks at you, then at the apple in your hand. You get the sense that he would shrug if he could, but he eats the apple anyway.)

quest_list.notes: You gave Old Ellie an apple.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (She snorts, shaking her head. You must not have an apple for her.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave an Apple to Old Ellie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Old Ellie looks at you as though raising an eyebrow, but takes small, polite bites out of the apple.)

quest_list.notes: You gave Old John an apple.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (He snorts, shaking his head. You must not have an apple for him.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave an Apple to Old John.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (John doesn't give you the chance to even take the apple out of your pocket- he pushes his nose into your pocket and takes it out himself!)

quest_list.notes: The horses all start playing with the ball.
quest_list.success_message: Looks like John isn't so lonely anymore! Better go tell Ruthie he has made a friend- or four!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: ( Before you can kick the ball back, it's intercepted by Old Kate! She's come to investigate the hullaballoo. She noses the ball across the way to Old Decaf, who kicks it back to Old John, who kicks it to Old Ellie, who kicks it to Old Dude!)

quest_list.notes: Ruthie rewards you.
quest_list.title: Ruthie's New Retiree
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ruthie's New Retiree quest! You earned $7,500 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: They did? All of them? Well, I never! (She laughs.) I wish I'd seen Kate give up her dignity and kick a ball around! Well, I'm glad John's settled in. Hard on a horse to not have any friends. Thanks for helping me take care of them!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Betsy gets her delivery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Where are my wreaths?  Go back and get them!!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Betsy her Wreaths and Betsy gave you a Bag of Ribbons for Lilibeth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, leave the crate on the counter, and here bring Lilibeth this bag of ribbons.  I'm sure she'll like the selection.

quest_list.notes: Iris gets her delivery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you had my flowers, go back and get them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Iris her Flower Arrangements and she gave you a Box of Floral Supplies for Lilibeth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Put the flowers by the flower pots, okay?  And here, bring this box back to Lilibeth, it's the wire and tape she asked for.

quest_list.notes: Lilibeth gets her supplies
quest_list.title: Lilibeth's Deliveries
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said you had all my supplies, go get the Ribbons AND the floral supplies!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Lilibeth's Deliveries.  You earned $2000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why thank you, you've done a wonderful job!  Here, please take this as a token of my appreciation.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Alton sends you to Holli
quest_list.success_message: Alton gave you two Crates of Edible Centerpieces for Holli in Tropicton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You'd do that for me?  Thanks!  Here take these two crates to Holli.  She won't give you cash, she'll give you two crates of melons for me instead.

quest_list.notes: Holli gets her centerpieces
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Alton said he'd send two crates, go back and get both of them!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Holli Daysin two Crates of Edible Centerpieces and she gave you two Crates of Melons for Alton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just put them in the Dining Room and take the 2 crates of melons that are by the door.  Thank Alton for the beautiful work as usual!

quest_list.notes: Alton gets his fruit and thanks you.
quest_list.title: Alton's Centerpieces
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Holli was supposed to give you 2 Crates of Melons, go back and bring both of them back!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Alton's Centerpieces!  You earned $2500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for taking care of the delivery for me, put the melons by the table and here's something for your trouble.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's great!  Here take this box to George, it has all the animals and cages his kids could possibly want. Just come back and let me know how George liked it.

quest_list.notes: George gets his zoo.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Is this some kind of prank?  Go find that zoo and bring it back to me!
quest_list.success_message: You gave George the Toy Zoo and he gave you five Logs to bring back to Woody.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Rooting through the box.) This is wonderful, look at how realistic these animals look! My kids will adore this! By the way, here are five logs, could you bring them back to Woody for me? I want to replace some of the wood he used on this.

quest_list.notes: Woody gets his logs and rewards you.
quest_list.title: Woody's Zoo
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had 5 logs from George...bring me all 5 logs!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Woody's Zoo.  You earned $3500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That was real nice of George to replace the wood.  Well, did he see the zoo?  Did he like it? Oh, I almost forgot, this is for you.  Thanks for helping me out.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Could you? That's great! Take this case to Percy and he'll give you paraffin and bee's wax in return. Okay? And here's some traveling money.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you so much for suggesting this! Here's some money to help with the costs, and the sail construction specifications.

quest_list.notes: Get indigo dye from Sasha in Treeton

quest_list.success_message: You have been given a jar of powdered indigo dye. Trudy needs it for the cloth.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Be careful not to get any on you. It'll stain your clothes.

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money.  I need $1500.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Barb takes the specifications note and reads it.) Marina also wants it dyed indigo. You'll need to take the material to someone else to have that done. Then bring it back so I can get started on it.

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the $500.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Trudy the Bolt of Cotton Cloth. Now you need to get the dye.

quest_list.notes: Give indigo dye to Trudy in Hotton
quest_list.success_message: You gave Trudy the Indigo Dye. Plenty of time to look for wilds!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks. This is just what I need! Give me some time to get it dyed.

quest_list.notes: Get indigo dyed cotton canvas
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.

quest_list.notes: Give indigo dyed bolt of cotton canvas to Barb in Shellton

quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a gorgeous color! Trudy did an amazing job for so much fabric. Give me some time to get this sewn.

quest_list.notes: Get finished headsail
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.

quest_list.title: Marina's Missing Headsail

quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm stunned! This is far more beautiful than I could have imagined. And the whorl design is perfect! Thank you so much. Please, take this as a show of my deep appreciation.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.notes: You find clue #8
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found another clue!

quest_list.notes: You find the culprit!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You see an elderly man. There are apple peelings all around him, along with what looks like.... shrunken heads? Best go tell Allaire what you've discovered.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've found the remains of the missing apples!

quest_list.notes: You agree to go talk to the elderly gentleman
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to go talk to the elderly gentleman.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for being willing to check up on him.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Andrea
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find out what's making all that ruckus and get it to quiet down.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I would sure be grateful!

quest_list.notes: Find the frog
quest_list.success_message: This must be why Andrea was complaining about noise. If you can get the frog to hush up, you'll solve Andrea's problem.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup! Oh, woe is me! All for naught, I say. All for naught. Croak! Ka-blurp! Ribbit! Greedeep! Bruddup!

quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find Murigal's ten lost gems. Might as well let Andrea know. Then you best start checking all the ponds!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh yes, indeed and please do! My lips are zipped. Sealed. Swallowing the key! No more noise from me. But please, bring back my gems as quickly as you can. Oh, in case you were wondering, there's ten missing.

quest_list.notes: Give Zerena/Hoof the material

quest_list.notes: Give Farley/Molten Meadows the suit.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't put on a suit without putting on a shirt first! Gesh!

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm. Farley is the dummy, right? And on Ricky, I hadn't planned on giving toothbrushes to businesses, but there is no reason not to! In the meantime you've done a great job so far. Ready to deliver this next set?

quest_list.notes: Kittens love pumpkins.
quest_list.success_message: Immediately, the kittens leap away and scramble into, out of, between, and over the pumpkins! Batkhuyag immediately flops down and falls asleep, but Lianhua looks like she has something to say.

quest_list.notes: Lianhua rewards you
quest_list.title: The Pallas Cat Pumpkin Playground
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Pallas Cat Pumpkin Playground! You earned a Ruby Necklace and 35 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (With an air of great relief, Lianhua drops a ruby necklace at your feet! She rubs against your leg briefly, purring. Then she mimics Batkhuyag and falls asleep.)
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Vole Hole #7
quest_list.title: Vole Hole #7
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You have already completed this vole hole.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Vole Hole #7!  You earned $3000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You got the vole to its food!

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Ed Klippit
quest_list.success_message: Apparently you agreed to pick up Ed Klippit's cleaning supplies at the local general store.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What?  Help?  Well, if you really must have something to keep you busy, I need more cleaning materials.  Head over to the general store to get my order.

quest_list.notes: Get cleaning supplies from Ethel
quest_list.success_message: Ethel Barryjam gave you the Cleaning Supplies.

quest_list.notes: Give Ed Klippit the cleaning supplies
quest_list.title: Ed Klippit's Cleaning Supplies
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have it.  Come back later.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ed Klippit's Cleaning Supplies.  You earned $2500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you finally are.  Here.  Take this.  Figured I should pay you something.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Agree to find Fergus' 2 gold chests
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to dig up Fergus O'Toole's two Gold Chests.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I never left Flower Isle.  I can tell ya that much.  There are two buried.  I remember they were buried next ta plants that were twins.

quest_list.notes: Find a gold chest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging deep, you hit something solid.  You clear away the dirt carefully.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Gold Chest!

quest_list.notes: Find a gold chest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Digging deep, you hit something solid.  You clear away the dirt carefully.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Gold Chest!

quest_list.notes: Give Fergus his two Gold Chests
quest_list.title: Fergus O'Toole's Lost Chests
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ya don't have two.  I said there was two missin'!
quest_list.success_message:
You Completed Fergus O'Toole's Lost Chests. You earned 25 Wishing Coins, 25 Chunks of Gold Ore and 75 quest points.
**POOF**You are in the middle of Wington!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah ha! Me chests! (He carefully opens one of them then closes it again before you get a chance to see what's inside.) Here. Take this fer yer troubles. Now leave me be.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Fergus' New pot quest completed.  Tracking to get rid of Ferrel Ironman replies
You annoy Grendel
quest_list.success_message: Looks like you've made a mess of things!

quest_list.notes: Get bone from Rocco
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have sufficient funds to purchase that.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a Dinosaur Bone from Rocco Shale for $2100! Time to head back to Whorl.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go! One dinosaur bone.

quest_list.notes: Grendel sends you to the dock
quest_list.success_message: You've been whooshed to the dock! What a great shortcut!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (With a huge swipe of his hairy paw, Grendel flings you through the air.)

quest_list.notes: Agree to find a bone for Grendel
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find a bone for Grendel. Time to find a really BIG bone!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I doubt you'll find anything big enough to satisfy my hunger, but I remain foolishly hopeful.

quest_list.notes: Give Grendel dinosaur bone.
quest_list.title: Grendel's Big Appetite
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have anything that can satisfy my appetite. Beat it, now.
quest_list.success_message: You completed Grendel's Big Appetite. You earned 18 Red Pine Cones and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are kind. This should bring me a bit of solace. In gratitude, let me give you these red pinecones. Now, please. Be gone!
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Carmina tells you about the fox problem
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to go off in search of the local fox and attempt to convince him to leave the hounds alone for the day.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I appreciate that. You understand, I'd have no objection to the fox having some fun- if that's what it is- if it weren't that my young entry on furry Shetlands are not prepared to go full-tilt!

quest_list.notes: You ride out to catch the scent.
You find fox tracks #1 at the veggie patch.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Tiny fox prints dot the edges of the vegetable patch.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You look very closely and notice small drips of honey.

quest_list.notes: You find fox tracks #2 at the honey tree.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looking closely, you spot more pawprints. A lot more- it looks like this is a favorite spot for the fox.  You also spot scattered berries on the ground under the tree- they're squished, but you can identify two varieties.

quest_list.notes: Find more tracks at the raspberry/thimbleberry pile.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, find nothing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It looks like you've found another foxy favorite spot as there are plenty of fox prints all around. A smattering of silvery, gold, and coppery dust is faintly visible on the grass.

quest_list.notes: Find Renard Jr. on the rocks
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Grins at you, tongue lolling out of his mouth.)
quest_list.success_message: Looks like your fox hunt has ended in success!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Grins at you, tongue lolling out of his mouth.)

quest_list.notes: Ruthie tells you about Old John and the baseball cap.
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie gave you $60 for the purchase of a new White Baseball Cap for her retiree Old John.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be very kind of you! I think a white baseball cap would be best. That way if it gets filthy I can bleach it. Here is a little something to cover the cost.

quest_list.notes: OPTION- Stop quest here. Do not help R.J. Back to Carmina.
quest_list.success_message: You did not agree to help Renard Jr. win his bet with Orly. Instead, you decided to tell Carmina what he was up to.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All right, you just do that. I'll be right here, preparing myself. A fox needs his strength, you know.

quest_list.notes: OR OPTION- Help R.J. Put him in your pack. Do not do this at home.
quest_list.success_message: You elected to help Renard Junior win his bet while at the same time keeping the hunt safe for the kids. You'll have to go up to Carmina to tell her you have a good plan.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: But once we do that, we'll need to go down to Orly. He lives down by the old scraggly tree down around the fuzzy stuff.

quest_list.notes: Offer cap to Ruthie. I want to check that they bought the cap, so taking AND giving in same cp, but they must buy the cap 1st or this action makes no sense.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: This isn't a white baseball cap, though.
quest_list.success_message: Ruthie asked you to give the White Baseball Cap to Old John.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, he'll love this! Please go out and give it to him, won't you? This leg of mine is really playing up.

quest_list.notes: IF YOU CONTINUED- Tell Carmina you found him. Continue on.
quest_list.success_message: You told Carmina that you're working out her fox problem. Now you'll have to take the problem fox in question and go find his friend Orly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looks a little baffled, although you can't tell if it's because of you, or because of her hounds' strange behavior.) Well, all right. Now if you'll excuse me... I don't know what has gotten into them!

quest_list.notes: Find Orly the Owl
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around, but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You look up in the scraggly tree, searching the branches and see a bird.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Looks like you've found Renard Junior's owl friend.

quest_list.notes: Leave Renard Jr. with Owl Friend to watch fireworks. Get mini-reward from Renard.
quest_list.success_message: You set Renard Junior down at the base of the tree. He gave you 2 Diamonds in return for your help. Now that you've helped him out, it's time to go back to Carmina to explain.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, yowhooooo better put him down then. We'll see if your trick confwhooooooooses the hounds- althooooooough I don't like that you had help, that wasn't part of the deal! (Flutters and fusses and nearly falls over.) Junior, whoooat are you doing?

quest_list.notes: Hunt Quest Endgame
quest_list.title: The Earton Hunt's Fox Problem
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Earton Hunt's Fox Problem quest! You earned $40,000 and 275 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, all's well that ends well, and my kids and my hounds will have a safe go. Thank you for your help today!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: You made a decision about R.J., and you cannot change your mind now. (tracking only)
Give the cap to Old John.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Old John looks at your empty hands quizzically.)
quest_list.success_message: You gave Old John the White Baseball Cap! Better tell Ruthie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Old John snatches the cap out of your hands and goes trotting off, looking very young for such an old fellow!)

quest_list.notes: Endgame.
quest_list.title: Ruthie and the Birthday Cap
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Ruthie and the Birthday Cap quest! You earned $3500 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thanks for all of your help! That ought to keep him out of my hair- or out of my hat, rather!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Lelu sends player back to Tail Isle
quest_list.success_message: *POOF*  You were sent back to Tail Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go. I hope you find that adventure you are seeking.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Lelu
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to look for Lelu's lost locket. Best giddy-up and go!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be wonderful! A woman named Hessa organized a camel trail ride. I remember we rode all around Santon.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Hessa (tracking only)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I remember that lady! Bless her heart! She and her husband spent hours looking for her necklace. If that darned packrat hadn't run out and scared the camel, I doubt she would have lost it.

quest_list.notes: Magnify before raking, southern rat midden.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: No sense using the magnifying glass. There is too much cactus and sticks in the way to see much of anything. Maybe you need to remove some of the debris first.

quest_list.notes: Dig before raking, packrat nest south of Santon
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: The midden is piled high with bits and pieces of sticks and cholla. The shovel can't break through the mess. Maybe you can rake away some of the stuff.

quest_list.notes: Rake 1st time, southern packrat's nest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully use the rake to pull back some of the sticks and cholla. Something glitters in the pile.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Diamond! Maybe if you rake again, you will find Lelu's locket.

quest_list.notes: Rake again, southern packrat's nest- find locket
quest_list.success_message: You carefully rake more of the debris away. Wowzers!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see an antique gold locket. This must be Lelu's!

quest_list.notes: Give Lelu her locket.
quest_list.title: Lelu's Lost Locket
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Lelu's Lost Locket. You earned $3000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My mother's locket! Thank you so much! Here, take this as a small reward.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Dig before raking, packrat nest north of Santon
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You try to dig through the tangle of cholla, branches and other debris but it is too difficult. Looks like you need to try raking first.

quest_list.notes: Agree to ask Karee Farley/toothbrush tracking
Magnify before raking, northern rat midden.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: No sense using the magnifying glass. There is too much cactus and sticks in the way to see much of anything. Maybe you need to remove some of the debris first.

quest_list.notes: Rake 1st time, northern packrat's nest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over, but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully use the rake to pull back some of the sticks and cholla. Something glitters in the pile.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Diamond! Maybe you should rake again.

quest_list.notes: Rake again, northern packrat's nest - find pocketwatch
quest_list.success_message: You carefully rake more of the debris away. Wowzers!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You see an antique gold pocket watch.  Maybe you should examine it more closely.

quest_list.notes: Give Ed his grandfather's pocket watch.
quest_list.title: A Pocket Watch For Ed
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed A Pocket Watch For Ed. You earned $2000 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You have made my day! Thank you so much. Here, a small reward for reminding me of a great man.
quest_list.author: Desertmorn

quest_list.notes: Renard tells you about his kits.
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to find Renard's four children, and report back with news of how they're doing.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: One left the home for fun, was the mane motivation. One went to seek what she felt she was dew. One stowed away, because he wouldn't shell out for the boat ride. And one... well, she just got lost. They have tended to live in rather rocky circumstances.

quest_list.notes: You found Tricksy (Dew fox)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aha, so my father sent you, did he?
quest_list.success_message: You found Tricksy, one of Renard's children!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aha, so my father sent you, did he?

quest_list.notes: Tricksy tells you about the gift
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to take a Nectar Sample from the iris just northwest of Tricksy as a present for Renard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The nectar from the great huge irises here (indicates the flower next to her) is supposed to boost the brain! Please take this vial and get a nectar sample from the iris just northwest of me. It's easiest to get to on the side by the sign.

quest_list.notes: Collect nectar sample
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You collected a Nectar Sample from the iris to give to Renard from his daughter Tricksy!

quest_list.notes: Found Wily (Lost fox)
quest_list.success_message: You found Wily, one of Renard's children!

quest_list.notes: Wily sends you for gift
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to collect a Honeycomb from under the wagon station to give to Renard.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He said that a bitter attitude makes for a bitter ending. I've buried a honeycomb under the wagon. Won't you bring it to my father?"

quest_list.notes: Procure honeycomb
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dug up a particularly large Honeycomb from under the wagon station!

quest_list.notes: Found Renard Jr.
quest_list.success_message: You found Renard's son, Renard Junior!

quest_list.notes: Renard Jr.'s present
quest_list.success_message: Renard Jr. asked you to give his father a big toothy grin as a present. He demonstrated to show you just how.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll confess, I'm flat broke. Too much adventuring, too little honest work. But Dad always said it didn't matter what you do in life so long as you're happy. So will you please give him a big, big grin from me as a present? (Bares all his teeth.)

quest_list.notes: Find Witsy (Shell fox)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Dear old dad! I keep meaning to go back and visit the old dog, but frankly, I don't have the money to catch a boat there, and the dock patrols are... well, I haven't gotten down. How's he doing?
quest_list.success_message: You found Witsy, one of Renard's children!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Dear old dad! I keep meaning to go back and visit the old dog, but frankly, I don't have the money to catch a boat there, and the dock patrols are... well, I haven't gotten down. How's he doing?

quest_list.notes: Witsy's gift
quest_list.success_message: Witsy asked you to take a sample of the water from the Shell Forest Wishing Well as a present to his father.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now, what to give... ah! Dad said that success was part hard work and part luck. Hard work's too hard for me, so I've lived by luck! Will you please take him a sample of the water from the well here? It sure is lucky.

quest_list.notes: Procure well sample
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You took a sample from the water in the Wishing Well to give to Renard as a gift from his son Witsy.

quest_list.notes: Renard checks for gifts, part 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Ah, but you have forgotten to visit at least one of my children! I do have four, you know.

quest_list.notes: Get reward from Renard for finding children
quest_list.title: Renard's Wayward Children
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Renard's Wayward Children quest! You earned $50,000, 10 Wishing Coins for luck, and 250 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Smarts, luck, a positive attitude, and happiness. That is all I could have wished for my children. I miss them at home, but I am glad they are doing so well. Merci beaucoup for your travels!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Agree to look for Zamora's family jewel (fix for an old quest)
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to look for Zamora's family jewel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I doubt if you can find it, but if there's a chance... Well. I would certainly appreciate it!

quest_list.notes: Holli checks your levels and sends you to Martina
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry but I think you are going to have to be a lot more adventurous this time.  Come back when you can travel to ALL of our beautiful islands.
quest_list.success_message: Holli sends you to see Martina on Whorl Isle with $2000 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is just perfect!  Now off you go to Whorl Isle to see Martina, she's my wedding planner.  Here's some traveling money, now get a move on, she's expecting you!

quest_list.notes: Martina send you to Web Isle
quest_list.success_message: Martina gave you two Order Forms.  One each for Lilibeth and Shoneah of Web Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now, start on Web Isle.  You need to see Lilibeth and Shoneah there. Here give them these orders and come back when you're finished.

quest_list.notes: You give Lilibeth the order form
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What about the order form, where is it?  Go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Lilibeth the Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the order.) Let's see, it's unique all right. Can you wait a bit while I figure out the bill?

quest_list.notes: Lilibeth gives you her invoice and sample.
quest_list.success_message: Lilibeth gave you an Invoice  and a beautiful Table Centerpiece to bring back to Martina.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: All done. Now bring these back to Martina.  Tell her I'll need 4 weeks advance notice, but they'll make it the wedding of the decade!

quest_list.notes: You give Shoneah  Martina's order form
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said you have an order form from Martina, where is it?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Shoneah the Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looks over the order form.) I'm honored that Martina thought of me for this monumental occasion.

quest_list.notes: Shoneah givres you his invoice and samples.
quest_list.success_message: Shoneah gave you his Invoice for Martina along with a sample pendant and belt buckle in a Velvet Pouch.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No thank you, I'm good.  Please bring these back to Martina.  Tell her that I will need 2 months to fill this order.

quest_list.notes: Aili mentions the strange prints in the sand
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to search carefully along the sand between the two lava-surfaced halves of Basalt Isle for the large tracks Aili mentioned.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent. I appreciate your help. As I said, it was between the two halves of the isle, on the beach sand. Tell me all about what you see. Maybe while you're looking closely for the prints, you'll see other things too.

quest_list.notes: Phoenix prints
quest_list.success_message: You hardly need your magnifying glass to see the enormous prints left in the sand. You observe carefully: three talons facing forward, and one behind. The prints are very deep. Could there be more?

quest_list.notes: Halcyon prints
quest_list.success_message: You don't need your magnifying glass to see these enormous prints. Three long toes stretch forward, well spread. The heel is long and narrow.

quest_list.notes: Phoenix feather
quest_list.success_message: Half-buried in the sand, you discover an enormous red feather. It's iridescent and its color seems to fade into oranges and yellows as you turn it to and fro. The tip looks a little burnt. How odd!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Long Red Feather.

quest_list.notes: Halcyon feather
quest_list.success_message: You barely notice this long, slender white feather half-buried in the sand. Particles of sand and ash stick to it and you have to brush it off. It's coated with a waxy substance and feels waterproof. Curious!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Long White Feather.

quest_list.notes: Is there more to find? (3808-3811 chain to this. Imaginary flagcount check)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Could there be more to find?
quest_list.success_message: You look around some more, but there doesn't seem to be anything left to find for Aili.

quest_list.notes: Give Aili the feathers and tell her about the prints
quest_list.title: Aili and the Strange Prints
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Aili and the Strange Prints quest!  You earned 2 Red Crystal Shard, 3 Blue Crystal Shards, and 75 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She quietly looks at the feathers, running the white one through her fingers.) Well. (She seems to be about to say more, but changes her mind.) That's that, then. Take these. Thank you. I suppose what you found means more to me than to you.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Olivia asked you to pick up her holiday cookie ingredients (need to choose difficulty level after this stage)
quest_list.success_message: You offered to help Olivia collect the special ingredients for her holiday cookies.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Would you? That's very kind. Now let me just organize my thoughts a minute and make sure I tell you the right things- I had a shipment of pecans just come in for the pfefferneusse so we're all set on that front...

quest_list.notes: You chose NOT to go to Cloud Isle
quest_list.success_message: Olivia gave you a List of the Ingredients she needs, as well as $3000 for travel and expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Super! Here's a list of all the ingredients I need. You should only need to make two stops to get all of it. Here's a little money for your travels, and in case I forgot to pay anyone in advance...

quest_list.notes: You chose TO go to Cloud Isle. You CAN select this path even if you can't get to Cloud, because why not; but you have to double-confirm that you want to do that.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hmmm... it doesn't look like you can actually get to Cloud Isle yet. You won't be able to finish the job for me until you can get there. Do you really want to wait until you can go there to finish this? It's OK if you want to just help me with the first t
quest_list.success_message: Olivia gave you a List of the Ingredients she needs, as well as $4000 for travel and expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Super! Here's a list of all the ingredients I need. You should only need to make three stops to get all of it. Here's a little money for your travels, and in case I forgot to pay anyone in advance...

quest_list.notes: Get spices from Rika
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but this was to be $1000. Olivia paid half in advance, but the rest was due upon pickup. I really will need that. The anise in particular is very dear.
quest_list.success_message: You purchased Olivia's Box of Spices from Rika Millgrater for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Certainly. I supply these for her every year. Olivia's pfeffernuesse are famous!

quest_list.notes: Get chocolate from Emma
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Raises an eyebrow.) I'm sure Olivia didn't forget that she'd only paid half up front. The remaining $1000 is due on pickup.
quest_list.success_message: You purchased Olivia's Dark Chocolate from Emma for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you are now! My very best dark chocolate, made from 72% cocoa solids- the finest, darkest chocolate you can get. Now, the chocolate's good, but Olivia's truffles really make it special.

quest_list.notes: Get sprinkles from Hansel if and only if you chose quest path 3816
quest_list.success_message: Hansel gave you the Shaker of Sprinkles Olivia had ordered.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yup! Here you are! One shaker of our magic sprinkles. Don't let Olivia forget our deal now! Everyone needs to know the sprinkles came from us!

quest_list.notes: Give the spices and the chocolate; this starts endgame chain for the no-Cloud path
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, but you're missing something. I'd needed the spices and the chocolate.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olivia the Box of Spices from Rika and the special Dark Chocolate from Emma.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooh! This all smells heavenly! Rika and Emma have outdone themselves as usual.

quest_list.notes: Give the sprinkles, if you got them; chains to 3823 to finish quest
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you're missing the sprinkles from Cloud. You agreed to get those for me also.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Shaker of Sprinkles from Hansel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: And these sprinkles even look magical! I wonder what Hansel puts in them?

quest_list.notes: Give the spices and the chocolate; this starts endgame chain for Cloud path
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but you don't have everything here. I'd needed the spices and the chocolate and the sprinkles. Please come back when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Olivia the Box of Spices from Rika and the special Dark Chocolate from Emma.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooh! This all smells heavenly! Rika and Emma have outdone themselves as usual.

quest_list.notes: Endgame for Cloud path
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh! And I nearly forgot, since you went all the way up to Cloud for me, I've also given you a $7000 bonus. That should help cover the cost of the giant coconuts, if nothing else!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olivia's Holiday Cookies quest! You earned $20,000 plus a $7,000 bonus for traveling to the Cloud Isles, as well as 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a fabulous job you've done! I do appreciate all your help. Since you went all the way up to Cloud for me, I've also given you a $7000 bonus. That should help cover the extra cost. I think this year's cookies will be the best yet!

quest_list.notes: Endgame for non-Cloud path
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Olivia's Holiday Cookies quest! You earned $20,000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a fabulous job you've done! I do appreciate all your help. I really think this year's cookies will be the best yet!

quest_list.notes: Finish Olivia's quest. You can now learn any of the recipes you've helped her with. These all come from my family's holiday cookie recipe collection
quest_list.title: Olivia's Holiday Cookies
quest_list.success_message: Olivia offered to teach you the recipes for the cookies you've helped her with. (You could use these recipes to make some yummy cookies to share with family and friends! You can always come back later if you don't want to learn them now.)
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd best get to baking. Say... since you've been such a big help, I'll let you in on a secret. Would you be interested in learning my cookie recipes?
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: You chose your path for Olivia's quest (allows for dialogue checking so you can't do 3814 and log out and get into a muddle.) Chained from both options.
Olivia checks if you can go to Cloud Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hmm... it doesn't look like you can get to the Cloud Isles yet. If you can't get there, you'll have to wait until you can to finish this job for me. Do you really want to wait to finish this job until you can go to the Cloud Isles?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It does look like you've been adventurous enough.  Are you sure you're up for it?

quest_list.notes: You agree to help Kendi make sand soup.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to ask Kendi's parents and neighbors for 'soup stuff' - presumably ingredients- so she can make her sand soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmmm... maybe not e'rybody. But soup stuff from Mommy, and Daddy, and Sando, and Mandala, and...

quest_list.notes: Get nopales from Sando
quest_list.success_message: Sando gave you some Nopales for Kendi's soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, if I'm going to have to eat the stuff, I may as well make sure there's something I like in it. Here, take these nopales.

quest_list.notes: Get cilantro from Mandala
quest_list.success_message: Mandala gave you some Cilantro for Kendi's sand soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (She wrinkles her nose.) Far be it from me to discourage cooking. Here, give her this cilantro. Cilantro makes everything better!

quest_list.notes: Get tomatillos from Loyada
quest_list.success_message: Loyada gave you some Tomatillos for Kendi's sand soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Her parents really ought to discourage her... or at least teach her how to really cook! I guess she can have these tomatillos. I picked more than I needed, and I'd hate to have them go to total waste.

quest_list.notes: Get serranos from Alati
quest_list.success_message: Alati gave you some Serrano Peppers for Kendi's sand soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well... you did pull me out of here, so I guess I can give you a little something for her. Here, take these serrano peppers. They're too hot for me, but maybe she'll like them.

quest_list.notes: Get onion from Yiska
quest_list.success_message: Yiska gave you an Onion for Kendi's stone soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My wife encourages her... and I have to take a bite, too! Every time! Here, take this onion. That way I can bite into it, and when I cry because the soup tastes like sand, I can say it is the onion.

quest_list.notes: Collecting items: start here, chains to 3835,3836
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Giggles.) You're silly! I don' think you've talked to ev'ybody yet!

quest_list.notes: Take tomatillos and serranos; chains to 3836
Take onion; chain end. Give 2 bowls soup
quest_list.success_message: You delivered all of Kendi's sand soup ingredients! She asked you to take a bowl to each of her parents.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yay! You brough' me lots of yummies! (She stirs them all into her bowl of water and rock, then pours out two smaller bowls.) Take to Mommy and Daddy, please?

quest_list.notes: Bowl of soup for Yazhi
quest_list.success_message: Yazhi enjoyed a bowl of her daughter's sand soup!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That was... very good! This is very good, Kendi!

quest_list.notes: Bowl of soup for Yiska
quest_list.success_message: Yiska really liked Kendi's sand soup!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: ( Screws up his face and takes a sip... and immediately starts bawling.) I'm crying because it's so delicious! It really is!

quest_list.notes: Everyone liked Kendi's soup
quest_list.title: Kendi Cooks Sand Soup
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Giggles.) You're really silly! You didn't give a bowl to both Mommy and Daddy!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Kendi Cooks Sand Soup quest! You earned 2 Dinosaur Bones and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yay! Everybody likes Kendi's soup! Thanks!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Octavius instructs you to find a jeweler to have a necklace made.
quest_list.success_message: Octavius has commissioned you to find a fine jeweler to make an obsidian-and-coral necklace for Octavia.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: How should I know? You think jewelers talk to octopi? All I know is, it would have to be a fine jeweler, to make a necklace worthy of Octavia!

quest_list.notes: Deidra instructs you on where to find coral.
quest_list.success_message: Deidra told you that you can find coral on the south-east point of Starfish Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, I'm growing some on the south-east point of Starfish. You can dig a little bit up. But be REALLY careful! Even though I'm farming it and you're not disturbing a natural reef, coral is precious!

quest_list.notes: Dig to find coral... or rather, Pearl.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: THUNK! Your shovel struck something hard... but it definitely wasn't coral! This clam does NOT look happy.

quest_list.notes: Pearl tells you where to find an algae sample.
quest_list.success_message: Pearl told you that you can collect an algae sample from the south-east point of Jungle Isle, under the double palm tree.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Now you just go to the south-east point of Jungle Isle under the double palm tree. You look really closely, now! And bring me back 20 pearls along with that algae, to thank me for putting up with you!

quest_list.notes: Dig on south Jungle... and get a wee bit of a surprise.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You looked closely at the sand south of the double palm like Pearl suggested... but didn't watch your feet! Yikes! Now you're in the middle of the ocean! Maybe if you look, you can see where you can get your feet on the ground...

quest_list.notes: Magnify to land on the rock.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Whew... you got yourself onto the rock. It's a near thing. The rock is slippery with... algae! Maybe you can scrape some up with your shovel.

quest_list.notes: Dig to collect a sample.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully collected a sample of Zooxanthellae, a type of algae! Now you'd better look closely for a way to get back to shore.

quest_list.notes: Magnify to go back to shore.
quest_list.success_message: Whew- you made it back to shore without losing the algae sample! Time to head back to Pearl. Don't forget to bring her the twenty pearls!

quest_list.notes: Deliver algae and pearls to Pearl
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Bah! Come back here without my pearls, will you? Thought you could get out of giving them? Well, you'd best think again, youngling!
quest_list.success_message: Pearl took the Zooxanthellae Sample and the 20 Pearls and gave you the Coral Sample she'd promised.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmph! Well, you did as you promised. Here's a sample of the coral for you. Now don't you come back here wanting more! (Slams her shell shut and disappears.)

quest_list.notes: Deidra makes the necklace.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You forgot the obsidian! I can hardly make a coral and obsidian necklace without it.
quest_list.success_message: Deidra crafted the necklace for Octavia! Time to take it right to her!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, marvelous. No trouble then? (Doesn't give you a chance to answer, twisting the coral and rock into secure brackets in a silver chain.) There you are then, a necklace fit for an octopus!

quest_list.notes: Deliver the necklace to Octavia
quest_list.success_message: Octavia took the Coral and Obsidian Necklace from you and put it on, so presumably she likes it. She gave you a Big Black Pearl to take back to Octavius.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Takes the necklace from you with a tentacle that's more delicate than you'd imagined, and slips it over her head. With another tentacle she rolls a large Black Pearl towards you.)

quest_list.notes: Give Octavius the Black Pearl from Octavia
quest_list.title: Octavius Goes A-Courting
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Octavius Goes A-Courting quest!  You earned 5 Crystal Statues and 175 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My Octavia! Sending me such a pearl- I've never seen one like it! I will swim to her soon! Here, take these- they washed up on shore the other day. I have no use for them. I'm coming, Octavia! (Dives into the water.)
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Yazhi doesn't have anything for Kendi's soup
quest_list.success_message: Yazhi let you know that she doesn't have anything for Kendi's soup.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh dear... she's at it again, is she? I do try to encourage her to cook- it's such a useful skill to have- but I wish she'd expand her horizons a little bit. Please tell her I'm sorry, but I don't have anything she can use this time.

quest_list.notes: Frederick asks you to gather his ingredients
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to stop at Rika Millgrater's for a Bag of Peppercorns and the Hotton General Store for a Box of Matzo; to visit the Wington communal vegetable garden for Celery and an Onion; and to gather 3 Carrots for Frederick. He gave you $500 for expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Excellent, excellent. Now, Rika's is the only place for peppercorns. Then Ethel at the Hotton General Store will get you the matzo, and except for the carrots, the vegetables can be picked at the community garden in town. Here's something for expenses.

quest_list.notes: Rika sells you peppercorn
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That costs $250.  Apparently you do not have enough on you.
quest_list.success_message: You purchased a Bag of Peppercorns from Rika for $250.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are then! Tell Frederick I said hello.

quest_list.notes: Ethel sells you a box of matzo
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That costs $250.  Apparently you do not have enough on you.
quest_list.success_message: You purchased a Box of Matzo from Ethel Berryjam for $250.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, dear! House-made. Frederick's been buying here for years!

quest_list.notes: Dig in vegetable garden for onions, celery
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You picked two Stalks of Celery and dug up a medium-sized Onion from the Wington Community Garden.

quest_list.notes: Give Frederick everything- chained to 3858,3859 to collect all items
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have everything here! Did you forget the carrots, maybe? I needed three of those, plus the vegetables from the community garden in town, the pepper from Rika, and the matzo from Ethel.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you very much! These vegetables look wonderfully fresh. They'll bring great flavor to the broth. Thank you for getting these for me- it's hard for a fellow like me to get around as well as I used to.

quest_list.notes: Give Frederick everything- chained from 3857, to 3859 to collect all items
Get reward from Frederick
quest_list.title: Frederick's Matzo Ball Soup
quest_list.success_message: You Completing Frederick's Matzo Ball Soup quest!  You earned $5,000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Cadence sends you to pick up seeds from her neighbors.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to pick up Seed Packets from the residents on the southern side of Wington. There should be 6 packets in all.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great! That will save me a lot of running around. First, I need you to go to the south side of town and pick up seeds from my neighbors there. You know, Dominique, Zachava, Elaina, everyone down there. There should be six packets in all.

quest_list.notes: Picked up seeds from Zachava
quest_list.success_message: You picked up a Packet of Seeds from Zachava!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hannah and I decided to grow pumpkins this year! Then when Halloween rolls around, we'll have lots of fun picking them out for jack o'lanterns. Won't we? (Hannah gives you a shy smile.)

quest_list.notes: Picked up seeds from Dominique
quest_list.success_message: You picked up a Packet of Seeds from Dominique.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are! These are seeds from last year's tomatoes. I just love tomatoes! When I was young, my mother and I would make our own tomato sauce. I loved that! I'm going to do the same thing with Tally.

quest_list.notes: Picked up seeds from Zamora
quest_list.success_message: You picked up a Packet of Seeds from Zamora!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here! (Thrusts a large packet of seeds at you.) Cactus figs. Brought 'em with me when I moved from Santon. Cadence says 'Noooo, they won't grow here.' They'll grow if I say so!

quest_list.notes: Picked up seeds from Gertrude
quest_list.success_message: You picked up a Packet of Seeds from Gertrude!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, dear! They're watermelons! Big juicy watermelons! I do hope their vines don't take up half the garden. They do that, you know.

quest_list.notes: Picked up seeds from Elaina
quest_list.success_message: You picked up a Packet of Seeds from Elaina!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, that's so nice of you to help Cadence. She's doing us all a big favor by orchestrating this garden! Here's my contribution: cucumbers! I do love cucumbers. Tell her I'll provide the trellis for them. My grandson is making one.

quest_list.notes: Picked up seeds from Patience
quest_list.success_message: You picked up a Packet of Seeds from Patience!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes! Green beans! I just love green beans. I could eat them for breakfast, lunch, and dinner every day! Well, maybe not breakfast. Maybe for a mid-morning tea?

quest_list.notes: Deliver the seeds to Cadence; run to the farrier.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, it looks like you may have forgotten to stop by all of my neighbors' homes. I was expecting six seed packets in all, and you don't have them all here.
quest_list.success_message: Cadence thanked you for collecting the seeds for her, and sent you to the farrier to pick up a few things she'd had made.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Flips through the packets.) Cucumbers, pumpkins, tomatoes... and cactus figs. Well, they'll grow or they won't. Thanks for bringing them to me! Now I just need you to run to the blacksmith's. He should be done with my stakes and rabbit fence.

quest_list.notes: Pick up from Liam the farrier
quest_list.success_message: You picked up Cadence's supplies from the blacksmith's.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, good timing! I didn't finish too long ago. The coil of wire rabbit fencing and the tomato stakes.

quest_list.notes: Give Cadence the wire and tomato stakes
quest_list.title: Cadence Plants the Community Garden
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I think you may have forgotten something! I needed my supplies from Liam, the blacksmith. You don't seem to have them with you.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed the Cadence Plants the Community Garden! You earned $4500 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, perfect! The tomato stakes and the rabbit fencing wire. We had terrible trouble with rabbits last year. Thanks very much for your help! With a little weather luck we'll have a great crop this summer.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Mal gives you a cup of coffee.
quest_list.success_message: Mal gives you a cup of Coffee.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, have one.

quest_list.notes: Spike wants a new shield
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to talk to the local librarian about books on armory and heraldry.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Awesome! Thanks!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Treeton library doesn't have the book; sends you to Crystalton
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, I'm so sorry. We actually don't have them on the shelves currently; they're on loan to... let me see... ah yes, Crystalton. They won't be due back here for another three weeks. You could always check with Crystalton to see if they have them available.
quest_list.success_message: The Treeton librarian says that all of their books on armory and heraldry are on loan to the Crystalton library.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, I'm so sorry. We actually don't have them on the shelves currently; they're on loan to... let me see... ah yes, Crystalton. They won't be due back here for another three weeks. You could always check with Crystalton to see if they have them available.

quest_list.notes: Crystalton library says the books are on loan to Ted.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Normally I wouldn't do this, but since they are overdue you have my full permission to go over to Polar Isle to see that Ted and ask him if he ever intends to give them back!
quest_list.success_message: The Crystalton librarian says that all of the books on armory and heraldry are on loan to Ted on Polar Isle. She suggested that you ask him if you can have them.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Normally I wouldn't do this, but since they are overdue you have my full permission to go over to Polar Isle to see that Ted and ask him if he ever intends to give them back!

quest_list.notes: Ted refuses to give the books back.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hmph! Take my books, I don't think so! I checked them out fair and square! I wouldn't give them to you even for a whole flagon of mead! (He coughs, loud and long.) Okay, maybe for a flagon of mead. But only then!
quest_list.success_message: Ted has flat-out refused to let you borrow the books... unless you bring him a flagon of mead. Maybe the Crystalton general store would know what he means.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmph! Take my books, I don't think so! I checked them out fair and square! I wouldn't give them to you even for a whole flagon of mead! (He coughs, loud and long.) Okay, maybe for a flagon of mead. But only then!

quest_list.notes: Windy Pick sells you a 'flagon of mead' (really tea with honey.)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money here. This will cost $500.
quest_list.success_message: You purchased a Flagon of Tea with Honey (which you'll be sure to tell Ted is actually 'mead.')
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go! Just call it 'mead' when you give it to him. It makes him feel like he's in those fantasy worlds he writes about, and trust me, he's a lot less grumpy when he thinks he's there.

quest_list.notes: Give 100 acorns for testing Mal's quest.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Acorns granted!

quest_list.notes: Swap Ted the tea for the books.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hah! Wasting my time, are you? You don't have what I wanted!
quest_list.success_message: You coerced Ted into giving you the books for Spike! She'll be happy to have them back.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ahh... (Takes a happy whiff of the 'mead' in the pitcher.) That's the stuff! Here, take the books. I'm about done with them anyhow.

quest_list.notes: Give Spike the books; she's going to need a minute or two...
quest_list.success_message: You gave Spike the Stack of Books! She looks like she may need some time to read through them.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ooh! You found it! You were away for so long I thought you'd just agreed to shut me up and weren't going to get it after all. Thanks so so so so so much! (Immediately starts reading the book.)

quest_list.notes: Spike needs another minute.
quest_list.success_message: Spike isn't done reading yet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Not looking up from her book, she replies:) Nope. Gotta read read read.

quest_list.notes: ...and another minute.
quest_list.success_message: Spike still isn't done reading yet.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Turns a page.) Nope.

quest_list.notes: That's enough minutes. Spike tells you what she needs for her shield to be made.
quest_list.success_message: Spike will need first for her shield to be made by an experienced woodworker, and then for it to be painted with her chosen device.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So that's going to take some doing. Could you go to those people for me? I sort of don't have my boat privileges back. The wicked witch who lives in my house said next time I read through them calling my dock she's not picking me up in Shellton.

quest_list.notes: Xamba will make the shield, but boy, does he need a laundry list.
quest_list.success_message: Xamba will require 5 pieces of Ebony Wood, 3 Leather Pieces, 2 Leather Straps, and 2 Large Buckles to make the shield, plus $3000 for labor.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Materials are needed, yes yes! Five pieces of ebony wood, three pieces of leather, and then two leather strips and two big buckles for the shield.  Cost will be $3000, yes yes!

quest_list.notes: Returning to Xamba with items part 1: wood and buckles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, oh, no, no.  Something is missing!  Five pieces of ebony wood and two large buckles.

quest_list.notes: Returning to Xamba with items part 2: leather and money (chained from 3883)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh, oh, no, no.  Something is missing!  Two leather straps, three pieces of leather and $3000.  Yes.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Xamba all of the supplies he needed, plus his payment, for the shield. He asked you to come back tomorrow for the completed shield.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, yes! This is all good. Now go on and go do whatever. Later.  Come back later.  Then it will be ready.  Yup yup!

quest_list.notes: Christel tells you she will sell you a jack-in-the-box
quest_list.success_message: Christel is willing to sell you Jack-in-the-box toys for $50 each.

quest_list.notes: Xamba gives you the shield
quest_list.success_message: Xamba gave you the shield for Spike! Now you'll just have to find a painter to finish it.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are, yup yup! A stout shield to defend against the fiercest of foes!

quest_list.notes: Pablo will paint the shield for $1500
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have enough money here! This will cost $1500.
quest_list.success_message: You paid Pablo $1500 to paint the shield for Spike. He told you to come back tomorrow to pick it up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Indeed! It is a noble device. Yes, this will be a project worthy of my talents! Now, shoo, shoo! Come back tomorrow.

quest_list.notes: Pablo painted the shield
quest_list.success_message: Pablo gave you the painted shield. Spike will be excited to see it!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, here you are! This has been a delightful project! So rarely I have the opportunity to work with someone who knows how to articulate what she wants! My regards to the Knight of Treeton!

quest_list.notes: Give April May Rain her new sheild
quest_list.title: The Knight of Treeton's Shield
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Knight of Treeton's Shield! You earned 4 Crystal Statues, 5 Dinosaur Bones, and 250 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My shield! It's gorgeous! Just how I wanted! And it's real, too! You found somebody who did the leather and everything! Oh, thank you, thank you, thank you! Here, take these for your help!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Buy a jack-in-the-box companion from Christel
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That will be $50 and you don't have that on you right now.
quest_list.success_message: Christel sold you a Jack-in-the-box companion for $50.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There you go.  I hope you don't scare the daylights out of your horse.

quest_list.notes: Agree to have a pillow made for Bess
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to find someone to make a small, waterproof, feather pillow for Bess.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Good!  Be sure it's made of some decent waterproof material.  Oh, and not a huge pillow.  Something small will be fine.

quest_list.notes: Barb Sower says she'll make a pillow
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get Paraffin Wax, Beeswax and 50 Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'll need a few things though.  Please get some paraffin wax from the local general store, talk to Evelynn about beeswax and you might as well get feathers.  Fifty should suffice.

quest_list.notes: Get beeswax from Evelynn
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It looks like you don't have the $500.
quest_list.success_message: Evelynn sold you Beeswax for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you are.  I hope the waterproofing goes well.

quest_list.notes: Get paraffin wax from Phoebe Wares
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don't forget the money.  You don't have $500.
quest_list.success_message: Phoebe Wares sold you Paraffin Wax for $500.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you for your purchase!  Shop here any time.

quest_list.notes: Give Barb Sower feathers and paraffin wax
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I see you have the beeswax, but I also need paraffin wax and fifty feathers.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Barb Sower the Paraffin Wax, Beeswax and 50 Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  I already made up the pillow, now I just need to waterproof the fabric and stuff in the feathers.  Then it will be done!

quest_list.notes: Give barb sower the beeswax (chained)
Get pillow from Barb Sower
quest_list.success_message: Barb Sower gave you a Feather Pillow.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I did!  Here you are.  You did so much work collecting the materials, don't worry about payment for this.  The excess wax will be helpful for me.

quest_list.notes: Give Bess the feather pillow
quest_list.title: A Comfortable Sleep for Bess
quest_list.success_message: You Completed A Comfortable Sleep for Bess.  You earned three Diamonds and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oooo, this looks nice!  It's about time you got here with it.  I suppose I should give you something for this.   Here are some diamonds I had around.
quest_list.author: Miranda

quest_list.notes: Mal is incoherent. (Go talk to Polly.)
quest_list.success_message: ...you'd really like to help Mal right now, but she's too terrifying. Maybe Polly will be able to help.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Practically hissing.) Give... me... give...

quest_list.notes: Polly explains the problem...
quest_list.success_message: Polly explained that Mal is out of coffee.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You are exactly right. It's like living with an extremely jumpy shark. She's out of coffee. Ran out this morning, and then sat upon her French press. The press is fine, but it's doing wonders for her temper, let me tell you.

quest_list.notes: Agree- sort of- to collect acorns for Mal/Polly.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to collect 50 Acorns for a coffee substitute for Mal.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That would be useful. And appreciated. Fifty ought to do it. Should only need a couple per cup, but she drinks a lot of coffee.

quest_list.notes: Offer to talk to Ted on Edward's behalf.
quest_list.success_message: You offered to talk to Ted about taking Edward on as a writing apprentice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Would you really do that for me? I'm sure I could get Grandma to let me visit Frigid Meadows!

quest_list.notes: Track Sahkyo (just for tracking)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Some say the look of knowledge does not shine from your eyes. Go back and learn.

quest_list.notes: You've heard the spiel from Hanska - Toy Soldier
quest_list.success_message: Hanska gave you Jack's Last Letter to her. Maybe that will help you with your investigations.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's very kind of you, dear. Certainly you might get further than I have.

quest_list.notes: Give acorns and get fake coffee from Polly.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait.  I thought you said you had the 50 acorns?
quest_list.success_message: You delivered 50 Acorns to Polly.  She brewed and gave you a Nutty Coffee Substitute for Mal.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Grind... grind... hot water... pour... Okay. This doesn't look like coffee and it doesn't smell like coffee either, but maybe it will calm her down for the meantime. I just checked the clock. The boat should be in by now.

quest_list.notes: Give fake coffee to Mal.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Myyyyyyyyy coffeeeeeeeeeee!)
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Nutty Coffee Substitute to Mal, and she doesn't appear to dislike it enough to stop drinking it... Better ask Polly whether this solves the problem.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Snatches the cup from your hands and downs it in a single gulp. She makes a face as though she's just consumed poison, then gathers her courage and imperiously gestures for more.)

quest_list.notes: Polly sends you to the dock to pick up the coffee.
quest_list.success_message: Polly sent you down to the Whorl Isle dock to pick up Mal's coffee shipment. She said to return directly to Mal.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Otherwise... if she smells coffee in the house and she doesn't have it, it might get ugly.

quest_list.notes: Pick up the coffee from the dock
quest_list.success_message: You picked up Mal's Enormous Bag of Coffee Beans! It's so big it's going to take all of your horses to haul it back to Mal...
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I wondered how she was faring with the delay. She gets a sack this big every week, you know. She's very serious about her coffee, Mal is. You'd best take it back to her directly. Put your wallet away, dear, she pre-paid.

quest_list.notes: Give the coffee to Mal and no one gets hurt.
quest_list.title: Mal Gets Her Coffee
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Mal Gets Her Coffee!  You earned $10,000 from Polly and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Knocks you over as she tackles the bag. When you get back to your feet, you realize that she is actually chewing on handfuls of beans at a time. From the corner of the room, Polly, looking resigned, flips you a small purse.)
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ted.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: (Listens to what you have to say, face growing slowly more purple.)
quest_list.success_message: You proposed to Ted that he take Edward on as his writing apprentice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Listens to what you have to say, face growing slowly more purple.)

quest_list.notes: Ted throws you out.
quest_list.success_message: Ted threw you out of his house... but do you really want to let it end like this? Are you really afraid of a guy with a fake wizard's staff?
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (With a mighty roar, Ted chases you out the door, brandishing what looks like a replica wizard's staff.)

quest_list.notes: Optional: You feel so guilty telling Edward
quest_list.success_message: Edward looks so disappointed that you can't help telling him you'll go back to Ted and make him listen to you this time!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh... Well, I guess I can understand that. He must be very busy. I guess I understand that he doesn't want to read a book by a kid. (Still, he looks so disappointed that you can't help what you say next...)

quest_list.notes: Bang back into Ted's house.
quest_list.success_message: You're going to give convincing Ted another try!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I thought you left!

quest_list.notes: Ted agrees to read Edward's novel when it's done.
quest_list.success_message: Victory! Ted says he'll read Edward's novel when it's done.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: FINE! Fine! You've convinced me! Tell the kid I'll read his novel, but only when it's done!

quest_list.notes: Tell Edward that Ted will read his finished novel.
quest_list.title: Edward Seeks Apprenticeship
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Edward Seeks Apprenticeship! You earned a Diamond, a Dinosaur Bone, and 75 quest points!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow! You did it! You really did it! I'm so excited! Now I'm going to be extra-motivated to finish!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: The letter told you nothing
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nothing? Well, dear, I didn't expect you would. Jack was always one to put my head in a whorl. Never could get to the point the way I'd have liked. Still...

quest_list.notes: Animal tracks leading west to the beach
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You can't make out what kind they are, but there are definitely animal tracks leading west to the beach- and drag marks, as though the creature had something in its mouth.

quest_list.notes: Imprint of toy soldier feet in the sandcastle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Peering closely at the sandcastle, you notice the imprint of little feet... soldier feet? Could be! Who made this sandcastle?

quest_list.notes: Edward sent the soldier off in a paper boat
quest_list.success_message: Edward told you that he found Hanska's toy soldier... and sent it off in a boat.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I remember that soldier! Curlypaws brought it over. I thought it looked like a Navy soldier in that outfit, fit to sail a boat! So I sent it off in a paper boat when the tide got low.

quest_list.notes: Puppy paws (optional action)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Out of the snow, you can clearly recognize the animal tracks as being dog paws. It looks like a dog was sitting around here watching something happen.

quest_list.notes: Agua demands a toll
quest_list.success_message: Agua demanded a toll before he'll tell you about the toy soldier.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I am speakin' of on'a those big orange squashy things. With the seeds in. Had one'a those once. Bring one back what's rat-sized, and I'll tell ya all about that toy soldier.

quest_list.notes: John O'Lantern will let you pick the pumpkin
quest_list.success_message: John O'Lantern has given his permission for you to pick one of his pumpkins for Agua.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I've never met a rat without an enormous appetite. Go ahead out into that patch and dig up the biggest one you can find.

quest_list.notes: Pick a pumpkin
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dug up the most enormous pumpkin you've ever seen. Ought to keep Agua busy for awhile.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You acquired a Rat-Sized Pumpkin.

quest_list.notes: Deliver the pumpkin
quest_list.success_message: You gave Agua the Rat-Sized Pumpkin.  He told you what he knows about the whereabouts of the toy soldier.

quest_list.notes: Justin gives you Dalton's Sea Picture
quest_list.success_message: Justin gave you Dalton's Sea Picture.

quest_list.notes: Polly sends you to Marina
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You know, for that matter, you might ask Marina. There's so much old mail stored at that dock. For all I know, it dates back to Grandma Jack's time. Here, take this soldier on back to Hans, will you? Sounds like it means a lot to her.
quest_list.success_message: Polly suggested you talk to Marina at the dock.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You know, for that matter, you might ask Marina. There's so much old mail stored at that dock. For all I know, it dates back to Grandma Jack's time. Here, take this soldier on back to Hans, will you? Sounds like it means a lot to her.

quest_list.notes: Get mail sack from Marina
quest_list.success_message: You got a Sack full of all the letters Jack had written Hanska over the years!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Certainly, it'll be good to have them out of the place. Every letter in here is for that Hanska person- would you believe it?

quest_list.notes: Hanska takes the letters (Endgame)
quest_list.title: The Steadfast Tin Soldier
quest_list.success_message: You Completed The Steadfast Tin Soldier quest! You earned $50,000 and 325 quest points.
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Dalton tells you to talk to Justin (dialogue purposes.)
quest_list.success_message: Dalton seems to be having a little trouble.

quest_list.notes: Pegleg Johnny sends you to Martha
quest_list.success_message: Pegleg Johnny says that the picture recalled him of a kraken his aunt, a baker, once met.
