quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, well, me auntie once told me she met a kraken o' that size. Terrible beastie, kraken. Hope I never see one. Auntie's a bit of a kraken herself, but she's a baker now, harmin' nobody.

quest_list.notes: Martha remembers Dalton; gives Sky Picture
quest_list.success_message: Martha gave you Dalton's Sky Picture.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, he put it back up in the clouds! So he told me, and I believe him. You would too, if you'd known him. He drew me a picture of it, look.

quest_list.notes: Astrid gives you the Stardust
quest_list.success_message: You were given a pouch of Astrid's Stardust for Dalton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A very unusual pair, they were! I've never seen the like. I doubt I ever will again. Even kings and princes would bow to them. Remember me to him, won't you please? Please give him this from me when you see him.

quest_list.notes: Prince Charming suggests you speak to a King (optional)
quest_list.success_message: Prince Charming doesn't know Dalton. He suggested you speak to a King.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, but that sounds like it may have been before my time. I've heard many wonderful legends of fantastical beasts, but none of a boy named Dalton. Perhaps the kings who bowed would know more.

quest_list.notes: King Phil sends you to talk to Falkor.
quest_list.success_message: King Phil suggested you talk to a dragon.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You need to talk to a dragon  What's the name of that dragon nearby... Fallen? Falcon? Anyway, you find that dragon. I bet he'll set you right.

quest_list.notes: Falcor flies you to the Isle of Hardly
quest_list.success_message: Falcor flew you to the Isle of Hardly!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hooooooold ooooooon!

quest_list.notes: Fluff asks you to leave him alone
quest_list.success_message: How could this wilting isle have ever cured Dalton before? Perhaps someone else will be more willing to talk.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I think it's best if you just... go.

quest_list.notes: Petunia sends you to Dalton; gives serum
quest_list.success_message: Petunia gave you a small vial of Unicorn Horn Serum to take back to Dalton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Fluff once cured that little boy by bringing him here. Perhaps the boy is now grown enough to return the favor. Here, take this. It is the last I have. I hope it will be of use.

quest_list.notes: Dalton gives you the Cake Picture
quest_list.success_message: You received Dalton's Cake Picture.

quest_list.notes: Martha tells you what she needs
quest_list.success_message: Martha will do her best to bake a healing cake. She will need the Stardust from Astrid, the Serum from Petunia, and 5 each of Moonbeams and Silver Linings.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This would be impossible to do if it weren't for these magical items you've been given- I mean the Stardust and the Unicorn Horn Serum. Very rare, very powerful. I will also need some Moonbeams and Silver Linings. Five of each. A little goes a long way.

quest_list.notes: Martha takes the collectible items (chained to 3940)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: How can I make a magic cake without magic ingredients? I need five each of moonbeams and silver linings. You didn't bring me enough.
quest_list.success_message: You delivered five Moonbeams and five Silver Linings to Martha.

quest_list.notes: Martha takes the quest items and gives the Sunshine Cake
quest_list.success_message: She stirred them into a batter along with Astrid's Stardust and the Unicorn Horn Serum. Quickly she bakes and frosts it, and presents you with a Sunshine Cake!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This is my very best. It contains the magic of stars and of unicorns, which are powerful things, but the real magic is that the ingredients were given out of friendship, and the cake made with love. If this cannot heal him, I'm afraid I can do no more.

quest_list.notes: Dalton eats half the Sunshine Cake.
quest_list.success_message: Dalton ate half of the Sunshine Cake and asked you to take the rest to Fluff.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh my... I feel better with just one bite! Please- take the other half of this cake to Fluff. He healed me once- now it's my turn to repay the favor!

quest_list.notes: Fluff eats the other half of the Sunshine Cake.
quest_list.success_message: The remaining half of the Sunshine Cake healed Fluff! All around you, you see the Isle of Hardly brightening up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh... Oh! This is marvelous! I can feel my strength returning already!

quest_list.notes: Fluff flies you to Dalton.
quest_list.success_message: Fluff flew you to Dalton's house! Suddenly he looks like a much smaller dragon than before- which is fortunate, or else he wouldn't fit in the house!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, sit up on my tail. That's how Dalton always liked to ride when he was a boy. Hold on tight!

quest_list.notes: Fluff flies Dalton back to the Isle of Hardly.
quest_list.success_message: Fluff flew Dalton back to the Isle of Hardly for a rest cure.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes! The Isle of Hardly! That's where I was cured before, as a child. I learned to be brave and face down illness. Maybe I need to remember how. Justin, I will be home soon- and when I am, I'll be well again!

quest_list.notes: Justin rewards you
quest_list.title: Dalton's Recovery
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dalton's Recovery! You earned 25 Dinosaur Bones and 10 Diamonds, plus 350 quest points!
quest_list.author: BrightLights

quest_list.notes: Falcor flies you from the Isle of Hardly back to Turtle Isle
quest_list.success_message: Falcor flew you back to Turtle Isle!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hooooooold ooooooon!

quest_list.notes: Falcor flies you from Turtle Isle to the Isle of Hardly
quest_list.success_message: Falcor flew you to the Isle of Hardly!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hooooooold ooooooon!

quest_list.notes: Warren Cash wants earthworms.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Right.  Worms.  A dozen, and a rotten tomato.  I hope that's clear.  You get them?
quest_list.success_message: Warren Cash of the Appleton Bank wants 12 Earthworms and a Rotten Tomato.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, I hadn't thought of that, but it saves me work!  Go fetch me 12 earthworms, and a rotten tomato, and I'll give you some pretty money.

quest_list.notes: Elizabeth tells you where she gets her glue
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to pick up Glue for Elizabeth from Zeke.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I get my glue from Zeke in Witherton.  He should have my order ready.

quest_list.notes: Give Warren his worms and rotten tomato.
quest_list.title: Warren Cash and the Worms of Wealth
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh no you don't!  Come back when you've got what I've actually asked you for!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Warren Cash and the Worms of Wealth!  You earned $2,000 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow!  Fine, ugly, slimy worms indeed!  And hungry! I'm going to be as rich as Croesus, and soon!  Thank you!  May you someday be half as rich as me!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Zeke gives you the glue.
quest_list.success_message: Zeke gives you six Pots of Glue and six Smores.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, six pots of glue.  Tell Elizabeth I threw in six S'mores too, I know she loves chocolate!

quest_list.notes: Elizabeth gets her glue.
quest_list.title: Elizabeth's Glue
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Zeke gave you six pots of glue and six s'mores, you had better find all of them!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Elizabeth's Glue.  You earned $2500 and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're just in time with the glue......Ooooo....chocolate!!! Zeke is such a dear.  Here take this for your trouble.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Amelia tells you where to get Waldorf Salad Fixings.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to get two each of Celery, Apples, Grapes, Walnuts and one Jar of Mayonnaise for Amelia's mice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I get my celery from Hotton and my mayonnaise from the store here in town.  I need 1 jar of mayo and 2 of everything else.

quest_list.notes: Buy Mayo from Phoebe Wares
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, that's not enough money.
quest_list.success_message: You bought a Jar of Mayonnaise from Phoebe Wares.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A jar of mayonnaise.  Here you are.  I don't have grapes, but you can get those on Aesop Isle.

quest_list.notes: Buy Celery from Hotton Food Store
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You can't afford this celery, sorry.
quest_list.success_message: Clementine Crate sold you two bunches of Celery for $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go.  Two bunches of stalks of celery.  Enjoy!

quest_list.notes: Bring Amelia Hayes the final ingredients for...
quest_list.title: Amelia Hays' Waldorf Salad
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Hmmm... you seem to be missing something important here.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Amelia Hays' Waldorf Salad.  You earned $7000 and 30 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Great!  That's everything I need!  Betty!  Twins!  Dinner coming right up!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Hand over apples and walnuts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But... there aren't enough here.  I asked for two of each.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Amelia two Apples and two Walnuts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nice apples.  And nice big walnuts.  And the grapes, did you get those?

quest_list.notes: Hand over Concord Grapes
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: But... there aren't enough here.  I asked for two.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Amelia two Bunches of Grapes.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These look incredibly sweet!  Good!  Last, but not least, the celery and mayo.  Got those?

quest_list.notes: Martina gets Lilbeth's sample
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're supposed to give me her invoice and a sample, you're missing something!
quest_list.success_message: You give Martina Lilibeth's invoice and sample centerpiece.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Examines the centerpiece) I knew Lilibeth would outdo herself with this, and (looking at invoice) at quite a fair price. Very good!

quest_list.notes: Martina gets Shoneah's samples
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You're supposed to give me his invoice and samples, you're missing something!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Martina Shoneah's Invoice and the Velvet Pouch.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Opens the velvet pouch and looks carefully at the jewelry, then at the invoice.) He does do exquisite work, a little on the pricey side but well worth it.

quest_list.notes: Martina sends you to Wington
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Check your pockets, I gave you the order forms already.
quest_list.success_message: Martina gave you Order Forms for Iris and William in Wington.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: William at the Inn is catering the wedding, so he gets the menu.  He'll send some sample appetizers along with his invoice.  Now Iris is doing all the flowers, no need for a sample, but if she could send a sketch of the bridal bouquet, that would be great

quest_list.notes: William gets the wedding order.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, I'm waiting...where's Martina's order form?
quest_list.success_message: You gave William Martina's Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's have a look here... I'm going to take this into the kitchen and do some figures. In the meantime, help yourself to the buffet. (He gestures towards the counter.) On the house!

quest_list.notes: William gives you his Invoice and samples
quest_list.success_message: William gaves you his Invoice and a carefully packaged Appetizer Sampler.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, tell Martina that Holli can choose 6 of the appetizers and she can make changes in the order up to 2 weeks prior to the wedding.  Got that?

quest_list.notes: Iris gets her order form.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, where is it? I don't have all day you know!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Iris Pettel the Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh good, I've been expecting this. ( She leans on the counter with a calculator, fingers flying over the keys.) I'm not going to give you the actual bouquets to bring back, but I will give you pictures for Holli to pick from. Be right back.

quest_list.notes: Iris gives you her invoice and pictures for Martina
quest_list.success_message: Iris Pettel gave you her Invoice and a Floral Designs for Holli's review.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, have Holli pick out the flowers she likes best and remind her I need at least 6 weeks to do this right. (Iris breaks out in a big grin.)

quest_list.notes: Martina gets William's invoice and samples
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Did you forget something?  I'm supposed to have an invoice AND samples.  Don't come back without them!
quest_list.success_message: You give Martina William's invoice and appetizers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These all smell delicious, it's going to be hard to choose (looks over the invoice) and he can bring it in under budget, wonderful!

quest_list.notes: Martina gets Iris' invoice and pictures.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm waiting...invoice and pictures please.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Martina Iris' Invoice and the Floral Designs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Shuffling through the pictures.) Nice, nice, very nice, Oh I bet this is the one! Now her prices are good. Perfect!

quest_list.notes: Martina sends you to Jungle Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Check your pockets, I gave you the order forms already.
quest_list.success_message: Martina gave you the Order Forms for Bob at the Tropicton Livery and Hansel, baker extraordinaire in the Clouds.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: No, those are already taken care of, I need you to see Hansel in the clouds for the cake and Bob in Tropicton for the wedding carriage.

quest_list.notes: Hansel gets the cake order.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, didn't Martina give you an order form?  Where is it??
quest_list.success_message: You gave Hansel Martina's Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the order form.) The wedding cake is no problem, and she wants a Gecko Groom's cake? Now that's a challenge suitable for my talents! Let me work out the invoice... Be right back.

quest_list.notes: Hansel gives you his invoice and a cake box full of goodies.
quest_list.success_message: Hansel gave you an Invoice and a Cake Box of Petits Fours.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Comes back with a cake box.) Here you go, I've packed an assortment of Petits Fours so Holli can sample all the cake/filling/frosting combinations we can do...and here's my invoice, I'll need 6-8 weeks notice.

quest_list.notes: Bob gets his Order Form.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invoice from Martina, where is it?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Bob Martina's Order Form.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the order form.) Okay, I can put this together for you, no problem. Let me get some sketches and I'll be right back..

quest_list.notes: Bob gives you his invoice and sketches of carriages and tack.
quest_list.success_message: Bob Barnett gave you his Invoice and a Packet of Sketches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's my invoice and I included some sketches of the carriages I rent out for weddings as well as some dandified tack for the groom. Let them know I need a month to arrange everything.

quest_list.notes: Martina gets Hansel's samples
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said that Hansel gave you his invoice and cake samples, aren't you missing something?
quest_list.success_message: You give Martina Hansel's invoice and cake box.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Peeks into the cake box and smiles.) These look heavenly! Now as for his prices....all very affordable, all things considered.

quest_list.notes: Martina gets Bob's sketches
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You said you had 2 things from Bob.....where are they?
quest_list.success_message: You give Martina Bob's invoice and sketches.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Shuffling through the sketches) I see Bob can handle any kind of carriage Holli might want, and he has some pretty fancy saddles , and excellent prices. Good work!

quest_list.notes: Martina rewards your efforts.
quest_list.title: Holli's Wedding Planner
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need everything from both Bob and Hansel, please.  One is on the Cloud Isles and the other is in Tropicton.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Holli's Wedding Planner.  You earned $7500, 2 Carrot Treats and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh no, dear, you've done more than enough.  You have no idea how much of a help you have been!  Here take this for your troubles. These are for your horse, poor thing must be exhausted.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Reid gives you the quest for his grandmother's catalog cards.
quest_list.success_message: Reid Pebbleton sent you to find his grandmother's Catalog Box and Cards. He gave you $250 toward travel expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She had a tin box with scroll-work on it and inside were cards. I know she had at least five in there that she used to make copies with.  If you could find them all, that would be great.  Here's some money for boat fare.

quest_list.notes: Dig up the box Reid's bubbe's catalog cards were in.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You dig a bit and hear a *clank!* and find a tin box just big enough to hold index cards.  It's empty now; an animal probably got to it first.  Perhaps if you search carefully nearby, you'll be able to find the cards.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Catalog Card Box!

quest_list.notes: Dig up catalog card 1
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Buried under the snow, you found a catalog card with a big, red 1 in one corner.  The intaglio printing has held up very well!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Catalog Card!

quest_list.notes: Dig up catalog card 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: Buried under the snow, you found a catalog card with a large red 2 in one corner.  This card was once bright blue, but the color has faded.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Catalog Card!

quest_list.notes: Dig up catalog card 3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You found a green catalog card with a large, red 3 in one corner.  But whether it was green to begin with, or has now become overwhelmed with algae, you cannot tell.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Catalog Card!

quest_list.notes: Hand over catalog cards.
quest_list.title: Reid's Grandmother's Legacy
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Oh dear... you didn't find everything, did you?  Nope, it appears you didn't.  There are obviously more cards missing.  Please give it a good old college try!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Reid's Grandmother's Legacy.  You earned 8 Green Crystal Shards, 8 Red Crystal Shards and 35 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes!  This is it!  My grandmother's box and her printed cards!  I can't give you money, but please take these crystal shards!  I'm sure you'll find a use for them.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Dig up catalog card 4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You found a dog-eared catalog card with a big red '4' in one corner.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Catalog Card!

quest_list.notes: Dig up catalog card 5
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You dig all over, but turn up nothing.
quest_list.success_message: You found a catalog card, with a big red '5' in one corner.  Unlike the others, this one is filled in, but alas the writing is only barely legible.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found a Catalog Card!

quest_list.notes: Ben Burlap sells you mosquito netting for Leda.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: A little short there, aren't you?
quest_list.success_message: You buy four meters of Mosquito Netting for $560 from Ben Burlap.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Four meters of mosquito netting, that'll be $560 please.

quest_list.notes: Leda sends you to Earl Bronze for armatures
quest_list.success_message: Leda Swann gave you $5000 and a drawing to give to Earl Bronze.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: There's a farrier on... Turtle, was it, Windy? Turtle! He can make miniature girders and screws and mountings and such. Here's a drawing he can use to make three armatures. And here's some money to pay for them.

quest_list.notes: Give design, get asked for ores
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: So... where's this drawing, then?  This is a laundry list.
quest_list.success_message: Earl Bronze will make Leda Swann's parts if you bring him 10 Chunks of Copper Ore.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, she wants miniature armature parts, does she? Honestly, do my eyes look young to you? No! I can do it, not happily, but I'll need 10 chunks of copper ore.

quest_list.notes: Give Earl  10 ores
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Eh, exactly what part of 'ten chunks of copper ore' is flummoxing you?  There ain't no 10 chunks here.
quest_list.success_message: Earl Bronze wants $5,000 for the parts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These will do. Okay. Got your mechanical parts right here. That'll be $5,000.

quest_list.notes: Pay Earl, get your armature parts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Can you count?
quest_list.success_message: You pay Earl Bronze $5,000 for the Copper Armature Parts that Leda Swann requested.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you. Here you are, and I threw in a few extra nuts and bolts in case, well,  just in case, you know.

quest_list.notes: Give Leda Swann the Armature parts.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: These aren't armature parts... are you sure you understood what I asked you for?
quest_list.success_message: You gave Leda Swann the box of Copper Armature Parts you got from Earl Bronze.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Mmmm!  Nice!  These are just the thing, if I put ... hmmm... hmmm!  Oh yes!

quest_list.notes: Leda sends you to Tropicton for mosquito netting.
quest_list.success_message: Leda Swann has asked you to go to Tropicton and pick up 4 Meters of Mosquito Netting.  She gave you $1000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This will... hmmm... OH!  Mosquito netting! Just the thing for attaching feathers to! Could you be a dear and run to Tropicton and get me... four meters of mosquito net?  Here's some cash for it.

quest_list.notes: Leda needs feathers, and lots of them!
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need 40 plain old feathers. You don't have that.
quest_list.success_message: Leda Swann wants 40 Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, I haven't thought much about that, but if you could get me 40 plain old feathers for now, that would help a lot.  Then I can decide what else I'll need.

quest_list.notes: Give mosquito netting to Leda Swann
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Wait!  This isn't mosquito netting, this is cheesecloth.  It isn't strong enough.  Please bring mosquito netting.
quest_list.success_message: You gave the Mosquito Netting to Leda Swann.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ha!  I'll bet they do!  But this will do just fine!  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Give Feathers to Leda Swann
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not enough.  I was hoping for 40.
quest_list.success_message: You gave 40 Feathers to Leda Swann.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nice!  These will do just fine.  Thank you.

quest_list.notes: Leda sends you to Jungle Isle to search for hummingbird feathers. (tracking)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'd like forty, please.
quest_list.success_message: Leda Swann wants you to go to Jungle Isle and find 40 Hummingbird Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'd like forty, please.

quest_list.notes: Use Magnifying Glass to find hummingbird feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the ground carefully, you find 6 Hummingbird Feathers.

quest_list.notes: Use Magnifying Glass to find hummingbird feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the ground carefully, you find 7 Hummingbird Feathers.

quest_list.notes: Use Magnifying Glass to find hummingbird feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the ground carefully, you find 2 Hummingbird Feathers.

quest_list.notes: Use Magnifying Glass to find hummingbird feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the ground carefully, you find 5 Hummingbird Feathers.

quest_list.notes: Use Magnifying Glass to find hummingbird feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the ground carefully, you find 8 Hummingbird Feathers.

quest_list.notes: Use Magnifying Glass to find hummingbird feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the ground carefully, you find 4 Hummingbird Feathers.

quest_list.notes: Use Magnifying Glass to find hummingbird feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Examining the ground carefully, you find 8 Hummingbird Feathers. Score!

quest_list.notes: Give Leda Swann Hummingbird Feathers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I need forty.  You're a bit short.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Leda Swann 40 Hummingbird Feathers.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, these are nice.  They could use a wash, but they're nice.  Thank you.  Now.  One last thing.

quest_list.notes: Leda wants 6 pearls to use as eyes.
quest_list.success_message: Leda would like six pearls to use as the eyes for her mechanical birds.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Eyes, of course!  Six pearls should do.

quest_list.notes: Leda checks to make sure you've given her everything
quest_list.title: Leda Swann's Mechanical Birds
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You haven't given me everything I need.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Leda Swann's Mechanical Birds!  You earned $75,000 and 200 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes you have! Here is your reward! You've certainly earned it. These will be the most beautiful birds ever. Thanks so much!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose, DesertM

quest_list.notes: Crows Nest Carrie asks for help
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to help Crow's Nest Carrie find a hobby.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I’ve nary a clue.  What do these other scurvy sea dogs around here do in their spare time? Would ye mind askin’ them fer me? But don’t be pesterin’ no Captains, they be too busy fer such tom foolery.

quest_list.notes: Carrie hears about her neighbors
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked ya to parley with all me neighbors, come back when yer finished talkin'.
quest_list.success_message: Crow's Nest Carrie want to know what her neighbors do.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Me neighbors be having some interesting pass times?  The Debbil ya say!  What do these scalawags do?

quest_list.notes: Carrie asks you to go to Art Isle
quest_list.success_message: Crow's Nest Carrie asks you to go talk to the women of an artist island.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Aye, I be hearin' of an island where nothin' but artsy folks be livin'.  Why don't ye be goin' there and ask the women folk fer me?

quest_list.notes: Phyllis Colt sends asks you to ask around FlipperTon to see who might have known a Miss Knight.
quest_list.success_message: Phyllis Colt would like you to ask around Flipperton for someone who might have known a Miss Knight who adopted a dun foal.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Would you do that?  I'd really appreciate it!  Like I said, her name was Miss Knight, or maybe it was Miss Castle...

quest_list.notes: Iona gives you a lead on Miss Knight's whereabouts.
quest_list.success_message: Iona says Miss Knight has, or had, a relative on Hare Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She had a relative on Hare Isle she talked about sometimes.  Worked in a feed store or some such thing, if I recall correctly.  I guess you could ask her if she knows anything.

quest_list.notes: Ginger Craft wants 10 honeycombs before she'll give you the address you want.
quest_list.success_message: Ginger Craft wants 10 Honeycombs in return for her finding the address you want.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I want ten honeycombs.  I need them for my work, and the sound of buzzing bees makes me crazy!  So, if you want that address, ten honeycombs it is.

quest_list.notes: Give Ginger the honeycombs, get a slip of paper.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: There's not enough!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Ginger Craft 10 Honeycombs.  In return, she gave you a Scribbled Note containing (one hopes) Miss Knight's current address.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, I'll write it down. (Hastily scribbles an address on a note, folds the note and seals it, and hands it over as if it were made of leeches.)

quest_list.notes: Give Phyllis the scribbled note.
quest_list.title: Phyllis Colt's Favorite Foal
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: This is a note?  Sorry, this is a tadpole, I was expecting a note.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Phyllis Colt's Favorite Foal.  You earned $12,000 and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: ...MeadowTon? Where's... I guess it's somewhere in the Foreign Isles.  Well, I can but try.  Thank you so much!  Here's a bit of a reward for you.
quest_list.author: SpottedRose

quest_list.notes: Martina makes sure you got everyone from Web Isle (tracking only)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not all.  I would like the invoices and samples from both Lilibeth and Shoneah before moving on, please.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let's see....what's next?? (Looks over all the lists in her hands.) Here...next stop is Wington.

quest_list.notes: you ask Just Gus
quest_list.success_message: Just Gus gives you a suggestion about painting.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Arrrrr, I be too busy with me duties here in the lighthouse to be bothered wit' such foolishness. Away wit' ye,ya scurvy bilge rat!! (He gestures you to come closer.) But I hears tell that there may be some paintin’ bein’ done by some.

quest_list.notes: Agree to help Kevin find the Wreck of the Hesperpuss.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to help Kevin search for the Wreck of the Hesperpuss.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I don't know. My home isn't by the sea so I don't really know anything about tidesl I was just guessing.  Could you help me search around the shoreline here and see if anything turns up?  The tide should be coming back in soon.

quest_list.notes: Find part of the Hull of the Hesperpuss
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You search high and low all around,  but find nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You scan the rock with your binocs, and see a small piece of wood bobbing in the waves just out of reach!  Thinking quickly, you get out your rake and haul it in.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found Part of a Hull!

quest_list.notes: you ask Black Bart
quest_list.success_message: Black Bart shares his hobby of collecting anchors.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: So Carrie thinks we manly men have hobbies?  Actually, I do have a pass time.  I collects anchors.  All sizes, all ages, all metals.  If it be an anchor, I wants it!

quest_list.notes: Give the hull part to Kevin
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Aww, that's not part of the boat, that's just flotsam.
quest_list.success_message: You give Kevin the Part of the Hull that you found.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, wow!  It's in bad shape.  But I can fix it, I think.  Where did you find it?

quest_list.notes: you ask Squalid Nathaniel
quest_list.success_message: Squalid Nathaniel suggested stamps.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hobbies,eh? I hears about them, but a real piratey pirate ain't got no time fer such things. (He checks side to side.) But if I did, reckon I might give stamps a fling. (Winks.)

quest_list.notes: you ask Silvertooth Sam
quest_list.success_message: Silvertooth Sam tells you about his hobby collecting maps.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, ain't it an obvious fact?  I be using me free time to collect and study maps.  The older the better, I sez, sez I.

quest_list.notes: Kevin says to talk to Bailey about currents. [tracking]
quest_list.success_message: Kevin suggests you ask Bailey about the local currents (discreetly, of course).
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I don't know.  Auntie Bailey doesn't use boats very much.  But I guess you could ask her ... if you could ask her without making her suspicious or anything.

quest_list.notes: Martina makes sure you got everyone from Wington (tracking only)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's not all.  I would like the invoices and samples from both Iris Pettel and William Sleapwhell before moving on, please.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Who's next?? (Looks over several lists tacked to her walls.) Oh, yes, the final errand for you, you're heading to Jungle Isle.

quest_list.notes: Search for catalog cards.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You look all over at all the tiny details, but alas, nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Looking carefully, you see signs that there were cards here.  Something has been digging at them, and may have carried them off a little way.  Perhaps if you dug around, you might find them.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found signs of cards...

quest_list.notes: Bailey sends you to Shellton to talk to the harbormaster (tracking)
quest_list.success_message: Bailey suggest you talk to Mr. Schooner, the Shellton Harbormaster.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Bailey shrugs.) One would talk to a harbormaster, I would think. Try Schooner at the Shellton Dock. He would know more than anyone, I'd think.

quest_list.notes: Seamus tells you about some shipwrecks he's heard of. (tracking)
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Anywhere the currents slow or make a sharp turn, that's a start.  An' I heard about a shipwreck on Haven a while back.  Crazy Eddie's place sometimes has stuff washed up.  Ask the islanders, they'll know.
quest_list.success_message: Seamus Schooner tells you about some places to look for shipwrecks.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Anywhere the currents slow or make a sharp turn, that's a start.  An' I heard about a shipwreck on Haven a while back.  Crazy Eddie's place sometimes has stuff washed up.  Ask the islanders, they'll know.

quest_list.notes: Find Foremast on Haven Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over,  but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: What's that?  It looks like a miniature mast, half buried.  You carefully rake it up.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found the Foremast of Bailey's Ship!  Kevin will be thrilled!

quest_list.notes: Give Kevin the Foremast you found on Haven
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: What's that?  I don't recognize it, it's not part of a boat.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kevin the Foremast you found on Haven Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, wow!  And I just found part of the deck, I can get this fitted in place right away!  Thanks!

quest_list.notes: Find the Mainsail on Quiet Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over,  but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: What's this? It's cambric, and it has eyelets just where a sail might have them!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found the Mainsail of the Hesperpuss! Kevin will be thrilled!

quest_list.notes: Find Two More Sails on one of the NeverEnding Isles
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over,  but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You rake carefully and see something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is part of a mast and a bit of cambric!  It's the Topgallant of the mainmast!  And here are some other sails as well!  Kevin will be thrilled!

quest_list.notes: Find the rudder of the Hesperpuss - Crazy Eddie's Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over,  but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: You carefully rake the sand off what turns out to be the rudder assembly and part of the keel of the Hesperpuss!
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You found the Rudder Assembly!  Better get these to Kevin asap.

quest_list.notes: Find the Aftercastle of the Hesperpuss west edge of Hotzeplotz
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You rake all over,  but uncover nothing interesting.
quest_list.success_message: Raking about a suspicious mound of sand you hit something.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You find the Aftercastle of the Hesperpuss! Good work! Kevin will be happy!

quest_list.notes: Give the Mainsail to Kevin that you found on Quiet
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, sorry, that's just a rag.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kevin the Mainsail you found on Quiet Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, this is the mainsail all right!  I'll get it stuck onto the boat right away!  Oh, and I found another mast and part of the deck too, so that's a little less I need you to find!

quest_list.notes: Give Kevin the Topgallant & other sails found on Neverending Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, no, these are just handkerchiefs or something.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kevin the Topgallant you found on the NeverEnding Isles
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wow!  This makes all the sails!  They're dirty, but I can wash them...I think.

quest_list.notes: Give Kevin the Rudder section you found on Crazy Eddie's Isle
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I wonder what this is. It's not part of Auntie Bailey's ship.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kevin the Rudder Assembly you found on Crazy Eddie's Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, the rudder and keel, and they're not in all that bad a shape, either!  That's almost everything!

quest_list.notes: Give Kevin the Aftercastle you found on Hotzeplotz
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: No, this is from a toy boat.  It's not what I need.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Kevin the aftercastle you found on Hotzeplotz.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: The aft section!  Wonderful!  I think this might just be it!

quest_list.notes: Finish Kevin's Quest
quest_list.title: Kevin and the Wreck of the Hesperpuss
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Well, that's almost everything, but some parts are still missing. Please keep looking!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Kevin and the Wreck of the Hesperpuss! You earned 10 Diamonds, 10 Crystal Shards, and 350 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That's everything!  Now for some glue and a wash and... Thanks so much!  I don't have a big allowance, but I've collected these.  You can have them!  THANKS!
quest_list.author: SpottedRose, Desertm

quest_list.notes: Give Crazy Eddie a strawberry to ensure his cooperation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: That's no strawberry, what do you think I am?  Sane?!  Get me a strawberry, or my lips are sealed.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Crazy Eddie a Strawberry.  You know how he is about strawberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, a strawberry which surpasseth all understanding!  Nom, nom, nom!  Now what was it you wanted again?

quest_list.notes: Eunice suggests Sand Painting
quest_list.success_message: Eunice gave you a Sand Painting Starter kit for Carrie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I see, here give her this sand painting starter kit.  If she likes it she can let me know and I’ll set her up with everything she needs.

quest_list.notes: Holly suggests collecting Sea Shells
quest_list.success_message: Holly gave you a Seahorse for Carrie to start a seashell collection.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I like collecting miniature horses.  Since she is on the waterfront, maybe she’d like to collect sea shells.  Here give her this to start her collection.

quest_list.notes: Genevieve suggests pottery
quest_list.success_message: Genevieve gave you basic Pottery Supplies for Carrie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here, take this beginners book and clay back to Carrie.  If she likes it, let me know and I'll set her up with everything she might need.

quest_list.notes: Mona suggests crocheting
quest_list.success_message: Mona gave you a Crocheted Tote Bag for Carrie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here give her this tote. There’s a couple of crochet hooks, some yarn and a very simple “how to” booklet.  If she likes it, tell me, and I’ll give you my yarn suppliers.

quest_list.notes: Posy suggests flower arranging
quest_list.success_message: Posy gave you three Books on Flower Arranging for Carrie.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You don’t say!  Well I have always found my flowers to be very relaxing.  Here, take these books back to her.  They contain everything she needs to know to begin flower arranging.  I hope she likes them.

quest_list.notes: Carrie gets the Sand Painting kit.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Belay that matey, ya said you had some sandy kit.  Ya best be bringin' it back here!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Carrie the Sand Painting kit from Eunice.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looking over the kit.) Ye be right abouts the sand. I’ll give this a try.

quest_list.notes: Carrie gets the Seahorse
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arrr ya scaliwag, where be me seahorse?  Go find it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Carrie the Seahorse from Holly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looks carefully at the seahorse.) Tis a pretty little thing. I’ll keeps me eyes open next time I walks on the beach I’ll see what I can find.

quest_list.notes: Carrie gets the book and clay.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Are ye tryin' to fools an old pirate?  Go find me pot'ry tings!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Carrie the Pottery Supplies from Genevieve.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Flips through the instructions.) Arrr, this be more complicated than I was thinkin’ about, but I’ll gives it a try.

quest_list.notes: Carrie gets the crocheted tote bag
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arrr ya mealy mouthed landlubber, where's me tote bag? Ya best be findin' it!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Carrie the Crocheted Tote Bag from Mona.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Looks at the tote bag and it’s contents.) Me mammy and her mammy before her crocheted. I thinks I be likin’ this suggestion!

quest_list.notes: Carrie gets the books on flower arranging
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Do ya takes me fer a fool?  Go find them books!
quest_list.success_message: You gave Carrie the three Flower Arranging Books from Posy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Leafs through the three books.) I’ll gives this a go, but there ain’t a lot of flowers here abouts.

quest_list.notes: Carrie rewards you.
quest_list.title: Crow's Nest Carrie's Hobby
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Don't be turnin' into no scurvy bilge rat.  Go talk to all the artist ladies on that island!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Crow's Nest Carrie's Hobby! You earned 2 Ruby Necklaces, a Diamond Necklace and 175 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ya did a right proper job fer me, matey. Here be somethin’ fer yer troubles. (She tosses a leather pouch towards you.) Come see me in a couple of months and I might needs ya to get me some supplies.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Agree to try to unite Marilyn Pugg and Fussy Spink-Bottle
quest_list.success_message: You have agreed to talk to those sundered lovers, Marilyn Pugg and 'Fussy' Spink-Bottle, and try to re-unite their hearts.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can't guarantee the state of your mental health when you're through, they're both as loopy as catnip fruitcakes.  But, in the absence of Skeeves, I gratefully accept your offer.

quest_list.notes: Fussy Spink-Bottle tells you where to find Ms. Pugg.
quest_list.success_message: Fussy Spink-Bottle tells you that Ms. Pugg might be found on Patsy Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I suspect she's gone back home to her family seat.  Patsy Isle, don't you know.

quest_list.notes: Raliegh Spayde would like a private word.
quest_list.success_message: Raliegh Spayed would like you to meet him in Sir Sleepwell's house.
quest_list.success_npc_chat:
Oh look! The sweet little Anopheles! They must be getting ready to turn into wee elves! (Marylin wanders off down the beach.)
Raleigh Spode: Listen to me! I have an idea. Meet me in the house.

quest_list.notes: Agree to go find Glossover
quest_list.success_message: You've agreed to find the eminent brain specialist, Rickroll Glossover.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She wants this Spink-Bottle, no matter what she says!  She's that kind of pure, sweet soul!  I care about her happiness.  So I want you to find Glossover and question him narrowly! I'll stay here, try to make her see sense!  Bring him here if you can!

quest_list.notes: Iona checks your level
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I’m sorry, I don’t think you’ve been on enough adventures to help me, come back when you are able to visit pirates.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It looks like you are the one I've been waiting for.  Are you ready to help?

quest_list.notes: Francis asks for Ebony
quest_list.success_message: Francis asked you to bring him 10 Ebony Logs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You're so kind.  Would you mind going to the jungle and bringing me back some Ebony?  Ten logs should do.

quest_list.notes: You give Francis his Ebony Logs
quest_list.title: Francis' Manicure
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I'm sorry, friend, but you don't have what I asked for.  Come back when you have all of them.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Francis' Manicure.  You earned 2 Pearl Necklaces and 25 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Oh, my, what perfectly grand logs!  Thanks ever so much.  Here's a little something for your troubles.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Iona gives you the first list.
quest_list.success_message: Iona gave you your Woodworkers List and 7 Festival Invitiations .
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is a list of woodworkers.  I've listed the islands they live on.  Find them and give them their invitations and bring back the R.S.V.P. cards

quest_list.notes: Woody gets his invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Woody gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You can tell Iona that I think this is a mighty fine idea. I'll be there with bells on!

quest_list.notes: Xamba gets his invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You say you have invitation, where is it?  Go find it.
quest_list.success_message: Xamba gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You tell Iona this is a maybe.  Long trip.  Yes it is.  Yes, yes.  If any one else from this island goes, go will I.

quest_list.notes: Cecil Shuteye gets his invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Cecil gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I never thought of showing my miniatures before, it might be fun.  Tell Iona I'm honored to be invited and I can't wait!

quest_list.notes: Gillian gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Gillian gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: A crafts festival?  That's not something I normally would do, but it does sound like fun.  Tell Iona I'll be there.

quest_list.notes: Rebecca gets her invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You say you have invitation, where is it?  Go find it.
quest_list.success_message: Rebecca gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm always looking for new ideas and contacts, this festival could provide both.  Tell Iona it will be my pleasure to attend her event.

quest_list.notes: Christel gets their invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You say you have invitation, where is it?  Go find it.
quest_list.success_message: Christel gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I know my grandmother won't go, but I'd like to show our toys.  I'll definitely be there!

quest_list.notes: Kelda gets her invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Kelda gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have some friends down south, this is just the excuse I need to visit them.  Tell Iona I will happily attend her festival.

quest_list.notes: Iona gets the RSVP's from the woodworkers [Iona's Festival Part 1]

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't give me seven cards. Make sure you visited everyone on the list!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Part 1 of Iona's Festival.  You earned $10,000 and 100 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Wonderful!  Here's a little something for your efforts.  Now, are you ready for the next list?
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Iona gives you the 2nd list
quest_list.success_message: Iona gave you her Jewelers List and 6 Festival Invitations.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is a list of Jewelers and Metalworkers. I've listed the islands they live on.  Find them and give them their invitations and bring back their R.S.V.P. cards

quest_list.notes: Shoneah gets his invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Shoneah gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I think I'd like to attend.  Flipperton is not that far away from Santon. I could visit my grandparents while there.

quest_list.notes: Lapis Maki gets her invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Lapis gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You know, I could use a break.  I'd love to attend.  And who knows, maybe my cousin, Jade, will be there too!

quest_list.notes: Inigo gets his invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Inigo gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: This sounds like a great idea.  I'm always looking for ways to expand my market. Tell Iona I'll be there!

quest_list.notes: Jade gets her invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Jade gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I LOVE craft shows! I'll definitely go. Maybe I'll even run into my cousin, Lapis, there too.

quest_list.notes: Grey Slate gets his invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Grey Slate gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: (Sighing) Much as I would love to get out of here for a while, I can't go. I never know when his highness over on Hotzeplotz is going to demand something.

quest_list.notes: Earl Bronze gets his invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Earl Bronze gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I never thought of displaying my work, but it might be interesting.  I'll do it!  Tell Iona I'll be there.

quest_list.notes: Iona gets the RSVP's from the Jewelers et al. [Iona's Festival Part 2]
quest_list.title: Iona's Festival Part 2
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't give me 6 cards. Make sure you visited everyone on the list!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Part 2 of Iona's Festival  You earned $7500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: What a shame about Grey Slate.  Here's a little something for your efforts.  Now, are you ready for the next list?
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Iona gives you her Artisan List
quest_list.success_message: Iona gave you her Artisans List and 8 Festival Invitations.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is a list of assorted artisans. I've listed the islands they live on.  Find them and give them their invitations and bring back their R.S.V.P. cards.

quest_list.notes: Willie gets his invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Arrr ya said ya had an invitation fer me, better go back and find it ya scurvy dog!
quest_list.success_message: Willie gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It be a right intrestin' idea.  I never thought to show me work to no landlubbers, but there be a few kindred souls in Flipperton...I'll do it!

quest_list.notes: Chanda gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Chanda gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You know a craft festival should be fun.  Tell Iona that I'd be honored to attend.

quest_list.notes: Yepa gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Yepa gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I would be honored to display our traditional crafts. I'll attend.  Do you know if my grandson, Shoneah, will be there?

quest_list.notes: Lenny gets his invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Lenny gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I haven't been off of this island in years. I'd love to go. It would be a much needed vacation!

quest_list.notes: Palila gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Palila gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I can always use new customers. I'll do it. Tell Iona I'd love to be there.

quest_list.notes: Leasa gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Leasa gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I never dreamed that people would be interested in my quilts. Do you think I should go? (You nod.) All right, I'll go!

quest_list.notes: Linnea gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Linnea gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Iona has referred many people to me, attending her festival is the least I can do.  Tell her I'm coming.

quest_list.notes: Katinka gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Katinka gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I'm honored to be included in her festival.  I might even drop in and visit Olav while I'm down in the lower islands.

quest_list.notes: Iona gets the RSVP's from the Artisans. [Iona's Festival Part 3]
quest_list.title: Iona's Festival Part 3
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't give me 8 cards. Make sure you visited everyone on the list!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Part 3 of Iona's Festival.  You earned $7,500 and 75 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've done a geat job!  Here's a little something for your efforts.  Now, are you ready for the final list?
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Iona gives you her Art Isle List
quest_list.success_message: Iona gave you her Art Isle List and 6 Festival Invitations.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here is my final list, it's only for the folks on Art Isle.  Remember I only want the artists invited, not the collectors.

quest_list.notes: Pablo gets his invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Pablo gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: It might be a good idea to expand my recognition.  I think I will attend.

quest_list.notes: Mona gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Mona gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I really love those craft shows.  There hasn't been one around here in a long time.  Let Iona know I will definitely be there!

quest_list.notes: Salvador gets his invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Salvador gave you his R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, a gathering of artists?  Yes I will be there and I will bring my best illustrations with me.

quest_list.notes: Genevieve gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Genevieve gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I love the folks in Flipperton. I'd be honored to attend.

quest_list.notes: Eunice gets her invitation.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Eunice gave you her R.S.V.P. Card.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That sounds like a wonderful plan.  Tell Iona I will happily attend.

quest_list.notes: Posy gets her invitation
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had an invitation for me, better go back and find it!
quest_list.success_message: Posy gave you her R.S.V.P card
quest_list.success_npc_chat: She wants me to show off my flowers?  I can't wait!  Tell her yes, yes, yes!!

quest_list.notes: Iona gets the RSVP's from Art Isle.
quest_list.title: Iona's Festival Part 4
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You didn't give me 6 cards.  Make sure you visited everyone on the list!
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Part 4 of Iona's Festival.  You earned $5,000 a Golden Retriever companion and  50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've done a stellar job for me!  Here's a little something for your efforts.  Oh, and here's a companion for your horse.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Dolly asks you to pick up her basics
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to pick up three Ice Cream Makers and three Sacks of Rock Salt for Dolly Eaton-Bemary.  She gave you $2000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I need three ice cream makers from Simon Goods and three sacks of rock salt from Zeke Sacker to start.  Here, this should cover the expenses.

quest_list.notes: Simon has the Ice Cream Makers
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: You don't have the $300 on you.  Please come back when you do.
quest_list.success_message: Simon Goods sold you three Ice Cream Makers for $300.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, three ice cream makers.  Tell Dolly that I want to know how her Ice Cream Social turns out.

quest_list.notes: Zeke sells you the rock salt
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It will be $75 and apparently you don't have that much.
quest_list.success_message: Zeke Sacker sold you three Sacks of Rock Salt for Dolly's ice cream for $75.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go then, three sacks of rock salt. (You hand Zeke the money.) Thank you, always a pleasure!

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her basics
quest_list.title: Dolly's Ice Cream Social
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I asked you to get the ice cream makers and the rock salt. Please come back when you have both.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed  Dolly's Ice Cream Social.  You earned $1500 and 50 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you, you have no idea how much of a help this is.  Stop by when you have some more time, there are still some more things I'll need.
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Dolly gives you her ingredient list
quest_list.success_message: Dolly gave you the Ice Cream Ingredients List and $3000.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here's my list. I've already ordered the chocolate and bananas from Nana and the Vanilla from Rika, all you have to do is pick them up.  You'll have to collect the strawberries and snow balls. Here's some travelling money too.

quest_list.notes: Nana gives you the bananas and chocolate
quest_list.success_message: Nana Knutkake gave you a Crate of Bananas and a Crate of Chocolate for Dolly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Here you go, honey, bananas and chocolate.  Hope Dolly's Ice Cream Social is a huge success.

quest_list.notes: Rika gives you Vanilla Beans
quest_list.success_message: Rika Millgrater gave you 5 Packages of Vanilla Beans for Dolly.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: I have them right here. Tell Dolly they are on her bill and it's a pleasure doing business with her.

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly the Bananas
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had my bananas, go back and get them.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly her Crate of Bananas.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: These bananas look delicious!  They'll make fabulous banana splits!

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Chocolate
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had my chocolate, go back and get it.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly her Crate of Chocolate.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: My, this chocolate will make incredible chocolate ice cream.

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Vanilla Beans
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: I thought you said you had my vanilla beans, go back and get them, please.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly her 5 Packages of Vanilla Beans.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Ah, these will make exquisite vanilla ice cream!

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Strawberries.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but I need 50 strawberries.  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly 50 Strawberries.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You picked the best strawberries I've seen in quite some time.  I bet the strawberry ice cream will become a thing of legends!

quest_list.notes: You give Dolly her Snowballs.
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Sorry, but I need 50 snowballs.  Come back when you have them all.
quest_list.success_message: You gave Dolly 50 Snowballs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Thank you!  You know you can't make ice cream without ice!

quest_list.notes: Dolly rewards you.
quest_list.title: Dolly's Ingredients
quest_list.fail_npc_chat: It looks like you're missing something.  Take a look at the list I gave you and see if you can figure out what it is.
quest_list.success_message: You Completed Dolly's Ingredients!  You earned $5000, some Ice Cream and 150 quest points.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You've done a wonderful job helping me with my Ice Cream Social.  Here's a little something for your efforts...and a sample of my ice cream!
quest_list.author: BklynFilly

quest_list.notes: Mehitabel gives you Archy's to do list
quest_list.success_message: Mehitabel gave you a copy of Archy's List and $10,000 for travel expenses.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Let me get it for you. (She goes into another room and comes out with a list.) Here it is, although I’m sure he did not follow the list in order, someone on this list should be able to tell you where he is. Take this to defray your expenses.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Gillian
quest_list.success_message: Gillian told you Archy went to vist Andrea.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why, he was here a few months ago.  Picked up his lumber and said he was going to drop by Andrea's place before he left Ring Isle.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Andrea
quest_list.success_message: Andrea told you Archy was on his way to Wington.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy stopped by months ago. He brought me suet and seeds for my birds, but he's long gone... Said he was heading to Wington.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Cadence
quest_list.success_message: Cadence told you Archy went to check up on Zamora.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yes, he picked them up quite a while ago. Ask Zamora if she knows his whereabouts.  He always stops by to check on her when he's here.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Zamora
quest_list.success_message: Zamora told you Archy went to pick up the tar.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Just a sec, let me look.  Nope, he left. Said he was going to see a man about some tar.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Karl
quest_list.success_message: Karl told you Archy went to see Arbuckle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Why sure!  Archy got his tar, oh, about a month or two ago. Check with Arbuckle, Archy always stops by for a chat whenever he's around here.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Arbuckle
quest_list.success_message: Arbuckle told you Archy went to pick up his signs.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Well, truth be told, he brought me some new shelves but that was over a month ago. He said he'd visit longer, but he had to pick up his signs.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Salvador
quest_list.success_message: Salvador told you Archy wanted a couple of knishes and to check the Inn..
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy picked up his signs a little over a month ago. I usually don't make signs, but for those two, I'd make anything!  He said he was craving some knishes. Look for him at the Inn.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Remy
quest_list.success_message: Remy told you Archy went to see Cedric.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Sure Archy was here.  He had his fill of knishes and picked up a dozen bagels for Mehitabel, but he left. Said he was going north to see Cedric.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Cedric
quest_list.success_message: Cedric told you to see if Rupert has seen Archy.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He sure did. Picked them up about a month ago. Said he was going to drop in on Rupert. I'd check with him.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Rupert
quest_list.success_message: Rupert told you Archy was on his way to Ice Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy?  Sure he was here about a month ago. Gave me a couple of cords of wood. Such a nice guy.  He said he was heading to Ice Isle next.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Linnea
quest_list.success_message: Linnea suggested you look for Archy at Yorick's place.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: That poor dear. Archy picked up his rugs about a month ago. He probably went to visit his old friend, Yorick. See if he knows where Archy is.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Yorick
quest_list.success_message: Yorick said Archy left for Rider Isle.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He was here. We ate some stew, played some checkers and talked some hockey, then he left for Rider.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Miguela
quest_list.success_message: Miguela told you Archy went to see Kyleigh.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Si! Si! He picked it up about 4 weeks ago. He said he had something for Kyleigh. Ask her where Archy is.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Kyleigh
quest_list.success_message: Kyleigh told you Archy left for Earton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He was here recently, gave me these bags of sachet that Mehitabel made for me. He couldn't stay long. Said he was on his way to Earton.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Tobias
quest_list.success_message: Tobias told you Archy went to see Twig.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Been and gone. Archy picked up his chocolate spread about three or four weeks ago.  I think he said he was going to check on Twig. Maybe he's still there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Twig
quest_list.success_message: Twig told you that Archy went on to Treeton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Nope, he dropped off a big bag of red pine cones for me and left.  I think he said he was heading down to Treeton.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Oliver Oates
quest_list.success_message: Oliver Oates told you to go see Ryland.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He picked up his order of oats almost a month ago.  I know he always drops in to visit Ryland.  I'd check there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ryland
quest_list.success_message: Ryland told you that Archy went to Shellton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy's gone on walkabout again?  He was here and gave me some of Mehitabel's chicken soup. Said he was on his way  to Shellton, I'd check there..

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ollie Scooper
quest_list.success_message: Ollie Scooper told you Archy went to visit Atreyu.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy pick those up about three weeks ago or so.  I believe he was going to say hello to Atreyu before he left town. Go ask Atreyu.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Atreyu
quest_list.success_message: Atreyu told you Archy was on his way to Hotton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy was here about three weeks ago. We had a nice visit. He had some gifts for my special pets.  He said he had to move on to Hotton.  I'd look there.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ward Anvil
quest_list.success_message: Ward Anvil told you Archy went to see Ormand.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy picked up his nails three weeks ago.  He said he wanted to drop in on Ormand before he left Hotton. Maybe he knows where Archy got off to.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Ormand
quest_list.success_message: Ormand told you that Archy was heading to Flipperton.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Yeah, he came by. Told him I don't need no help from the likes of him and to git. He said okay, said he was heading to the old folks town next. Now you git!

quest_list.notes: Talk to Sandra
quest_list.success_message: Sandra told you that Archy might be at Fin's.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: He most certainly did pick up their preserves.  He was here two or three weeks ago. You might check with Fin.  He and Archy love to chew the fat.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Fin
quest_list.success_message: Fin told you that Archy left to go to see Lilac.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy came by and we had a real nice visit, but he left.  He said he was heading to see Lilac.

quest_list.notes: Talk to Lilac
quest_list.success_message: Lilac told you that Archy was going to visit Tulippe.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Archy?  He picked up his seed order about two weeks ago. He said he was going to stop in on Mehitabel's cousin, Tulippe. Go see her..

quest_list.notes: Talk to Tulippe

quest_list.notes: You give Anathema a bunch of grapes

quest_list.success_npc_chat: No charge necessary. Good deed for the day.  Yes yes.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: These are wonderful. He does such beautiful work! I can get started on painting them right away.

quest_list.notes: Track Xamba
quest_list.success_npc_chat: Hmm...  Two days.  Yes.  Two days will be enough time.  Go.  Explore!

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Beautiful! Just beautiful. This will create the perfect highlights to compliment the ebony.

quest_list.fail_npc_chat: Not quite. I needed ebony forms, gold leaf, and beetle shells. Please come back when you have everything.
quest_list.success_message: You agreed to give Kelda a week to finish the work.
quest_list.success_npc_chat: You did an amazing job of getting these things. Now I need to do my work and paint, paint, paint. Please give me about a week to complete the set.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: And here's the second smallest one. It is covered in charming chameleons. I've still got four more nesting shapes to paint. Come back in a few days.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: And look here! I've covered the fourth form in lovely parrots! I wanted to share everything that's beautiful about the Jungle. So, that said, give me a couple more days, please.

quest_list.success_npc_chat: Please give me one more day to finish the outer shell. My reputation is on the line here and I simply won't be rushed.

quest_list.notes: Kelda gives you the beautiful ebony nesting doll set
